fdroid:com.sigseg.android.worldmap.name: WorldMap
fdroid:com.sigseg.android.worldmap.description:
WorldMap is a simple Android app that displays
a map of the world taken from Wikimedia and allows the user to scroll around on
it. The map is licensed as PD-USGOV; PD-USGOV-CIA-WF - more info
 here )
The map itself is quite large (6480x3888), so it's way too big to fit in memory
all at once (over 48MB). The VM heap size Android supports is either 16 or 24
megs, so we can't fit the whole thing in memory at once. To overcome this,
WorldApp uses the BitmapRegionDecoder API (available as of Android 2.3.3) to
decode just what it needs to display. The app can also serve as a viewer for
arbitrary images opened via a (3rd-party) file manager.

fdroid:cz.kutner.why.summary: Asks why you unlock your phone. See your habits. No internet. No tracking.
fdroid:cz.kutner.why.description:
Why? asks one question each time you unlock your phone: what brings you here?

 What you get 
• A question after each unlock, with your reasons sorted for the time of day
• Today's jar: every unlock drops a pebble. Tilt the phone and the pebbles roll.
• A week view: daily jars, where the time went, and your habit hours
• A gentle check-in when you stay longer than you planned
• An evening summary with the day's numbers
• Typed answers you use often can become reasons with one tap
 Private by design 
• Everything stays on your phone
• No internet permission, no accounts, no ads, no tracking
• Never reads which apps you use: it only notices unlocks and screen off
 Permissions 
• Display over other apps: to show the question
• Notifications: Android needs a small notification to keep the app running
• Battery set to "Unrestricted" (recommended), so Android does not stop the app
Free and open source.

fdroid:pl.zse.bydgoszcz.elektron.description:
Unofficial app for students of the Zespół Szkół Elektronicznych (school of electronics) in Bydgoszcz, Poland. It reads the school's public websites directly - no login and no personal data collected. Works offline.
 Features 
 Daily and weekly timetable with substitutions applied; the current lesson shows the time left
 Class groups: only the lessons you attend (languages, workshops, PE, religion), including several groups of one subject
 Substitutions for your class and group, including cancelled lessons, plus notices the school adds under a date (e.g. blood donation)
 Notifications about new substitutions (day, lesson, subject and teacher), news and school notices, quiet hours
 Days off: no reminders or live notification on holidays, breaks and winter break
 Live notification on school days: countdown to the break or the next lesson, what is on now and next, when lessons end (optional)
 Notes for upcoming lessons with a reminder the day before or before the lesson
 Lesson reminders with the room number
 School news read in the app, with photos, search and favourites available offline
 Home screen with the current or next lesson, breaks, substitutions and time left until lessons end
 Widgets: Next lesson, Day plan, Substitutions, plus a quick settings tile
 Commute: in the morning buses and trams to your next lesson (time to spare, last one that makes it), after lessons the way home (when to leave), live delays, without GPS (optional)
 Custom subject names and colours, light and dark theme, accent colour, ready-made or custom background colour, wallpaper colours, app icon choice
The app's interface is in Polish. Not affiliated with the school or VULCAN. Inspired by Atom (iOS) by Kacper Górka. Free software under GNU GPL v3 or later.

fdroid:xyz.cmcdaniel.localcrop.summary: Find local farms and farmers markets near you using public USDA data.
fdroid:xyz.cmcdaniel.localcrop.description:
LocalCrop puts ~28,000 farms, farmers markets, CSAs, food hubs, and agritourism listings on an interactive map. All data comes from the USDA Local Food Directories, which is public domain.
Search by location, filter by type, and find what's near you. Tap a listing to see contact info, website, address, and a link to the vendor's USDA directory page.
Features:
- Interactive map with ~28,000 listings across the United States
- Filter by type: farmers markets, on-farm markets, CSAs, food hubs, agritourism
- Search by address or use your device's location
- Tap listings for contact details, websites, and directions
- Works offline with bundled data — no account or internet required after install
- No tracking, no ads, no data collection
Data is voluntarily reported to the USDA by market managers, farm representatives, and state agriculture agencies. LocalCrop links to vendor websites and phone numbers so you can verify details before visiting.
Built with MapLibre GL JS and OpenFreeMap tiles. Entirely open source under the AGPL-3.0 license.

apple-macos:1511725248.description:

Many times when we upload videos to Instagram, it converts them to a Square video because of which some important sections of the videos are cropped out. Using this application, you could create the videos for Instagram without cropping any parts. 
The application resizes and adds background colors to the videos so that it would fit inside the 1:1 square shape and it would be used with Instagram without any cropping. It creates all videos using H.264 Video Codec and AAC audio codec and saves them in MOV format. This is the best video and audio format which is compatible for Instagram.
You could also beautify your videos by adding any background color of choice to the video. The application supports various video formats like FLV, AVI, MP4, MOV, M4V, MKV and WMV. The application supports both vertical and landscape videos. The videos are created using the video and audio codecs that are compatible with Instagram. Once the videos are created, you could transfer them to iPhone or iPad using AirDrop and upload it to Instagram easily from those devices.
Note : 
a) The application only creates videos for Instagram. It does not upload videos to Instagram. Once the videos are created, please transfer them to iPhone, iPad or any other device on which Instagram app is installed and then you will be able to upload them easily to Instagram using those devices.
b) The application only creates videos that you could use for Instagram. It is not related to Instagram in any way.

 Intricate and highly interactive levels, with many secrets to find.
 A rich story consisting of multiple character arcs and plot threads.

 Collectibles, weapon replacements and a fully-fledged progress system.

 Multiple vehicles, including motorcycles, spaceships, tanks and horses.
 In-game cutscenes and pre-rendered FMV sequences, complete with voice acting and subtitles.
 Original music composed by HiveBoss, TheDavisD, AliCatGamer, and various tracks sourced from OpenGameArt.

flathub:net.kubux.Muehle.summary: Play a game of Nine Men's Morris
flathub:net.kubux.Muehle.description:
Muehle is a no frills implementation of the classical board game
 Nine Men's Morris. It does not have any cool features: no play
 against other humans (neither locally nor via the network), no
 play computer vs computer, no stats, no time control, no
 learning from play, no analysis mode, no variants for the rules
 of play. It's just to have some fun playing against
 the AI. The only additions: you can undo moves; and the AI will
 indicate when it thinks the position is dead even (you may take
 that as the AI offering a draw). You, on the other hand, cannot
 offer a draw: that would be pointless, as the AI is not designed
 to handle it anyway. Just quit or start a new game if you feel 
 the current game is going nowhere.
 The AI uses a Monte Carlo tree search variation with a hand
 crafted evaluation function that is based on pattern counts
 (e.g., the number of open mills) and also has perfect knowledge
 of the game theoretic values of all 3 on 3 positions.
 Muehle is distributed free of charge and comes without any (not
 even implied) waranties. So don't use it. If you decide to use
 it anyway, you may find the annotated screenshot helpful.

flathub:org.feichtmeier.Musicpod.description:
A Music, podcasts, and internet radio player built with Flutter for your Linux Desktop
 Musicpod isn't just a music player. You can browse podcasts or listen to internet radio stations - all in one app!
 Play local audio files (mp3, flac, mp4, ogg)
 Find your local audio library sorted by metadata
 Search for local audio files sorted by title, album, genre and artist instantly
 Play internet radio and TV stations and search them by tag, name or country, with icytags displayed and images loaded on demand!
 Play podcasts and find them by country, topic and name
 Download podcasts
 Video podcast support!
 Pin your favorite albums
 Subscribe to podcasts
 Gather a collection of your favorite radio/TV stations
 Jump easily between local audio genres and radio station genres
 Collect your favorite songs with the heart button
 And much, much more!

flathub:org.pvermeer.WebAppHub.description:
A modern Web App Manager built with Rust, GTK, and the Adwaita design language. Web App Hub
 enables seamless management of web applications, each with its own icon and isolated browser profile.

 Apply a wide range of other effects to audio recordings

fedora-packages:flex/flex.description: The flex program generates scanners. Scanners are programs which can recognize lexical patterns in text. Flex takes pairs of regular expressions and C code as input and generates a C source file as output. The output file is compiled and linked with a library to produce an executable. The executable searches through its input for occurrences of the regular expressions. When a match is found, it executes the corresponding C code. Flex was designed to work with both Yacc and Bison, and is used by many programs as part of their build process. fedora-packages:gdouros-alexander-fonts/.description: A text typeface using the Greek letters designed by Alexander Wilson (1714-1786), a Scottish doctor, astronomer, and type founder, who established a type foundry in Glasgow in 1744. The type was especially designed for an edition of Homer’s epics, published in 1756-8 by Andrew and Robert Foulis, printers to the University of Glasgow. A modern revival, Wilson Greek, was designed by Matthew Carter in 1995. Peter S. Baker is also using Wilson’s Greek type in his Junicode font for medieval scholars (2007). Latin and Cyrillic are based on a Garamond typeface. The font covers the Windows Glyph List, IPA Extensions, Greek Extended, Ancient Greek Numbers, Byzantine and Ancient Greek Musical Notation, various typographic extras and several Open Type features (Case-Sensitive Forms, Small Capitals, Subscript, Superscript, Numerators, Denominators, Fractions, Old Style Figures, Historical Forms, Stylistic Alternates, Ligatures). It was created by George Douros.

Highlights: - GHC supports the entire Haskell 2010 language plus a wide variety of extensions. - GHC has particularly good support for concurrency and parallelism, including support for Software Transactional Memory (STM). - GHC generates fast code, particularly for concurrent programs. Take a look at GHC's performance on The Computer Language Benchmarks Game. - GHC works on several platforms including Windows, Mac, Linux, most varieties of Unix, and several different processor architectures. - GHC has extensive optimisation capabilities, including inter-module optimisation. - GHC compiles Haskell code either directly to native code or using LLVM as a back-end. GHC can also generate C code as an intermediate target for porting to new platforms. The interactive environment compiles Haskell to bytecode, and supports execution of mixed bytecode/compiled programs. - Profiling is supported, both by time/allocation and various kinds of heap profiling. - GHC comes with several libraries, and thousands more are available on Hackage.

fedora-packages:atf/libatf-c++-devel.name: libatf-c++-devel
fedora-packages:atf/libatf-c++-devel.description: The Automated Testing Framework (ATF) is a collection of libraries to implement test programs in a variety of languages. At the moment, ATF offers C, C++ and POSIX shell bindings with which to implement tests. These bindings all offer a similar set of functionality and any test program written with them exposes a consistent user interface. ATF-based test programs rely on a separate runtime engine to execute them. The runtime engine is in charge of isolating the test programs from the rest of the system to ensure that their results are deterministic and that they cannot affect the running system. The runtime engine is also responsible for gathering the results of all tests and composing reports. The current runtime of choice is Kyua. This package provides the libraries, header files and documentation to develop applications that use the ATF C++ bindings.

fedora-packages:libint2/libint2.name: libint2
fedora-packages:libint2/libint2.summary: A library for efficient evaluation of electron repulsion integrals
fedora-packages:libint2/libint2.description: LIBINT computes the Coulomb and exchange integrals, which in electronic structure theory are called electron repulsion integrals (ERIs). This is by far the most common type of integrals in molecular structure theory. LIBINT uses recursive schemes that originate in seminal Obara-Saika method and Head-Gordon and Pople’s variation thereof. The idea of LIBINT is to optimize computer implementation of such methods by implementing an optimizing compiler to generate automatically highly-specialized code that runs well on super-scalar architectures.

firefox-addons:9609.summary: The best privacy tool and ad blocker extension for Firefox. Stop trackers, speed up websites and block ads everywhere including YouTube and Facebook.
firefox-addons:9609.description:
Ads slowing down your browsing? 
Ghostery blocks ads instantly on YouTube, Facebook , and across the web while protecting your privacy automatically.
Install once and Ghostery quietly removes ads, stops trackers, and handles cookie popups so you can enjoy a cleaner, faster web.
More than an ad blocker. Ghostery shows what others hide.
Trusted by millions of users for 15+ years, counting more than 100+ million downloads worldwide.
Ghostery for Firefox provides safe, fast, and clutter-free browsing for free. The browser extension upgrades your Firefox browser and supplies full adblock functionality, stops trackers from accessing your personal data, and annoying cookie consent pop-ups.
Ghostery has three main components:
 Ad-Blocking - blocks all ads on websites you visit with your Firefox browser, including Youtube and Facebook, helping you to focus only on the information important to you.
 Anti-Tracking - stops trackers’ ability to collect your personal data, replacing it with random values and anonymizing your identity for data brokers. If you see a need to unblock individual trackers, we developed this option. The reasons are up to you!
 Never-Consent - automatically removes intrusive cookie popups and expresses dissent to online tracking. This unequaled feature adds convenience to each website visit and acts like your privacy advocate towards content providers while using Firefox.
Ghostery delivers the online privacy protection our users have come to know and love while minimising the need for customisation and maintenance.
As Ghostery is more than an ad-blocker, it comes with exceptional additional features, not found in any other ad-blocking extension:
 Trackers information on any website your visit, informing you about the number of trackers, their type, and the company operating them.
 Trackers Preview on search engine result pages - displaying tracker information even before you visit a page. You can safely make the choice to visit it, as Ghostery will stop trackers expecting you on the landing page.
 WhoTracks.Me - Owning and operating the largest database of trackers allows Ghostery to update tracker information fast and reliably for all users.
Moreover, Ghostery is:
 Open source
 Supported by thousands of contributors worldwide
 Free to use forever
Ghostery is free for everyone. Take back control over your digital privacy and become a Contributor to Ghostery. Contributors help Ghostery fund the development of the Privacy Suite and WhoTracks.Me , the largest database of trackers in the world.
Become a Contributor and help Ghostery fight for privacy as a human right!

firefox-addons:2931469.name: FastestPass Password Manager
firefox-addons:2931469.summary: FastestPass instantly saves and auto-fills your passwords so that you can focus on what matters more–without password worries!
firefox-addons:2931469.description:
FastestPass is a password manager extension for Firefox that securely stores passwords, passkeys, and financial information in its digital vault guarded by military-grade encryption protocols. It auto-saves and fills your credentials to ensure seamless access without the hassle of forgotten passwords.
We help detect weak passwords, generate stronger ones, and analyze password health via our premium password management tools. Our personalized security dashboard offers tailored access to your digital vault, where you can organize details according to your preference, giving you complete control over your credentials. Plus, with storage for hundreds of passwords, you'll never have to worry about running out of space. 
Elevate your password security with FastestPass. Here’s what makes us the best password manager for Firefox:
Digital password vault 
Store all your passwords in our digital vault protected by military-grade encryption protocols and access it with the master key. 
High-end Encryption 
The digital password vault is guarded by military-grade encryption, ensuring hacker-proof credential protection. 
Password Generator
We help create strong passwords by blending alphabets, numerics, and alphanumerics. 
Password Health Checker
Check your password health score to analyze if your passwords can stand against advanced cyber threats. 
Master Security Dashboard
Regain control of your passwords with a centralized security dashboard that you can tailor according to your preferences. 
Bank Account Data Vault
Store your financial information in our finances’ vault for improved protection of your financial details.
Driver License Data Storage
Store your personal details, such as your driver's license and other personal information, in the vault for unbreachable security. 
Device Syncing
Install FastestPass on your devices and sync your account across them for seamless access to accounts without device restraints. 
Family Code Sharing 
Share the vault’s master key with your family using a FastestPass code, ensuring that only those with the code can access your accounts. 
Emergency Contact 
In case of an emergency, you can authorize a verified authority to access the FastestPass vault.

bluejetty:00120744:ios.description:
Try our new and exiting worksheet activities game!
Remember learning from activity books? 
Kids love completing the various activities and they have so much fun they hardly notice they are learning and progressing. This game is designed to bring the same feeling to the digital world. It is beautifully designed to be as close as possible to a physical activity book. Game objects and activities are beautifully drawn and colored to relay the sense that this is a good old fashioned activity book. Even game sounds are selected to give a natural feeling.
The worksheets game offers a unique and safe platform that help your child to experience and practice a variety of subjects, all carefully chosen by experienced educators and based on international toddler education guidelines. 
The game is an engaging and fun learning tool designed to help young kids to strengthen their basic skills and expand their knowledge. 
The activities in this game are tuned for toddlers and preschool kids.
About the game:
--------------------
The game consists of 20 worksheet activities, sorted in four beautifully colored environments. Each environment focuses on one important basic skill, such as orientation, following instructions, and basic logic. It combines classification, sorting and matching challenges and uses objects lovingly selected from the child's surrounding
Game features:
--------------------
- Easy and intuitive: Toddlers can play this game independently.
- No stressing time limits.
- Safe environment for your child. No 3rd party ads.
- Enjoyable and educational.
Educational targets:
--------------------------
- Practice visual perception concepts.
- Establish Motor skills such as Hand-eye coordination.
- Practice Visual Attention such as size, length, and angles
- learn to identify colors by name
- exercise kids thinking skills while drawing lines connecting the matching objects
At ToyaTap we are dedicated to creating high-quality learning experiences that children and parents can enjoy together.

bluejetty:00068830:ios.summary:
Pregnancy test - Pregnancy symptoms is an app with a complete questionnaire, which will help you to know whether you might be pregnant, based on the main early symptoms of pregnancy.
Here you will find a pregnancy quiz with 15 questions, w
bluejetty:00068830:ios.description:
Pregnancy test - Pregnancy symptoms is an app with a complete questionnaire, which will help you to know whether you might be pregnant, based on the main early symptoms of pregnancy.
Here you will find a pregnancy quiz with 15 questions, which correspond to the main early signs of pregnancy and with which you will obtain an approximate percentage, which can serve as an orientation to know whether you are pregnant.
If you ask yourself: Am I pregnant? In this case, the best idea is to go to a professional doctor or a pharmacy to do a pregnancy test, but if you want to have an approximate orientation before going, you can do the "Am I pregnant quiz" we have prepared.
Main characteristics:
- Before the first signs of pregnancy, if you want to know the approximate possibility to become pregnant, you can use this pregnancy test calculator to eliminate your doubts.
- It is an online pregnancy test, focused on 15 questions about the signs of early pregnancy during the first weeks, which will give you a guiding result.
- If you are tired of home pregnancy tests, you can try to take this questionnaire. You will have an approximate result by only responding to some simple questions related to the early pregnancy signs in first weeks of pregnancy.
Premium features:
- Unlimited Test Simulations: Remove limits on daily or monthly test uses.
- Remove Ads: Enjoy the App without advertisements.
Which kind of questions will you find in this home pregnancy test?
As we have explained before, all questions are focused on early pregnancy symptoms. Therefore, you will find some questions related to fatigue, irritability, sickness or vomiting, appetite, heartburn, constipation, etc. In short, a collection of the most relevant questions to be able to have an orientation about your situation.
If you ask yourself how to know whether you are pregnant, this app will help you to shed some light and have a rough idea. We hope that this free pregnancy test helps you in discovering a positive or negative pregnancy test result or whatever you are looking for.
If, on the contrary, you want to know how to get pregnant, this is not the aim of this app, therefore we recommend you to search for other apps or information of a professional doctor, since the aim of this app is to check your pregnancy status when having some sign of pregnancy to know whether you are pregnant or not.
Note: This app is not a reliable pregnancy test, but simply a questionnaire to obtain an approximate result, but never definite. It is important that you go to the doctor or pharmacy for a 100% reliable result when experiencing signs of being pregnant.
Legal note: This app and its content have been created by Smiko. The use of the content of this app without previous authorization by the creator of the app is prohibited.
Terms: https://smikoapps.com/terms/pregnancytest-terms.html
Privacy policy: https://smikoapps.com/privacy-policy.html

Easy Currency Strength helps forex traders quickly understand the relative strength of major currencies across multiple timeframes.
Instead of checking individual currency pairs one by one, the dashboard makes it easy to see which currencies are currently strongest and weakest. Larger differences in currency strength may help highlight pairs worth watching for potential trading opportunities.
Key features:
* View the strongest and weakest major currencies across multiple timeframes, from M5 to MN1.
* Compare the relative strength of all major currencies using easy-to-read strength charts.
* Use Pairs to Watch to identify currency pairs with larger strength differences.
* Monitor multiple timeframes to get a broader view of currency strength.
* Quick access to the Economic Calendar.
Currency strength should be used together with price action and other analysis when making trading decisions.

bluejetty:00137389:ios.name: Monster World: Catch and Care
bluejetty:00137389:ios.summary: Embark on an unparalleled adventure in an open world teeming with secrets, where the art of survival merges with the thrill of monster mastery. As you step into this vast expanse, you'll find yourself in a realm where pocket-sized pals are
bluejetty:00137389:ios.description:
Embark on an unparalleled adventure in an open world teeming with secrets, where the art of survival merges with the thrill of monster mastery. As you step into this vast expanse, you'll find yourself in a realm where pocket-sized pals are not just creatures to be captured, but companions to be cherished and trained. Your journey is one of craft, cunning, and camaraderie, where every monster you encounter has the potential to become the next great pal in your ever-growing roster.
In this world, survival is not just about braving the elements or fending off fierce foes; it's about understanding the intricate bond between master and monster. As you navigate through lush forests, arid deserts, and mysterious caverns, your skills in craft will be put to the test. You'll learn to create habitats, concoct potions, and forge equipment not just for your survival but for the well-being of your monstrous pals.
The heart of this experience lies in the deep connection you forge with your monsters. Each creature you capture carries unique abilities, personalities, and potential. Training them is not just a matter of strength but of understanding and nurturing. As you spend time with your monster pals, training in your home and exploring the world together, you'll witness their growth from mere pocket-sized beings to formidable allies.
The ultimate test of your mastery comes in the form of monster battles. These are not mere contests of strength but a display of the deep bond between master and monster. The tournaments you'll participate in are arenas where strategy, bond, and skill converge. With each victory, your reputation as a master will grow, but the true reward lies in the journey with your monster pals and the unbreakable bonds you form along the way.
In this game, every monster is a story, every battle a lesson, and every moment an opportunity to deepen the connection with your pocket-sized pals. Whether you're delving into the art of survival, mastering the craft of monster care, or proving your prowess in high-stakes tournaments, your journey will be one of discovery, friendship, and mastery. Welcome to a world where every monster can become a pal, every challenge a chance to grow, and every player a potential master of this rich, immersive universe.

Fo
bluejetty:00180383:ios.description:
**Apply for a savings account** 
For Filipinos residing and located in the Philippines, easily open a PNB savings account with just one (1) valid ID. This service is initially available to customers with no deposit account with PNB. 
For Filipinos working in Hong Kong, Singapore and Japan, start your account application through PNB Digital with just a few taps and a valid ID. Visit the nearest PNB overseas branch within 30 days from your application for a quick KYC verification. Complete your application with a remittance to fund your account. 
**Easy sign-up** 
Register without going to the branch. You can use any eligible PNB Savings or Checking account number, PNB Debit Card or Credit Card number to enroll.   
**Stay Safe, Bank with Confidence** 
Access your account effortlessly with biometrics. 
Lock your card anytime to prevent unauthorized use and unlock it when needed. 
**Manage and monitor your PNB deposit or e-money accounts** 
View your account balances and transaction history with 24/7 real-time access. 
**Lock your funds safely** 
Set aside part or all your available balance. Locked funds are removed from your available balance and will remain unavailable for any transaction. Unlock anytime in the app.
**Protect your PNB Digital account instantly**
Quickly suspend your PNB Digital access if you suspect your device or access has been compromised. For your protection, access can only be restored through any PNB branch.
**View your credit card information and electronic statements** 
Monitor your PNB Credit Card account balance, statement and recent transactions (including pending transactions).  View your rewards points and PIN. View and download monthly e-statements. 
**Send money anytime, anywhere** 
Support your family or pay for your purchases online. Send money between PNB accounts, to other local banks and eWallets with InstaPay and PESONet. You can also schedule important one-time or recurring transfers for your convenience. 
**Settle your monthly bills in just one app** 
Skip the lines and beat the due dates!  Make hassle-free payments to our various billers using your PNB Debit or Credit Card. You can also schedule important one-time or recurring payments for a worry-free experience. 
**eWallet Top-Up** 
Transfer funds directly to an eWallet in real-time with InstaPay. 
**Speed up your transactions** 
Transfer funds instantly to your family and friends by scanning their account QR Codes. 
**Share your account details safely** 
Receive funds without giving your account number. Create a QR Code for your accounts or link them to your registered mobile number and/or email address for sharing to your contacts.  
**Pay via QR Code** 
Pay your bills and your favorite online and in-store shops easier via QR Ph codes. This is available for participating billers and merchants. 
**Request for Cardless Withdrawal** 
Get cash at any PNB ATM --- no card needed.
**Add Card to Digital Wallet**
Pay smarter and faster. Add your active PNB Card to Apple Pay using PNB Digital and enjoy a seamless and secure checkout experience when paying with Apple Pay.
**Monitor your PNB Time Deposits**  
Add and view your active time deposits easily. 
**Invest in UITFs** 
Subscribe, manage and redeem your investment funds anytime, anywhere.  
**Order your PNB checkbook conveniently** 
Order via the app and pick up at your PNB branch of account. 
**Personalize your PNB Digital Dashboard** 
Access your favorite features instantly by customizing your dashboard based on your most-used services. 
Download the app today and make banking easier.

Planetaro is a powerful planetary hours calculator and moon‑phase calendar that syncs with your location to divide each day into unequal hours from sunrise to sunset. Track which of the seven classical planets—Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury and Moon—rules each hour, and align your activities with their energies. • Planetary hours & moon calendar — view rulership and lunar phases at a glance

• Siri and Shortcuts – ask for the current planetary hour, Moon phase, void of course or your best hours, hands-free

• Multiple themes and automatic or manual location selection
• Universal app: works seamlessly on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
Based on the ancient Star of the Magi principle, Planetaro helps you make the most of your time by showing favorable and unfavorable moments for different activities. Explore the planetary clock that gave rise to the names of the days of the week and discover a timeless tool for self‑awareness, scheduling and astrology.
Learn more at www.planetaro.com.

bluejetty:00120068:ios.summary: Compose cadences on the go! Choose from snares, tenors, bass drums, cymbals, and even drumset if you want. In a league of its own, DrumToolz also lets you manually input exercises for drum set, marching snare, tenors, and bass drums while g
bluejetty:00120068:ios.description:
Compose cadences on the go! Choose from snares, tenors, bass drums, cymbals, and even drumset if you want. In a league of its own, DrumToolz also lets you manually input exercises for drum set, marching snare, tenors, and bass drums while generating new creative ideas using what you input, all shown on an editable music score. You can also upload your beats to your social profile, play what other users are playing, save rhythms, practice snare drum rudiments, and learn from a full library of dynamic exercises for both snare drum and drumset! It's perfect for all skill levels, from beginner to extremely advanced, drum wizards. 
Works great for sharing drum cadences with your drumline. Isolate individual snare, tenors, etc. parts.
Practice the simplest to the most complex of beats and rhythms. If you can think of it, you can input it and practice it! Anything from beginner rock beats, to the most complex of jazz beats and fills. Lastly, top off the notes with ornaments: stickings, accents, flams, diddles, and cheese. Input up to 50 measures.
When practicing drum set beats, choose from a ride cymbal, hihat, hihat foot, kick drum, snare drum, and three toms. Input everything from whole notes to thirtysecond notes and tuplets. Also, for tenors, choose from four tenors and a spock. Bass drums - five bass drums. Marching snare - a realistic marching snare and a ping sound.
Generate new ideas (modifications) using beats that you input into the score. Choose from several modification methods: Add, Shuffle, Substitute, Permutate, Repeat, and Random. Modify individual parts of the beat (ex: kick drum only) or the entire beat if desired. 
Custom snare exercises. Choose the time sig, subdivisons, tuplets, stickings, accents, flams, diddles, cheese, drags.
Save the beat in the score for later practice, keeping the modifications if desired. If the modifications are kept, this turns the beat into an endless, dynamic exercise! Each time you generate an exercise, it uses the modifications to give you an entirely new beat.
String together saved rhythms and practice them as one exercise, perfect for practicing beats followed by a drum fill.
Upload your beats to your profile. Find and follow other drummers in the social network. Learn from them as you see and practice what they have uploaded to their profile.
Share your beats through PDF links and files. Also, share your entire score with a link that pre-populates the score into the app.
Learn from a full library of dynamic drum set and snare drum exercises, essential and hybrid rudiments included.
For highlighted rhythms, shuffle around groups of notes, stickings, accents, flams, diddles, and cheese.

bluejetty:00042254:ios.description:
Get Your iPhone Storage Back — Fast. Private. One Tap.
Tired of “iPhone Storage Almost Full” and a slow Photos app? This is an all‑in‑one toolkit that helps you clean clutter, compress large 4K videos, and protect private photos with Face ID — while keeping processing on your device for privacy.
Why you’ll love it
• Free up space in minutes (results vary by library)
• Clean duplicates + similar shots intelligently
• Compress 4K videos & HEIC photos to save serious GBs
• Lock sensitive media with Face ID / Touch ID
• Fix duplicate contacts and outdated reminders
• No cloud upload for your photo/video/contact processing
KEY FEATURES
1) AI Smart Cleaner (Deep Clean)
- Finds exact duplicates + visually similar photos
- Detects blurry shots, screenshots, and oversized media
- Groups clutter automatically so you can delete in batches
- You’re always in control: review before removing, undo anytime
2) 4K Video & HEIC Compressor
- Reduce file size dramatically with minimal visible quality change*
- Great for saving storage, sharing faster, or archiving
- Choose what to compress and keep originals if you want
*Compression results depend on content and settings.
3) Private Vault (Face ID / Touch ID)
- Keep sensitive photos/videos inside a biometric vault
- Secure access with Face ID / Touch ID + passcode fallback
- Optionally remove originals from your Photos library after importing (with your permission)
4) Contact & Calendar Doctor
- Merge duplicate contacts to keep your address book clean
- Clear outdated reminders and reduce calendar clutter
5) Optional Extras
- Home Screen widgets and personalization tools
- Charging effects and quick utilities (where available)
ONE‑TAP WORKFLOW
1. Tap Scan → AI analyzes your library quickly
2. Review → clutter is pre‑grouped for easy decisions
3. Confirm → clean, compress, or lock in seconds
4. Enjoy → more free storage and a smoother everyday experience
PRIVACY FIRST
We designed this app to be privacy‑friendly:
- Processing happens on your device
- No photo/video/contact content is uploaded for scanning
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
- Plans: Weekly, Monthly, Yearly (some plans may include a 3‑day free trial).
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto‑renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Manage or cancel anytime in: Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.
Privacy Policy:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vRO0oAoTsnYRvkWdWt4neDQtv7f2YbtBuqP4oUUgEDp2_jXluvpsTptYv7RAjq_vC3NXr5CT-qdApWY/pub

Run your crew with one app. Supercrew clocks your crew in automatically, tracks the job site and gets payroll ready before you ask.
Time Tracking
- Automatic or manual clock in options.
- See travel time, route history and live location.

Crew Communications

Reporting & Costing
- Real-time labor costs by job, crew and worker.
- Set budgets and catch jobs before they run over.

bluejetty:00115426:ios.summary:

Step into the colorful world of Yarn Quest 3D, where matching fuzzy yarn patches becomes a delightful art form. In this soothing wool-themed puzzle adventure, your mission is simple yet sati
bluejetty:00115426:ios.description:
Yarn Quest 3D – A Cozy, Vibrant Puzzle Adventure!
Step into the colorful world of Yarn Quest 3D, where matching fuzzy yarn patches becomes a delightful art form. In this soothing wool-themed puzzle adventure, your mission is simple yet satisfying: align three yarn pieces of the same hue to fill up yarn boxes and reveal beautifully crafted 3D creations made entirely from colorful threads.
Every stage unveils a charming new yarn sculpture—whether it’s adorable animals, mouth-watering treats, or familiar everyday objects. And here’s the special twist—once you’ve unraveled the final threads and matched every color, all those yarn pieces come together to form a stunning woolen picture as your reward, making each victory both satisfying and beautiful.
HOW TO PLAY
- Tap on yarn pieces embedded in the 3D model.
- Match three of the same color to complete a yarn box.
- Remove every thread from the sculpture to unlock the next challenge.
- Watch as the completed yarn colors at the end combine into a vibrant woolen artwork.
FEATURES
- Gorgeous 3D models woven entirely from vibrant yarn.
- Intuitive gameplay that’s easy to pick up, yet deep enough for puzzle fans.
- A delightful mix of match-3 mechanics, sorting puzzles, and visual relaxation.
- Smooth animations and cozy textures inspired by knitting and fiber art.
- Perfect for quick breaks or longer unwind sessions.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE YARN QUEST 3D
- Combines the warmth of yarn crafting with clever, relaxing puzzles.
- Perfect for fans of brain-teasers, sorting games, and knit-style visuals.
- Progress through hundreds of levels for endless yarn-filled satisfaction.
- Suitable for all ages—simple to start, impossible to put down.
- Whether you’re seeking a stress-free escape, sharpening your planning skills, or simply craving the tactile joy of sorting soft yarn, Yarn Quest 3D offers a soothing yet addictive experience. It’s the perfect companion for coffee breaks, bedtime relaxation, or any moment you want a cozy getaway.
DOWNLOAD NOW and let the yarn-tastic fun begin!

bluejetty:00154727:ios.description:
“Big Day–The Countdown Clock” transforms your anticipation for every significant life event into an exhilarating countdown journey. Our Event Life Timer-Counter Clock is the epitome of precision and personalization, making sure you revel in the buildup to every special moment, from my love relationship countdowns to beach holiday adventures.
Exceptional Features:
• Comprehensive Countdowns: Centralize your life’s landmarks with our app—from every vacation countdown to each holiday milestone.
• Versatile Timer: Not just a day countdown, but also hours, minutes, and seconds. Perfect for every holiday inn stay or event countdown pro.
Customizable Visuals: Choose background images from our curated selection, your Photo Album, or snap a fresh one with your Camera. Ideal for remembering those special moments.
• Personalized Countdown Timer: Tailor your event countdowns with customized visuals, and celebrate progress with our unique countdown.app.
• Repeating Alerts: Never miss an anniversary or a weekly meeting with our repeating alerts, perfect for those recurring special moments. Set your countdowns to repeat in any pattern—ideal for recurring events like anniversary dates or weekly meetings at the holiday inn.
• Multiple Alerts: Stay informed with up to five reminders for each countdown, ensuring you’re always on track, be it for next holiday’s prep or your event time management.

Subscription options

bluejetty:00087552:ios.name: Frequency: Sound Generator
bluejetty:00087552:ios.summary: Are you producing? Want to sound test your speakers or tune your instruments? Or simply, do you want to generate sounds and listen to the generated sounds in different frequencies? Well, then you need a frequency sound generator to produce
bluejetty:00087552:ios.description:
Are you producing? Want to sound test your speakers or tune your instruments? Or simply, do you want to generate sounds and listen to the generated sounds in different frequencies? Well, then you need a frequency sound generator to produce sound waves in different frequencies. Introducing Frequency Sound Generator!
Frequency: Generator Sound player lets you generate a sine, square, sawtooth or triangle sound wave with a frequency between 1Hz and 22000Hz (Hertz). It produces accurate tone & soundwaves while being simple and easy to use. Additionally, pick from a wide variety of notes by taping the notes icon.
No matter if you need to sound test and generate high frequency sounds or low frequency sounds, our frequency tone generator is your #1 best solution.
EASY CONTROL
Frequency: Sound Generator allows you to easily change the soundwaves from the main menu. Simply tap on the sound wave icon and pick between sine, square, sawtooth or triangle. 
ANIMATED SOUND WAVE
You’ll love the animated sound wave function which visually represents the sound for a given frequency. You can change waveform by clicking on a round button at the left side and get a different sound and animated wave.
ADJUST FREQUENCY & VOLUME
Adjust the sound generating frequency easily by dragging the yellow dot. Make use of the - & + buttons for added adjusting precision. Additionally, control the volume of the generated sounds from 0-100%.
NUMEROUS USES:
This sound generating app can be used in multiple use cases:
- Test your hearing. 
A human being is capable of hearing frequencies in the average range of 20Hz-20000Hz. This range is getting smaller by age, so it’s interesting to sound test your hearing capabilities.
- Test speakers and headphones for the high end (treble) and low end (bass) tones.
- Use this app as an instrument tuner when playing or producing.
- Cleaning water from the speaker. Since sound is making small vibrations it can help to shake off unwanted water from your speakers.
- Find your tinnitus frequency.
NOTE: Since mobile phones are not high-quality audio sources and in-built speakers may vary in quality, sometimes users can hear sounds at very low or high frequencies even beyond the scope of human hearing. That noise is not sound of a given frequency but static or “parasite” noise generated by your mobile device. For the best experience use a pair of good quality headphones.

bluejetty:00142778:ios.description:
Create Your Own Atmosphere with Soundscaper
Build personalized soundscapes for sleep, focus, meditation, yoga, or a quiet moment in your day. Explore a growing library of over 100 sounds, from gentle rain and ocean waves to forest ambience, instruments, animals, white noise, pink noise, and brown noise.
Make Every Sound Your Own
Combine sounds and adjust their individual volumes to create an atmosphere that suits you. Fine-tune start delays, repetitions, and pauses. Change playback speed and pitch, and position sounds in 3D space for a more immersive listening experience.
Create Your Own Thunderstorm
Add a customizable thunderstorm to your mix. Adjust thunder frequency and distance, or vary the distance randomly. Enable optional flashlight effects and haptic feedback on supported devices. Save your thunder settings as part of your soundscape.
Set a Sleep Timer
Let your soundscape accompany you as you unwind or concentrate, then pause playback automatically when the timer ends.
Save, Edit, and Sync
Save your favorite combinations and return to them whenever you like. Edit existing soundscapes, adjust their sounds and settings, and sync your saved creations across your devices using iCloud.
Fit Soundscaper into Your Routine
Use Siri and Shortcuts to play or pause your current sounds.
Discover More Sounds
The sound library keeps growing, bringing new ways to shape your atmosphere and explore different combinations.
Unlock More with Premium
Start with a selection of free sounds and a timer of up to 10 minutes. Premium unlocks all currently available sounds, saving and editing your own soundscapes, iCloud sync, 3D positioning, longer timers, and expanded thunderstorm settings. Choose a one-time purchase or an optional subscription.
Download Soundscaper and create an atmosphere that feels right for you.
Terms of Service: https://gw-solutions.de/TermsOfServiceENG/

🎮🌌 Dive into “Pocket Necro”, a dynamic action-packed RPG game set in a whimsical modern-day fantasy world. 

Your mission? To crush the demonic hordes and defend your territory. Choose your skills wisely, summon your loyal minions, and prepare for a humorous yet thrilling adventure!​

👹 Crush Demons
Ready your weapons and strategic skills to face waves of demons. From fiery imps to colossal fiends, each battle is a test of your tactical prowess and determination to protect your realm.​

🧙‍♂️ Summon Your Minions
Assemble a diverse army of minions, each with unique abilities and personalities. From spell-casting mages to sturdy skeletal knights, select your squad and lead them into battle against encroaching evil forces.​

🛡️ Defend Your Castle
Your mansion isn't just your home; it's your fortress. Ward off the most powerful demons and protect your sanctum from being overrun.​

🔄 Progress & Choose Your Skills 
Progress through an engaging storyline filled with challenges and rewards. As you advance, choose from a broad range of skills to enhance your strategies and strengthen your minions.​

⚙️ Upgrade Your Arsenal
Invest in your arsenal and empower your minions with superior weapons and magical artifacts. Each upgrade enhances your team's fighting abilities, crucial for surviving tougher foes.​

🌍 Explore Various Environments
Journey through enchanted forests, shadowy caves, and mystical landscapes plagued by demonic entities. Each environment offers unique strategic challenges and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.​

👾 Battle Various Monsters and Demons
Face a plethora of monstrous creatures and vile demons in epic battles. Learn their weaknesses, devise counterstrategies, and lead your minions to victory in each encounter.​

🌟 Engaging RPG elements mixed with strategy and action.

• Extensive Question Bank: Access over 200 practice questions covering all topics from the MTO handbook, ensuring thorough preparation.

• Progress Tracking: Easily monitor your progress, including tests in progress, tests passed, and tests needing a retry, empowering you to track your journey to success.

• User-Friendly Experience: Enjoy a seamless studying experience with no registration required and no distracting ads, enabling full concentration on your preparation.

Download G1 Driver’s Test 2026 now and ace your Ontario G1 Driver’s License Knowledge Test with ease. Start your journey towards becoming a safe and responsible driver today.
For feedback, questions, or bug reports, contact us at driverstestapp@gmail.com.

bluejetty:00142861:android.description:
Please note before downloading: the Digital iD app service will be closing on April 30, 2026.
Australia Post regularly reviews its products and services to align with changing customer preferences
and behaviours.
Following a strategic review, Australia Post has decided to exit its Digital iD service.
- 
Imagine using your phone to securely prove who you are when you need to. No need to carry your wallet with you to get into a participating bar. You, your phone and the tap of a button. That’s Digital iD™ by Australia Post. 
Use Digital iD™ to prove you’re over 18^, and for everyday tasks like collecting items from the Post Office. Use Digital iD™ online for redirecting mail, applying for a police check or opening a bank account with participating organisations, and more. Anyone living, studying or working in Australia can use it as proof of identity.
If you’re 18 or older, you can get a free Keypass in Digital iD™ that you can use to enter licensed venues or purchase alcohol in select States and Territories^.
Find out more at DigitaliD.com or contact us at help@digitalid.com with any comments or suggestions.
^Keypass in Digital iD™ is accepted as proof of age to enter participating licensed venues and to purchase alcohol in Vic, Tas, Qld, ACT and NT (excluding takeaway alcohol in NT).
Please note that dark mode is not available at this time, please turn on greyscale as a vision enhancement in your settings to help with light-sensitivity issues.
Due to legislation, you must be at least 15 years old to use the Digital iD™ app.

bluejetty:00177066:ios.name: Mood-Tracker
bluejetty:00177066:ios.summary:
Why don't you record your daily mood and grasp the change in your mood?
This app is an app that allows you to easily record your current mood.
Simply scroll or tap the arrows to select your mood on the home screen and tap the Save button
bluejetty:00177066:ios.description:
Why don't you record your daily mood and grasp the change in your mood?
This app is an app that allows you to easily record your current mood.
Simply scroll or tap the arrows to select your mood on the home screen and tap the Save button to record your current mood.
If you fill in the situation and reason at that time in the memo column, you can save it according to your mood.
On the "Yearly" screen, the average daily mood is displayed in a list.
On the "History" screen, the mood recorded on the date selected in the calendar is displayed. You can also modify the data with the edit button on the top right of the data. In addition, you can add data that you forgot to record with the "Add" button.
On the "Analytics" screen, you can view graphs of changes in mood over the week, month, and year.
On the "Settings" screen, you can set the first day of the week for the calendar. You can choose to start Monday or Sunday.
In the free version, you can check the history for up to one week. If you want to check all the history, please consider purchasing the premium version in the app.
----------------------

bluejetty:00084912:ios.description:
Welcome to Sri Mandir – India’s Largest Devotional Platform!
Sri Mandir App is the most trusted destination that serves the devotional needs of millions of devotees in India and abroad. Connect with over 100 temples across India, participate in pujas, offer goods (Chadhava) as part of the rituals, and access a wealth of free devotional content - all in one place from the comfort and convenience of your home.
With the Sri Mandir App, you can:
- Set up your own temple and receive blessings anytime, anywhere
- Offer online Chadhava to 100+ famous temples in your name
- Participate in online pujas performed through Vedic Rituals in your name and gotra
- Listen to the melodies of Chalisa, Bhajans, Aartis, and more
Key Features:
Participate in Online Pujas for Peace, Prosperity & Overall Well-Being.
Sri Mandir Puja Seva connects devotees to top sacred temples across India, allowing them to participate in pujas online in their name and gotra and providing the access they have always wanted.
After booking a Puja with Sri Mandir:
- You will receive mantras to chant during the Puja
- Panditji will perform the Puja in your name and Gotra according to Vedic rituals
- A video of the Puja will be shared with you
- Sacred tirth prasad will be delivered to your doorstep.
Top Pujas on Sri Mandir:
- Hanuman Chalisa Path
- Bagalamukhi Puja
- Mahalakshmi Puja
- 10 Mahavidya Puja
- Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga Puja
- Manglik Dosha Nivaran Puja
- Kaal Sarp Dosha Shanti Puja
- Pitru Dosha Nivaran Puja
- Shani Saade Sati Peeda Shanti Mahapuja 
- Rahu-Ketu Peeda Shanti Puja
Offer Online Chadhava to 100+ Top sacred temples:
Experience the divine with Sri Mandir Chadhava Seva. Offer goods (Chadhava) at renowned temples across India, receiving blessings and a video recording of the rituals performed by our Purohit ji on your behalf.
With Chadhava Seva you can:
- Make offerings at the famous Temples, Jyotirlingas and Shaktipeeths
- Chadhava will be offered with proper Vedic rituals on your behalf
- Your name will be taken by Pandit ji while offering Chadhava
- Certificate and Video of your Chadhava experience will be shared with you
You can offer Chadhava at sacred places like:
- Hanumangarhi, Ayodhya
- Shani Shingnapur, Maharashtra
- Trimbakeshwar Jyotirling, Nashik
- Omkareshwar Jyotirling, Madhya Pradesh
- Shaktipeeth Mahalaxmi (Ambabai) Mandir, Kolhapur
- Mangalagauri Shaktipeeth, Gaya
- Bada Ganesh Mandir, Ujjain
- Pashupatinath Mahadev Mandir, Haridwar
- Navgrah Shani Mandir
Why Choose Sri Mandir App?
- Access 100+ temples across India at your fingertips
- Trusted by 40M+ devotees across 30+ countries
- Secure and verified platform for all your devotional needs
FAQs:
- When will my offerings be made?
We partner with top temples to fulfill offerings within 1-2 days
- When will I receive my Puja/Chadhava video? 
You can expect your video within 3-5 days, showcasing the rituals performed on your behalf
Download the Sri Mandir App now and start your devotional journey! 
With Sri Mandir App, you can participate in pujas, offer goods (Chadhava) on occasions like Ganesh Chaturthi, Pitru Paksha, Navratri, Amavasya, Purnima, Ekadashi, Kalashtami, Kali Chaudas, Dussehra, Karva Chauth, Diwali (Deepavali), Tulsi Vivah, Chhath Puja, Sankranti (Makar Sankranti)

bluejetty:00128923:ios.description:
The best and most reliable app to stay anonymous and private on the web!
Onion is a Tor-powered browser that lets you access the Internet privately, anonymously and secure from your iOS device. 
Using the Tor network, Onion hides your real IP address and gives you the ability to browse all sides of the Internet without revealing you identity. 
Features:
• Internet access tunneled over the Tor network
• Websites do not see your real IP address 
• Change IP address with a tap
• User agent spoofing
• Clear cookies, history and cache automatically 
• Block third party cookies or all cookies
• Block scripts and content that can be used for tracking (DNT headers)
• Tor bridges configuration
Important note:
• Web browsing through Tor anonymization network is significantly slower than a non-tunneled browser. This is a small price to pay to keep your identity safe & protected. 
• This product uses the Tor distributed networks, is produced independently from the Tor(r) anonymity software and carries no guarantee from The Tor Project about quality, suitability or anything else.

bluejetty:00167048:ios.summary: Dive deeper into the world of magic and mystery with the free-to-play version of the "Twin Mind: The Deathly Trick" detective hidden object games! Experience a gripping tale of hidden objects mystery crimes where you'll play as the famous t
bluejetty:00167048:ios.description:
Dive deeper into the world of magic and mystery with the free-to-play version of the "Twin Mind: The Deathly Trick" detective hidden object games! Experience a gripping tale of hidden objects mystery crimes where you'll play as the famous twin detectives known for solving the most perplexing mystical riddles and crime mysteries. Investigate the suspicious deaths of two magicians to uncover whether these were mere accidents or part of a darker plot. Enjoy a variety of casual games, mystery hidden object games and complex brain teasers, lead your own crime investigation and uncover the secrets that lie behind the curtain!
Magicians often take staggering risks while on stage just to capture the undivided attention and admiration of their audiences. In fact, if a magician dies during a performance, it gets more media coverage than if one of them achieves worldwide fame! So when the press announces the deaths of two prominent figures in the world of magic in the space of a week, the voice in your head starts telling you this is not an accident. If it weren't so tragic, the circumstances of the victims' deaths would be almost comical – Neptune drowned, and Golden Dragon's armor was pierced by his own arrow. But whatever is the case - It is up to you to find out what really happened.
· DYNAMIC DUO!
Play as the renowned twin detectives, each with unique skills that complement the other. Leverage their distinct abilities to solve complex puzzles, find hidden objects and crack the criminal case!
· INTRICATE PUZZLES!
Engage in a variety of challenging puzzles and mini-games that will test your logic and problem-solving skills. Perfect for enthusiasts of detective hidden object games, each puzzle brings you closer to solving the haunting riddles of the magic world!
· INTERACTIVE GAMEPLAY!
Make choices that influence the outcome of your crime investigation, a unique feature for fans of mystery hidden object games and crime solving games. With multiple endings available, your decisions will shape the resolution of these unnerving events!
· COLLECTIBLES!
Explore detailed locations from dressing rooms to backstage areas, gather clues and search for crime mysteries that will aid your crime investigation. Keep an eye out for numerous collectible items scattered throughout the crime detective game. Collecting these items can provide deeper insights into the world of magic and show business!
Join the free-to-play version of the "Twin Mind: The Deathly Trick" detective hidden object games to explore shadowy corners of showbiz right now!
-----

bluejetty:00027125:ios.description:
Route planning
The main functionality is planning routes leading along official hiking trails in the mountains and foothills of Poland. The app finds a route quick and easy, displays it on a map, shows its length, estimated time, detailed course and elevation profile. It also shows your current location.
Routes are displayed on detailed Touristic map layer with contours and terrain shading, which contains peaks, passes, parkings and other points of interest. It's also possible to download maps of regions listed further in this description and use them offline.
Tracks recording
Second main functionality is recording tracks. You can then share it with your friends!
Interesting places
The app also displays information about points of interest: photos and opinions taken from the mapa-turystyczna.pl website. 
Detailed functionalities:
 - planning routes based on given points; points can be chosen from map or found using the search box, 
 - intelligent search suggestions, considering spots closest to your location and those most popular, 
 - displaying routes on a map along with their length, estimated time, route details (spots and trails) and elevation profile, 
 - information about impediments on route,
 - GOT points for planned route,
 - showing your current location on the map, 
 - compass,
 - track recording, showing elapsing distance and time,
 - list of recorded tracks, 
 - searching for places and showing them on the map, 
 - displaying information about places your searched for: photos and opinions taken from mapa-turystyczna.pl website,
 - navigation on planned route,
 - detailed touristic maps layer, also available for download.

bluejetty:00180192:ios.description:
Protect visuals with Custom Watermarks, Digital Signatures, Timestamps, Logo, Stickers & QR Code!
Photographers often rely on a brand watermark app to maintain ownership of their visual content. With eZy Watermark Photos, you can easily add professional watermarks, add text, create signature watermarks, apply digital signatures, add watermark logos, write on photos, add copyright watermarks, camera images, trademarks, stickers, and emojis as watermark stamps - all without losing image resolution or ruining the original aesthetic. It’s quick and simple, mark your content and keep it truly yours.
Manually adding watermarks to multiple photos is time-consuming, and keeping the same style or logo on all of them is almost impossible. We help you batch watermark photos in one go with fast and professional results.
A professional watermark tool designed for photographers, businesses, artists, influencers, and creators. eZy Watermark Photos editor adjusts image resolution, overlays photos with brand logo watermarks, and protects images from unauthorized use.
Perfect for image protection, posters, flyers, and banners with custom watermarking for your business.
Features:
ADD WATERMARK TO PHOTOS:
Protect images online by adding a customized watermark to photos. Personalize to add text on photos, put QR codes, digitally sign your photos, add logos, add watermark picture, date stamp on photo, add label on photos, timestamps, and copyright stamp on a photograph.
SINGLE AND BATCH PROCESSING:
Watermark photo editor processes single images and upto five images in batch photo editor, all within seconds. You can easily add text to photos in bulk and in single mode. Save time with batch watermarking — batch watermark photos in seconds, perfect for creators on the go.
CUSTOMIZED WATERMARKS:
You can easily adjust opacity, rotation, size, position, and placements of your watermarks. Customize text watermarks with your own fonts, colors, and styles to give them a personal touch and make your photos truly yours.
AI POWERED TEMPLATES:
Powered by AI, eZy Watermark introduces adaptive templates that intelligently adjust watermarks across images, delivering a consistent and refined batch watermarking experience.
CLOUD-SYNCED TEMPLATES:
All templates are securely synced to the cloud, ensuring they are always up to date and available wherever you need them.
CREATE AND SAVE WATERMARK TEMPLATES:
You can create your own watermark templates and save them for later, so you don’t have to start from scratch every time. Just create a template once; your logo, text, style, everything and reuse it whenever you need to add custom watermarks to your photos.
PREVIEW, CROP, AND RESIZE PHOTOS:
You can preview the image before processing watermarks, cropping and resizing photos, adjusting size to different ratios, applying rotation to align the photo, and applying filters on images, and then create a watermark on photo.
TILE WATERMARKS:
Apply your watermark in a repeated pattern across the entire photo for stronger protection and professional-looking results.
SNAP TO GRID:
Easily place your watermark exactly where you want it. Our grid snapping feature helps you align it perfectly, giving your photos a consistent and professional look.
IMPORT & EXPORT WATERMARK PICTURES:
We make it easy to import photos from your camera, library, or capture a new picture directly from camera. Save your edited images with stylish watermarks to your gallery or share them instantly on Instagram, Pinterest, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, or Google Drive! Whether you are sharing product photos or travel shots, your content stays yours.
MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT:
eZy Watermark Photos is available in many languages, including Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish, so everyone can use it easily.
Add or create watermark to protect your images and keep your visuals safe from unauthorized use.
T&C: https://www.ezywatermark.com/terms

MyFLO® is uniquely tailored to support
bluejetty:00161715:ios.description:
MyFLO®: the official Cycle Syncing® app & period tracker designed by Alisa Vitti, the creator of the Cycle Syncing® method, best-selling author of WomanCode and In the FLO, and founder of FLO Living.
MyFLO® is uniquely tailored to support your hormonal health from your first period to your last, empowering you to sync your life with your cycle phases and address your symptoms naturally. 
Backed by science and founded and led by women, MyFLO’s patented algorithm provides comprehensive tracking for period start date and length, flow intensity, PMS symptoms, predicts ovulation and fertile window & supports cycle syncing.
Your health data will never be sold or disclosed. 
With MyFLO, you can:
• Gain profound understanding of your menstrual health and how to optimize it
• Enhance fertility and anticipate menstrual cycles with precision
• Mitigate perimenopausal changes and harmonize your mood with your cycle
• Access dietary and exercise recommendations that evolve with you throughout the four phases of your cycle
• Unlock the power of your unique brain and body strengths with our personalized Cycle Syncing® feature
CYCLE & PERIOD TRACKER
• Manage your cycle, an essential biomarker of your health:
• A period and ovulation tracker that adjusts to your unique cycle 
• Track symptoms daily to understand hormonal issues and patterns 
• Track your ovulation predictions and fertile window 
CYCLE SYNCING®
The official Cycle Syncing® app built by the creator of the method, Alisa Vitti. 
• Understand your hormones in real time, in each phase
• Access your personal Cycle Syncing® planner 
• Sync your diet to your cycle with recipes & ingredients
• Sync your fitness to your cycle with workout videos & exercise guidance
• Sync your productivity & relationships with your cycle phases
HEALTH EVALUATION & PERSONALIZED GUIDANCE
• Evaluate your cycle health and receive functional health based guidance to help you restore hormonal balance naturally.
• Evaluate your symptoms and understand the root causes of your hormone issues
• Get a personalized care plan to manage your symptoms
• Customized functional health tips to help
• Naturally address conditions like PCOS, endometriosis, PMS, PMDD, fertility issues & perimenopause
MyFLO helps with:
• PCOS
• Endometriosis
• Ovulation
• PMS
• PMDD
• Fertility
• Missing Periods
• Fibroids
• Mood Swings
• Low Sex Drive
• Perimenopause
• Acne
• Bloating
• Fatigue
• Cycle Syncing®
ABOUT US
FLO Living is a hormonal health company that provides digital therapeutics and supplements to help women feel their best. FLO Living has helped millions of women with their cycle, fertility, and perimenopause journeys.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
• MyFLO offers a subscription plan for the Cycle Syncing® membership for $28/mo or $280/year
• Upon purchase, your account will automatically be charged
• Cancel your subscription by navigation to your account and tapping “Manage Subscription”
• Your subscription will be active until the billing cycle ends
For more info: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
PRIVACY PROTECTION
• Erase all your data at any time. 
Privacy Policy: https://www.floliving.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.floliving.com/terms-of-service
MyFLO app is not a diagnostic tool or MyFLO’s predictions should not be used as a form of birth control/contraception. MyFLO app is not a substitute for medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
SUPPORT: support@floliving.com
CUSTOMER LOVE
“MyFLO is worlds better! I quit using other apps because they didn't offer much more than complicated graphs.”
“MyFLO is such a great resource. Other apps I've tried make it hard to sync your actual cycle”
DOCTOR APPROVED
“The Cycle Syncing® Method is an effective way for women to align with their biological rhythms to optimize not only their health, but every other aspect of their lives.” - Dr. Mark Hyman
“Living in alignment with our cycle is the next frontier for women’s health.” - Dr. Aviva Romm

bluejetty:00069812:ios.description:
The Edmonton Sun is your trusted source for local news, politics, sports and entertainment. Create your custom feed so you don’t miss the latest from your favourite writers. Stay up to date throughout the day with breaking news in Edmonton, Alberta and around the world. Plus get the latest on the Edmonton Oilers and the Edmonton Elks with the best sports coverage in Canada including scores, standings, highlights and commentary.
Features include:
• Stay connected to the best local news, sports, entertainment, commentary and beyond.
• Browse the Toronto Sun, Ottawa Sun, Edmonton Sun, Calgary Sun, The Province and Canoe brands seamlessly.
• You will be prompted to choose your preferred publications when you first open the new app, ensuring a curated news feed that aligns with your interests.
• Use the Discover tab to explore trending stories from Postmedia newsrooms across Canada
• Personalize your news experience by selecting topics, journalists and columnists you care about, so your feed will be filled with the content and perspectives you enjoy.
• As a registered user, you are recognized consistently across web and app platforms for a more cohesive experience.
Register to sample the wide variety of breaking news and special features — plus extensive photo and video coverage. Home delivery print subscribers receive unlimited access, included as part of their print subscription and can gain access by simply signing in with their existing account when prompted. If you’re not an existing print subscriber, you can easily subscribe to the app through the App Store for iOS devices.
Subscription details
• Monthly subscription cost: $5.99 plus applicable taxes
• Complete your subscription at the App Store for iOS devices. Payment will be charged to your account upon confirmation of purchase. 
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. 
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
• Account will be charged $5.99 each month within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
• Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. 
Privacy policy: https://www.postmedia.com/privacy-statement/
Terms of use: https://www.postmedia.com/terms-and-conditions/
We appreciate and value your feedback. Please send any comments, suggestions or questions to: appfeedback@postmedia.com

bluejetty:00087002:ios.description:
Sgcarmart.com is Singapore's Number 1 car site. With almost 20,000 car listings, it offers the largest database of new and used cars for sale in Singapore. Sgcarmart.com attracts more than 2.6 million million visitors every month and as a testament to its popularity, it has been awarded the Most Popular Automotive Site in its category for six years running by Hitwise.
Sgcarmart.com is filled with all the essential information for both car buyers and owners. With diverse competencies of focus, it caters to different people with different aspects of motoring needs.
1. New Cars - With prices updated twice every month, this section contains the latest information on all new car models available in the market. The information depicts detailed description for all new car models and provides car buyers with a very convenient way to compare and choose their ideal car model and price.
With pricelists from authorised distributors and parallel importers made available for print, Sgcarmart.com makes car buying decisions a breeze. Additionally, the site has a built-in search engine that assists car buyers in narrowing down their search. This saves them the hassle and time of viewing hundreds of cars.
2. Used Cars - Complete with photos and pricing, Sgcarmart.com possesses the largest and most comprehensive database of used cars in Singapore. It also provides daily updates of listings of all major used car dealers and their current car lists.
3. Articles - This section aims to provide value-added services for users to make a more informed and intelligent buying decision. The inclusion of key features such as updated automotive global news, carpark rates for all major zones in Singapore and updated COE results allows users as well as car buyers and owners to gain useful information. Furthermore, our editorial team provides car reviews of the latest and most popular cars in the market to allow users to have a better understanding of the cars.
4. Motor Directory - Designed with the objective of being a one-stop car-related merchant directory for users, this section contains listings of motoring-related merchants from over 42 categories. Of which, full contact details as well as their products and services are made easily accessible.

bluejetty:00135120:ios.name: Morse Mania: Learn Morse Code
bluejetty:00135120:ios.summary: In both the receiving and sending modes, the app starts with the easiest letters (E and T) and moves to more complicated ones. Once you master all the letters, it teaches you numbers and other symbols, and then proceeds to Prosigns, Q-codes
bluejetty:00135120:ios.description:
In both the receiving and sending modes, the app starts with the easiest letters (E and T) and moves to more complicated ones. Once you master all the letters, it teaches you numbers and other symbols, and then proceeds to Prosigns, Q-codes, abbreviations, words, Callsigns, phrases and sentences.
----------------------------
Features:
- 135 levels teach you to recognize (receive) 26 Latin letters, numbers, 18 punctuation marks, 20 non-Latin extensions, procedure signs (prosigns), Q-codes, most popular abbreviations, words, callsigns, phrases and sentences.
- Another 135 levels teach and train you to send the Morse code.
- 5 output modes: audio (default), blinking light, flashlight, vibration and light + sound.
- 7 different keys for sending Morse code (e.g. iambic key).
- 52 challenge levels test and consolidate your knowledge.
- Custom level: create your own level to practice symbols of your choice. Save your own list of symbols and load anytime.
- NEW! “Playground” to test and train your Morse code sending skills. 
- Smart learning: custom level choice is pre-populated with symbols where you made the mistakes most recently.
- Support for external keyboard.
- Hints (for free!) when you need help.
- Explore mode: if you want to hear the symbols, or see a list of prosigns, Q-codes & other abbreviations and hear their sound representation.
- 4 themes to choose from, from bright to dark.
- 9 different keyboard layouts: QWERTY, AZERTY, QWERTZ, ABCDEF, Dvorak, Colemak, Maltron, Workman, Halmak.
- Randomize letter/symbol positions for each level (to ensure you're not just learning the position of the symbols on the keyboard).
- Absolutely no ads.
- Works completely offline.
----------------------------
Completely customize the app:
- Adjustable speed: from 5 to 45 WPM (words per minute). Less than 20 is not recommended though, as it doesn't help you to actually learn the language.
- Adjustable sound frequency: 400 to 1000 Hz.
- Adjustable Farnsworth speed: from 5 to 45 WPM. Determines how long are the spaces between letters.
- Adjustable difficulty level for sending the Morse code.
- Disable/enable the progress circle in Settings.
- Settings for progress speed, review time, time pressure and lives in challenges.
- Setting for background noise: to better support some Bluetooth earphones that keep disconnecting from the phone while you play, or just to make it more challenging.
- Ability to jump to the past levels to revise, or skip some if you're already familiar with certain characters.
- Ability to reset mistakes and levels.
----------------------------
Read our dedicated blog posts to get the most out of the game.
Have any comments, questions or advice? Don't hesitate to email us, we'll reply right away!
----------------------------
Links:
- Privacy Policy: http://morse.countrymania.net/privacy
- Terms of Use: http://morse.countrymania.net/tos
Have fun learning!
