bluejetty:00166037:ios.description:
The Bitcoin financial platform built on self custody.
Trusted by nearly 2 million users and featured in Yahoo Finance, Nasdaq, and CoinDesk.
Earn yield, borrow against your bitcoin, and spend your coins without selling. Send and receive money globally. Your keys stay in your control. Onchain finance. No permission required.
SECURE. PRIVATE. SELF CUSTODY.
Full self custody. You control your private keys. Xverse never has access to your funds.
Connect your Ledger or Keystone hardware wallet. Keep your keys offline. Manage your portfolio with the speed of a digital bank.
- Hardware wallet support including Ledger and Keystone
- Biometric authentication on mobile
- Import existing wallets in seconds
- Open source and independently audited by leading security firms
No custodians. No account freezes. No withdrawal limits. No credit checks. Your coins. Your control.
SEND AND RECEIVE MONEY GLOBALLY
Pay anyone, anywhere. Send bitcoin and stablecoins instantly using Lightning. Transfer money across Bitcoin layers including Starknet, Stacks, and Spark with near-zero fees.
- Send and receive bitcoin and stablecoin payments
- Pay instantly using Lightning
- Global money transfer with no intermediaries
- Buy bitcoin and supported assets directly in-app
- Swap tokens or bridge assets across chains
Everyday payments. Cross-border capital. You stay in control.
EARN YIELD AND GROW YOUR BITCOIN
Your coins should be working. Stake, lend, and earn interest on your bitcoin and stablecoins.
- Stake STX and earn BTC rewards paid directly to your wallet
- Earn interest on stablecoins including USDC through secure lending
- Access bitcoin-backed yield opportunities including WBTC staking
- High yield onchain strategies
- Browse and earn directly in-app
Every coin works harder. You stay in control.
BORROW AGAINST YOUR BITCOIN
Get cash without selling your coins. Take out bitcoin-backed loans and keep your position.
- Borrow money against your BTC with no credit checks
- Bitcoin-backed loans with no intermediaries
- Access stablecoin liquidity instantly
- Keep your coins. Never sell.
The old way: sell your bitcoin, lose your position, trigger a tax event. The new way: borrow against it and pay it back on your terms.
SPEND YOUR CRYPTO
Spend globally while your bitcoin and stablecoins keep generating yield.
- Spend bitcoin and stablecoins globally
- Pay with Lightning for instant settlement
- The Xverse bitcoin card is coming soon. Your onchain balance, connected to everyday spending.
Your money. Onchain. No bank required.
YOUR STABLECOINS. YOUR SAVINGS.
Stablecoins built for payments, savings, and yield.
- Store stablecoins including USDB, USDC, and USDCx
- Earn interest on your savings with no lock-ups
- Send stablecoin payments globally, anytime
- Use stablecoins as digital cash for everyday spending
- Connect your US bank account to deposit and buy directly
Global finance. Bitcoin-grade security. One platform.
THE BITCOIN ECONOMY. ONE SCREEN.
Manage your full onchain portfolio in a single unified view.
- Bitcoin (BTC)
- Stablecoins
- Stacks (STX) and sBTC
- Starknet and Spark assets
- Bitcoin Layer 2 tokens
- Ordinals, Runes, and Bitcoin-native assets
Available in English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Korean, Japanese, German, Portuguese, French, Turkish, and Russian.
Download Xverse and put your bitcoin to work.

bluejetty:00040628:ios.description:
Master Japanese with Bunpro!
Bunpro is a dynamic tool for learning Japanese that combines expert guidance with an engaging, learner-focused experience. The platform is designed for users of all levels, from those just starting with Hiragana & Katakana, to those who have already passed a JLPT exam. Bunpro offers meticulously crafted lessons, personalized reviews, and interactive practice that empower you to navigate Japanese grammar and vocabulary with confidence and ease.

* 25 JLPT practice tests with full offline support
* Content-Rich Curriculum: Explore over 900 grammar points to learn, each with a hand-crafted explanation to deepen your understanding.
* Diverse Vocabulary Decks: Learn from countless Decks featuring content from anime, manga, textbooks, and more — making vocabulary learning engaging and immersion easier. 
* Rich Example Sentences: Immerse yourself in our vast library of 100k+ hand written example sentences that are crafted to showcase unique nuances of the language, all with audio recordings to deepen immersion/studying!
* Smart SRS Reviews: Retain what you learn with our intelligent spaced repetition system that adapts to your progress.
* Interactive Practice: If your answer is incorrect or nearly correct, our system instantly provides targeted feedback to pinpoint your mistakes to help make things as clear as possible.
* Progress Tracking: Stay motivated with detailed stats, streaks, and goal-setting features as you advance toward fluency.
Embark on your journey to Japanese fluency today — risk-free! Enjoy a one-month free trial to explore all of Bunpro’s features and see the difference it makes in your learning. Download now and experience the most engaging way to master Japanese grammar and vocabulary!

bluejetty:00150279:ios.description:
You know exactly what you should be doing right now. So does your phone - and it's betting you'll check it anyway. Jolt is built for people who are done losing that bet.
——
KNOW IF YOU'RE ACTUALLY IMPROVING
Attention Forecast - New Before your day starts, Jolt tells you how it's likely to go. One predictive score built from last night's sleep, your 28-day usage trend, your streak, and your blocking discipline.
Attention Score: One number. Every day. Your Focus, Sleep, and Discipline combined. It rises when all three do - it won't let one good habit carry the weight of two bad ones. Watch it over 7, 14, 30 days. The direction it moves is the most honest feedback you'll get.
Discipline Score: The gap between the limits you set and the limits you actually held. Not whether you blocked Instagram - whether you stayed blocked when it counted. Most people are surprised by this number. That's the point.
Focus Score: Most people think they're focused. The Focus Score measures whether they actually were - how much deep work you completed, how many sessions you finished without quitting, how little you touched your phone mid-session. The score doesn't round up.
Sleep Score: Your last pickup before bed. Your first reach in the morning. How many times you interrupted your own sleep. Tracked, scored, shown back to you every day.
——
SET LIMITS THAT ACTUALLY HOLD
Duration Limit: Daily time cap on any app - 30 minutes on Instagram, 20 on YouTube. When it hits, it locks. No snooze, no exceptions.
Open Limit: Cap how many times you open an app each day. Three opens on Twitter. Five on Reddit. Once you've hit the number, it's done.
Blocking Modes: Easy: a breathing pause before the app opens. Medium: rapid taps or a timed challenge - your brain earns the unlock. Hard: nothing gets through.
Hard Mode: Set it once. Can't edit, delete, or override it until the next day. Your morning self makes the rules. Your evening self lives with them.
——
FOCUS SESSIONS
Focus Flights - New: You don't start a timer anymore. You book a flight.
Pick a destination reachable in your focus window. Choose your seat: First Class seals the cabin - no early exit. Business puts a challenge between you and the door. Economy lets you tap out.
Board, take off, block your apps. Land and it logs as a completed flight. Quit early and it goes down as a crash - distance credited for how far you got. Every flight lives in your Flight Wallet.
Focus Sessions Block every distracting app for a set window - deep work, exam session, meeting hour. 20+ templates or build your own. Everything else disappears until you're done.
Quick Sessions: One tap. Immediate block. Zero setup. Focus right now, not after configuring anything.
——
CLOSE EVERY LOOPHOLE
Sleep Schedule: Set your bedtime and wake-up time. Every distracting app locks automatically. You choose which essentials stay on - everything else is off until morning, with full tracking of every pickup.
Accountability Partner: A real person who sees your screen time and must approve every override. Not an algorithm. A human who will actually push back.
GPS Blocking: Set your office, library, or gym. The moment you arrive, Jolt activates. The environment does what willpower can't.
Good Apps First: Use your journal, reading app, or workout tracker first. Once you do, the distracting apps unlock. Focus becomes the price of entry.
Block 18+ One toggle. Every adult site and app - off.
Shield Customisation - New: The screen that blocks you now looks how you want it. Choose a persona or build your own: custom text, colors, and icon. Turn on Randomized Experience, and it changes every time a block fires.
——
PRIVACY FIRST: All blocking runs locally via Apple's Screen Time API. No personal data leaves your device.
Download free. Block your first app in 30 seconds.
Support: hello@thejoltapp.com 
Terms: thejoltapp.com/terms & https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 
Privacy: thejoltapp.com/privacy

EMBARK ON A JOURNEY IN ELEMENTAL RAIDERS - A WORLD OF STRATEGIC BATTLES AND STUNNING VISUALS

bluejetty:00089478:ios.description:
EMBARK ON A JOURNEY IN ELEMENTAL RAIDERS - A WORLD OF STRATEGIC BATTLES AND STUNNING VISUALS
In this immersive 3D world, you'll assemble a formidable team, collect unique spells, and face off against adversaries in thrilling PvP battles and challenging single-player raids.
Key Features:
• Deep Tactical Gameplay: Engage in intense turn-based combat, where each decision has a strategic impact on the outcome of the battle. With accessible gameplay mechanics, you'll need to carefully select your heroes' spells and use them wisely to triumph over your foes.
• Thrilling PvP Arena: Prove your strategic prowess in the exciting PvP Arena, where you'll go head-to-head against other players in live battles. Rise through the ranks and unlock new heroes as you demonstrate your mastery of strategy and team building.
• Elemental Heroes: Command a diverse team of heroes, each hailing from the elements of Water, Fire, and Nature. Each hero possesses a unique set of spells, providing endless strategic combinations.
• Spell-Based Hero Customisation: Equip your heroes with over 135 unique spells, each with exclusive stats and attributes, to enhance their combat effectiveness. From Uncommon to Legendary, these spells enable heroes to adapt and overcome diverse challenges.
• Hero Aesthetics: Add a touch of uniqueness to your team with a variety of distinctive skins. These skins offer a way to style your heroes, adding an extra layer of individuality to your gameplay experience
• Single-Player Raids: Experience the thrill and challenge of single-player Raids. Engage in epic battles against the Evil Titans to earn powerful chests and unlock awe-inspiring new spells.
• Climb the Leaderboard: Ascend to the top by earning trophies and reap exclusive rewards like Chests and Rune Stones. Your journey through the realm of Elemental Raiders could lead you to become the greatest champion this world has ever seen.
• Made for Esports: For those seeking an extra challenge, participate in regular esports tournaments with massive rewards. Showcase your strategic skills on a grand stage and earn recognition for your prowess.
• Vibrant Community: Become part of the active Elemental Raiders community. Forge alliances, share strategies, and embark on thrilling adventures with fellow players around the globe.
PLEASE NOTE! Elemental Raiders is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.
If you are below eighteen (18) years of age (or the age of majority where you live), have your parents or legal guardians review this Agreement. Your download and/or use of Elemental Raiders will entail their acceptance and authorisation to you for becoming a Player, and all binding obligations in relation to the EULA will also be binding for them.
Official Website: https://elementalraiders.gfal.com/
Support: https://elementalraiders.gfal.com/support/
Twitter: https://x.com/GFAL_Elemental
Community: https://discord.gg/gamesforaliving
Privacy Policy: https://gfal.com/games-privacy-policy/
End-User License Agreement: https://gfal.com/games-eula/

bluejetty:00064688:ios.description:
An easy & quick way to manage your daily finances, Checkbook keeps track of your credit card charges, cash expenditures...etc. With the Checkbook application, it can totally replace your paper checkbook. You can create multiple accounts, save recurring transactions, transfer funds, view reports & graphs, export data...etc. You can even search the transaction by crossing your finger on the calendar! All details of the Checkbook are well designed to provide an excellent experience. Designed and developed by polycents!
FEATURES 
※Export in CSV, QIF & HTML Formats 
-Export your transactions by email for use of desktop applications such as Excel, Quicken...etc. 
※Calendar 
-Show all your monthly transactions as points on the calendar. 
-Filter transactions by tapping a date or selecting multiple dates on the calendar. 
※Recurring Transactions 
-Save a transaction to be used repeatedly(daily, weekly, 2 weeks, monthly, tire monthly), without retyping all the details. 
※Multiple Accounts 
-Track as many accounts as you need. 
※Categories 
-Supports multiple categories with beautiful icons to choose from. 
※Payee & Note 
-All the details you need to keep track of your transactions are including. 
※Search 
-Quickly search for transactions by dates, name, payee, and category. 
-Search and edit transactions on the same screen. 
※Transfer 
-Transfer funds from one account to another. 
※Reconcile Transactions 
-Reconcile your transactions by editing cleared/un-cleared status 
※Reports & Charts 
-Review all your expenses & income by category or account with beautiful graphs and reports. 
-Supports both bar and pie charts. 
-You can set the time period to daily, weekly, monthly & yearly. 
※Passcode 
-Protects your private information. 
※Currency 
-Supports multiple currencies. 
※Elegant, Powerful & User-friendly interface 
# Subscription Details #
- Monthly and annual subscriptions are available.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Automatic renewals will be charged at the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.
- Subscriptions can be managed by going to Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/42835851
Privacy Policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/42835851
Developer website：https://www.polycents.com
If you have any problems or suggestions please send a mail to checkbook@appxy.com, you will get the response in a short time.

bluejetty:00186921:ios.name: AlgoApp - Flashcards
bluejetty:00186921:ios.summary: Learn languages, or study for school and tests, with the most powerful and user-friendly flashcard app. Millions of language-learners and students have studied over 2 billion flashcards with AlgoApp. Ranked #1 Education app in multiple coun
bluejetty:00186921:ios.description:
Learn languages, or study for school and tests, with the most powerful and user-friendly flashcard app. Millions of language-learners and students have studied over 2 billion flashcards with AlgoApp. Ranked #1 Education app in multiple countries world-wide. Featured in the New York Times.
Designed by learning experts, including a published neuroscientist. Whether you're learning a language to live somewhere new or just for fun, need to get through med school, or just want to crush your tests, AlgoApp has already done it for over 5 million people.
Why AlgoApp?
FOR LANGUAGE LEARNERS
• Automatic translation. Make vocab flashcards faster by typing words in the language you know, then AlgoApp translates to the language you're learning (or vice versa). Supports 120 languages including Japanese, Chinese, Korean, English, German, French, and more...
• Speaks flashcards to you, in dozens of languages (automatic text-to-speech). Supports 39 languages including Japanese, Chinese, Korean, English, German, French, and more...
• Automatically generates furigana annotations for kanji, or pinyin annotations for hanzi.
FOR STUDENTS
• Converts PDFs directly into flashcards using AI. Upload lecture slides and have a full deck of flashcards ready in seconds.
• Prompt AI to make flashcards for you based on text and pictures. Turns handwritten notes and diagrams into flash cards for you.
• Format your cards with colored text, bulleted lists, underlines, and more (no CSS needed).
• Works offline, so you can study and make cards even when you don't have signal.
• Syncs automatically with desktop, web app, and your other phones and tablets. So you can make cards on a computer with a full keyboard, then study on your phone.
• Natively supports FSRS, the most-advanced spaced repetition algorithm.
• Imports Anki decks (.apkg), AlgoApp (.xml) files, or spreadsheets (.csv).
• Supports folders and subfolders, to keep your classes organized.
• Notifications tell you when it's time to study (opt-in).
• Share decks and study with your friends using Study Groups.
• No ads.
For the most-dedicated students, try AlgoApp Unlimited free for 7 days. Study as much as you want on all your devices.
If you want to upgrade to AlgoApp Unlimited, you can either purchase "Unlimited: 1-Year" which is a 1-year auto-renewing subscription, or "Unlimited: Lifetime" which is a one-time purchase.
• Unlimited grants you access to unlimited cross-platform multi-device sync, and more..
• If you choose "Unlimited: 1-Year", the subscription will automatically renew, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account within 24-hours before the end of the current period (renewal or trial period).
• You can manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Service: https://www.algoapp.ai/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.algoapp.ai/privacy.html

WiFinder: WiFi Location Map
• Stay Connected Without Spending on Mobile Data!
Tired of running out of mobile data? Need a reliable internet connection while on the go? WiFinder: WiFi Location Map is your solution! Whether you’re walking down the street, sitting in a café, shopping at a mall, or traveling abroad, WiFinder helps you find nearby WiFi-friendly places quickly. No more worrying about expensive data charges — just fast, convenient internet access wherever you are!
• Discover WiFi-Friendly Places with Ease
With WiFinder, you can explore an interactive map of locations that advertise WiFi or are known to be WiFi-friendly. Instead of walking around asking “Do you have WiFi?”, you can quickly check the map, choose a nearby spot, and go there with confidence.

 ○ Apple Watch support

IT'S BUILT FOR YOU
Do.List is a task management app for people. I'm not building for an enterprise corporate client. I design for normal lives. 
SIMPLE - START IN SECONDS
The design is simple enough that it's intuitive. Use the tutorial to get started or skip it and explore!
SCHEDULING
When you need to give a task a due date, add it to the "Reminders" list and you'll get a reminder!
FOCUS
When you open Do.List, the home screen is "Today". That helps keeps the focus on what's important.
"Do.List is a minimalist app empowering focus."
-AppPicker.com
MOTIVATION
Choose the notifications that work for you: 
 ○ Get daily quotes
 ○ Productivity tips
 ○ "Sunday Night Prep" reminders to prepare for the week
 ○ "Monday Morning Pep" motivation
"Personally, I love this app... I encourage anyone who needs to organize their life and loves doing it with lists to use this."
InsideHerHead.net
PROTECTION FROM YOURSELF
Long lists are overwhelming. If your Today list goes over five tasks, you'll get a message encouraging you to shorten your list!
DATA BACKUP
All data saved locally on phone, plus just tap "Backup" in Settings to backup to iCloud. 
****************************************
OTHER LIFE LISTS
 - Grocery List
 - Gift ideas
 - Movies to See
 - Bucket Lists
 - Yard Tasks
 - Trip Packing Lists
 - And more!
Summary of Lists
> Three main to-do lists: Today, Tomorrow, Later
> 30+ Life Lists for various non-urgent task management
> Daily, Weekly, & Monthly lists for repetitive tasks 
Stats
> Get Daily & Weekly "Done" stats after each completed task 
> From the "Done" list, view your completed stats
PLEASE READ WHAT DO.LIST IS NOT:
- Do.List is not a calendar and will not offer that functionality in the foreseeable future.
- Do.List's design encourages going deadline-free. Instead, it encourages you to focus and look at your list often.
- Do.List does not allow you to sync lists. It is not an enterprise app for teams, it's for people and their lives!
- Do.List is iPhone only. There's no syncing, so it doesn't require an account.
●●● Do.List Goals ●●●
Deliver a new level of organization within an intuitive interface. Avoid task pile ups. Keep lists short and motivation high. 
●●● Do.List Terms of Service ●●●
To read about the Do.List terms of use, please visit the below URL:
https://davegetman.com/terms-of-use
●●● Privacy ●●●
Do.List does not require an account! The app collects aggregated numbers, such as how many tasks are added or completed. Your tasks, descriptions, and photos never leave the phone unless you yourself back them up or enable syncing.
Twitter: @YourDoList
Facebook: facebook.com/YourDoList/
Website: YourDoList.com

bluejetty:00180703:ios.developer: Hypnosis and Meditation for Success, LLC
bluejetty:00180703:ios.summary:
Easy Meditation & Hypnosis brings you 110 guided meditation and hypnosis sessions by Joel Thielke, C.Ht., for sleep, calm, focus and confidence. Choose how you want to feel, build the session around it, and press play.
THE WHOLE LIBRARY IN
bluejetty:00180703:ios.description:
Easy Meditation & Hypnosis brings you 110 guided meditation and hypnosis sessions by Joel Thielke, C.Ht., for sleep, calm, focus and confidence. Choose how you want to feel, build the session around it, and press play.
THE WHOLE LIBRARY IN ONE STEP
• Unlock All opens all 110 sessions at once, and it sits first on the home screen
• Or take any single session on its own; the library is sorted by what you need
• A free session is ready to play the moment you open the app
REBUILT FROM THE GROUND UP
Faster, lighter and calmer to use, with a living night sky that gently takes over the screen as you relax. It runs on iOS 16 too, so older iPhones and iPads are welcome. Past purchases carry over: tap Restore Purchases and everything you own returns.
BUILD THE SESSION YOU NEED
• Six inductions, classic and new: the original Short, Long and Sleep, plus Beach (a calm walk along the shore), Speed (a fast way in) and Staircase (counting down step by step)
• Then choose from 110 meditation and hypnosis programs, grouped in eleven areas
• Close it with a Wake ending to come back alert, a Sleep ending to stay under, or Delay — five quiet minutes, then a gentle wake-up
• One unbroken experience from the first word to the last, and any part of it can be swapped while it is playing
PLAYLISTS & ALL-NIGHT REPEAT
• Line up several programs to play back-to-back as a single seamless session, in any order
• Turn on Repeat to loop a playlist, or one program, gently through the whole night
• Pair Repeat with the sleep timer and the audio fades out softly on its own
WHAT'S INSIDE
• 110 guided meditation and hypnosis programs
• The Sound Mixer — fifteen beds: Gentle Rain, Rain on the Window, Ocean Waves, Rain & Thunder, Babbling Brook, Crackling Campfire, Crickets, Soft Wind, Winter Snow, Green Noise, Wind Chimes, Binaural Beats, 528 Hz Tone, 8 Hz Theta and Room Tone. Play one on its own, or stack four with a level apiece and five one-tap mixes
• A background level separate from the voice, and the beds play with no session at all
• A sleep timer; the audio fades rather than stops
• Runs from the lock screen and Control Center, and carries on with the display dark, on Wi-Fi or cellular
• Ready for iPhone Duo: both displays, sideways too, and Nightstand mode, a calm bedside player when the phone stands half-open
POPULAR TOPICS
Anxiety Free, Focus & Concentration, Clear Your Mind Meditation, Confidence & Self Esteem, Interpret Your Dreams, Better Memory, Unlock Creativity, Let Go Of The Past, Chakra Opening, Art of Manifestation, and many more.
WHO IS BEHIND THE SESSIONS
An About screen under Settings carries the byline, a short note from Joel, and a quiet row of his other apps. No banners, nothing on the paywall.
BOUGHT ONCE, KEPT FOR GOOD
There is no subscription, and there never has been. Own one program, or own all 110 in a step. Whatever you buy stays yours on every device signed in to your Apple Account, and Restore Purchases brings it back.
HOW TO USE
1. Start from the feeling you want, not from a title.
2. Set the way in, and a bed or a mix underneath it — or silence.
3. Choose how it should end, or leave Repeat on for the night.
4. After that it is only listening.
ABOUT HYPNOSIS
Hypnosis is a natural state of focused relaxation, and you stay aware the whole time. In that state the subconscious is unusually receptive, which is what makes guided suggestion work on long-standing patterns. You will only accept suggestions that fit your own values, and you come back up naturally at the end.
ABOUT JOEL THIELKE
Joel Thielke is a certified clinical hypnotherapist and instructor, and an NLP coach and trainer, in practice for nearly two decades. He was among the first to put guided hypnosis on the App Store, in 2009. His programs have been played millions of times, and every session here comes from his professional catalog.
From the maker of Weight-Loss Hypnosis, Weight Loss - Sleep Learning and Spirit Guide Sleep Meditation, all on the App Store.

bluejetty:00026535:ios.description:
Sunshine Island is an island-building tycoon game where you can turn your new home into a paradise. Harvest crops, craft products, play with your friends, team up with other islanders worldwide, and trade with the inhabitants! 
BUILD the island of your dreams
Start from scratch, expand and upgrade your tropical village. Plant, grow, and harvest your favorite exotic fruits and vegetables. Send your workers around the island to explore and gather resources to craft goods!
EXPLORE magnificent archipelago
Start expeditions and locate new areas around your home paradise. Discover different islands and learn more about their secret treasures and rare resources. 
Go on an Adventure with FRIENDS
Join a guild and grow together! Team up and compete against other players and guilds.
MEET the Islanders
Be a beloved member of the tropical island community. Meet all unforgettable characters, become close friends with the islanders, discover their stories, and enjoy the vacation feeling!
Have fun with CUTE ANIMALS
Take care of your village by raising lovely farm animals like chickens, cows, goats, horses, pigs, and many other cuddly companions. 
Sunshine Island is completely free to play with optional in-app purchases. You may disable in-app purchasing using your device settings. This game requires an internet connection. Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Imprint: https://policies.altigi.de/en/terms/

Do you like Klondike Tripeaks card games? Do you like to enjoy a leisurely and comfortable farm life? Solitaire Farm Klondike Games will be your best choice. It's a beautiful Tripeaks card game，Train your brain and patience, build your own farm and become an excellent farmer.
Play with friends and compete together for free coins, or play solo and improve your solitaire tripeaks level to build and design the farm of your dreams.
HIGHLIGHTS:
- Klondike card game with a farm theme
- Thousands of different levels, more levels will be available in future versions!
- Wild Cards and boosters to help you harvest your wins.
- Log in to leaderboards to compete with friends.

FEATURE
- Get a hammer to play whack-a-mole, win coins and boosters
- Log in every day to collect bonus gifts to keep the solitaire Klondike game going!
- Every hour you can earn coins from raising animals and harvesting from farming. The more animals and crops you raise, the more coins you earn.
- Don't forget to spin the Solitaire Farm Lucky Wheel for more free gifts.
- Try new events every week: Tomato Trade, Rabbit Race, not just Tri Peaks Offline Solitaire.
- Build and manage your farm and share it with your Facebook friends.
The classic Solitaire TriPeaks card game! The funniest free solitaire TriPeaks classic card game. This isn't just a casual card game - there's so much to explore - TriPeaks levels, farms, animals, and other fun activities.
While enjoying the fun gameplay, you will be fully immersed in a world of cute animals and various plants, exercise your brain while building your farm and enjoy rewards along the way
If you love playing Patience or Klondike card games, this is definitely one of the best mobile Klondike classic card games for you! You can enjoy the fun of the sea world with your friends and explore more exciting content

bluejetty:00187139:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00187139:ios.description:
** Note **
1. The Therap for iOS app is designed to be used by people who already have an active Therap account with the appropriate permissions. If you cannot log into the app or you do not see the functionality you expect, please contact your Provider Administrator.
2. Users with the Reset Password administrative role will be able to access 'Password Reset' section from their dashboard. Users who have both the 'Reset Password' administrative and 'Super Admin' roles enabled can change the password for the users of their agencies.
3. Access to the T-Log module requires the 'T-Log' role to be enabled by a Provider Administrator who has the Mobile T-Log enabled in their Admin Settings.
4. Users with the 'ISP Data' role enabled will have access to Mobile ISP Data module after it has been enabled.
5. Users with the ‘MAR Data Update’ role are able to edit Scheduled, PRN and Other medications from their mobile devices.
6. Users would be able to access the Scheduling/EVV module section from their dashboard if Mobile Scheduling is enabled for the provider.
** Description **
The Therap iOS application offers HIPAA compliant tools for Developmental Disabilities and Long-term services and supports (LTSS) to document shifts notes/progress notes, collecting service data in the home or community setting and resetting passwords remotely. The T-Log, ISP Data, MAR and Scheduling/EVV modules are currently available on the iOS app along with a password reset feature for agency administrators. 
With the Therap iOS app, users can:
• Directly submit shift notes or progress notes from their handheld devices
• Capture date and time stamped photos of activities and supports
• Ensure proof of service delivery with GPS tracking and electronic signatures
• Quickly reset passwords of staff members
• Access to view schedules for a particular date on the Agenda List page
• Option to check in, check out and add comments after the service delivery

bluejetty:00095989:ios.name: Trill: Ear Training Game
bluejetty:00095989:ios.summary:
Ear training that feels like a game. 10 minutes a day.
Trill teaches you to recognize pitches, intervals, chords, scales and melodies by ear, so you can play what you hear instead of guessing. Loved by 100,000+ musicians.
WHAT YOU TRAIN
•
bluejetty:00095989:ios.description:
Ear training that feels like a game. 10 minutes a day.
Trill teaches you to recognize pitches, intervals, chords, scales and melodies by ear, so you can play what you hear instead of guessing. Loved by 100,000+ musicians.
WHAT YOU TRAIN
• Pitch: name the note you hear
• Intervals: hear the distance between two notes
• Chords: major, minor, sevenths, sus chords and inversions
• Chord progressions: hear the chords behind any song
• Scales and modes: tell them apart by sound
• Melodies: listen, then play the melody back on the keyboard
HOW IT WORKS
• Short daily sessions. About 10 minutes is enough.
• A step-by-step journey from easy to advanced (advanced levels are Pro)
• XP, streaks, levels and collectible badges
• Daily challenges, including Melody Rush
• Progress charts for accuracy and response time
Many users call Trill “Duolingo for ear training”: short sessions, clear progress and small wins that keep you coming back.
FOCUS LOCK: PRACTICE FIRST, SCROLL LATER
Struggle with consistency? Turn on Focus Lock and distracting apps stay blocked until you finish your daily ear training. Every answer earns break time.
FREE MUSICIAN TOOLS
• Tuner
• Metronome
• Chord, interval and scale visualizers
WHO IT'S FOR
Guitarists, pianists, producers and music students who want to improvise more freely, transcribe songs and play with others with confidence.
WHY I BUILT TRILL
I built Trill for myself. I wanted to hear the key of a song right away and recognize chords at jam sessions without guessing. It grew into a complete daily training system for anyone who wants a real musical ear.
FREE AND PRO
Trill is free to download. The free version includes the tuner, the metronome, the chord, interval and scale visualizers, progress charts, achievements, Focus Lock, the easy journey levels and one free ear training session per category each day.
Trill Pro is an optional paid subscription. It unlocks unlimited ear training sessions, all journey levels and advanced exercises, and practice sessions built from your saved exercises and mistakes. Pro is an auto-renewable subscription; the plans offered (weekly, monthly or yearly) and their prices depend on your country and are shown in the app before you buy. The yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
By downloading or using Trill, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
Privacy Policy: https://trill.studio/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://trill.studio/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00178391:ios.description:
Those Bloons may look cute and colorful but they've made a mess of Monkey Town, and it's up to you to pop them all and set things right!
Aim your friendly Monkeys then watch them jump right into the puzzle and use their signature abilities to pop as many Bloons as possible. Merge shots into powerful Mega Monkeys and unlock bonus Hero Monkey shots to help you win!
Each victory helps you rebuild the beautiful village scenes that the Bloons disrupted. Place buildings, characters, pets, decorations, and a variety of other interactive, animating objects to make each Monkey Town your own creation.
KEY FEATURES:
* 10 adorable animating Monkey characters that jump straight into the puzzle
* Thousands of colorful, challenging levels with an endless variety of Bloons, obstacles, and moving formations
* 12 unique Monkey Town scenes to restore and decorate with 150 beautifully crafted animating objects
* Merge Monkeys to create awesome Mega Monkeys, capable of clearing huge puzzle sections by themselves
* Build up your score meter and win powerful bonus Hero Monkeys
* Earn and collect screen clearing Powerups to help get past tough levels
* Combine your victories with other players to complete Team Goals and earn special rewards
So sharpen your darts, steady your aim, and pop your way to victory in the richly animated world of Bloons Pop!

bluejetty:00025311:ios.description:
Make your games more legitimate with Scoreboard!
Scoreboard lets you keep score on the go with an actual scoreboard. Scoreboard is excellent for those looking to referee a game, keep track of scoring for a game that they are watching, or legitimize the competitive nature of a game that they are playing by using a real legitimate scoreboard on their phone, tablet, or other devices!
The Scoreboard app is applicable to any points-based game like football, basketball, baseball, and many more (including board games and other indoor/outdoor games).
Some of the features are:
-change points/score increments
-change team colors
-set win limits
-set a game timer
-accurately manage and keep track of game time & more!
Just tap the side that scored to increase their score on the scoreboard! Reset the score to start a new game.

bluejetty:00161327:ios.description:
--TRY SHIFTLIFE TODAY FOR FREE-- 
ShiftLife Organizer is the calendar application designed specifically for shift workers. 
- Organize your Shifts.
- Record your Hours.
- Calculate your Pay.
ShiftLife provides a clear and easy display of upcoming shifts, training days, holiday, on-call days and other important events. 
As well as allowing you to plan your future work & play, ShiftLife also allows you to easily maintain a record of your completed shifts, overtime hours, working locations, hourly pay, total pay, sick days and other details. 
ShiftLife has a simple easy to use interface for quick intuitive operation and functionality designed specifically for easy use. This will quickly become one of your indispensable Apps.
FEATURES:
* Apple Watch
* Notification Center Widget
* iPhone, iPad, iPad mini, iPad Pro. 
* iCloud, Google, Outlook, Yahoo, iCal Sync.
* Fast Shift Entry. A whole year of shifts can be done in seconds.
* Add, delete, edit calendars. 
* Flexibility to handle any wok pattern.
* Bluetooth sync calendars & shift patterns with your work colleagues & friends.
* Pictures for calendar months display.
* Import your own images from your photos.
* Custom events, sick days, holidays, training days. 
* Multiple daily events & shifts. 
* List, Day, Week, Month & Year Views.
* Friendly user interface with intuitive touch gestures .
* Holiday & Sport Calendars.
* Export/import your events & shifts using .ics files. 
* Create image of month view to use as your phones wallpaper.
* Send a picture of your calendar to your friends
* Set any day as the start of your work week.
* Personalise your display.
* Send Email of your shifts.
* iCloud calendar support for automatic syncing between your devices.
* Spanish, French, German, Russian, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Swedish.
 -- YOUR WORK LIFE IN YOUR POCKET --
_____________________________________
- THIS IS NOT A FREE APP. DOWNLOAD THE LITE VERSION FOR FREE TO SEE IF YOU LIKE IT BEFORE YOU DECIDE TO PURCHASE. THE LITE VERSION IS FULLY FUNCTIONAL EXCEPT THAT IT CONTAINS ADVERTS AND RESTRICTS THE NUMBER OF EVENTS THAT CAN BE CREATED AND ADDED TO YOUR CALENDARS. A SMALL IN-APP UPGRADE CAN BE PURCHASED TO REMOVE THE RESTRICTIONS AND ADVERTS. THE COMPLETE CURRENT AND NEXT YEAR'S CALENDARS ARE THEN INCLUDED WITH THE INITIAL FULL VERSION UPGRADE PURCHASE. SUBSEQUENT CALENDAR YEARS ARE AVAILABLE AS A SMALL IN-APP PURCHASE. YOU WILL ALWAYS BE DISPLAYED THE COST IN YOUR LOCAL CURRENCY, BEFORE BEING ASKED TO CONFIRM ANY IN-APP PURCHASE.
To allow our users to further customise their app to meet their specific needs and interests, there is also a separate Add-on available called the ‘Calendar Store’ provided by SchedJoules. It contains a large selection of great holiday, sport fixtures, weather & lifestyle calendars. These calendars can be set up so they are displayed alongside your other personal calendar events. You can purchase access to the ’Calendar Store’ Add-on for 1 year with a yearly auto-renewable subscription. You get full and ongoing access to the ‘Calendar Store’, including live updates. The 1 year subscription to the ‘Calendar Store’ Add-on starts at $1.99 (Prices may vary by location) and begins with a one-month free trial, so you can try before you buy. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase after the 1 month free trial. Subscriptions to the Add-on automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed. You can manage your subscription and turn off the auto-renew for the 'Calendar Store' Add-on at any time from your iTunes Account Settings. Full Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy are available at www.ovalkey.com/terms-of-service and www.ovalkey.com/privacy-policy respectively.

bluejetty:00062444:ios.description:
What's that bird? Ask Merlin—the world’s leading app for birds. Just like magic, Merlin Bird ID will help you solve the mystery.
Merlin helps you identify birds you see and hear. Merlin is unlike any other bird app—it's powered by eBird, the world’s largest database of bird sightings, sounds, and photos.
Merlin offers four fun ways to identify birds. Answer a few simple questions, upload a photo, record a singing bird, or explore birds in a region.
Whether you’re curious about a bird you’ve seen once or you’re hoping to identify every bird you can find, the answers are waiting for you with this free app from the renowned Cornell Lab of Ornithology.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE MERLIN
• Expert ID tips, range maps, photos, and sounds help you learn about the birds you spot and build birding skills.
• Discover a new bird species each day with your own personalized Bird of the Day
• Get customized lists of birds you can find where you live or travel - anywhere in the world!
• Keep track of your sightings—build your personal list of the birds you find
MACHINE LEARNING MAGIC
• Powered by Visipedia, Merlin Sound ID and Photo ID uses machine learning to identify birds in photos and sounds. Merlin learns to recognize bird species based on training sets of millions of photos and sounds collected by birders at eBird.org, archived in the Macaulay Library at the Cornell Lab of Ornithology.
• Merlin delivers the most accurate results thanks to experienced birders, who curate and annotate sightings, photos, and sounds, who are the true magic behind Merlin.
AMAZING CONTENT
• Merlin has bird photos, songs, and calls, and identification help for anywhere in the world, including Mexico, Costa Rica, South America, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, India, Australia, Korea, Japan, China, and more.
The Cornell Lab of Ornithology’s mission is to interpret and conserve the Earth’s biological diversity through research, education, and citizen science focused on birds and nature. We are able to offer Merlin for free thanks to the generosity of Cornell Lab members, supporters, and citizen-science contributors.

bluejetty:00087016:ios.description:
Lingoland is a comprehensive English learning app, designed to help you improve all your language skills – vocabulary, grammar, listening and speaking – through modern learning methods and advanced technology. With a friendly interface, rich content and personalized features, Lingoland offers an effective, enjoyable learning experience suitable for all levels, from beginners to those who want to perfect their English skills.
KEY FEATURES
1. Smart vocabulary learning
Lingoland uses the spaced repetition method, combined with intelligent AI algorithms, to help you memorize vocabulary effectively for a long time. The system analyzes your proficiency level and prioritizes the words you need to practice more.
- Learning by topic: Choose from hundreds of diverse topics such as work, travel, academics, or daily life, to suit your personal needs.
- Learn words in context: The feature of learning words through videos, articles, or real-life content helps you understand how to use words in real-life situations.
- Quick lookup: The built-in word lookup tool allows you to find meanings, pronunciations, and usage examples instantly, even while reading a newspaper or watching a video.
2. Practice natural communication
Lingoland's communication practice feature helps you become more confident when using English in real life.
- Standard pronunciation: Advanced voice recognition technology analyzes and gives detailed feedback to improve your pronunciation.
- Chat with AI: Practice conversations with smart AI, simulating real-life communication situations such as ordering food, job interviews, or casual conversations. AI will adjust the difficulty based on your level, helping you improve every day.
3. Effective Listening Practice
Lingoland provides a variety of listening exercises, from basic to advanced, to help you improve your listening comprehension.
- Dictation: Practice listening and rewriting the content to improve your ability to recognize sounds and improve spelling.
- Listening by level: Listening exercises are classified by level, from short dialogues to longer conversations or speeches, suitable for learners of all levels.
4. Practice speaking like a native speaker
Lingoland's Shadowing feature helps you practice pronunciation and intonation like a native speaker.
- Listen and repeat sentences from videos with instant feedback on accuracy.
- Practice intonation and rhythm, helping you speak English more naturally and fluently.
5. Personalize your learning experience
- Create your own vocabulary folder: Store and categorize vocabulary according to topics you are interested in, such as specialized vocabulary or words used in daily communication.
- Flexible learning path: Choose lessons that suit your time, level and goals.
6. Statistics and progress tracking
Lingoland's smart statistics system helps you understand your learning progress.
- Detailed analysis: Review the vocabulary you have learned, the words that are difficult to remember, and receive appropriate review suggestions.
- Smart reminders: Receive notifications to review vocabulary at the right time, helping you remember longer.
7. Rich and updated content
Lingoland constantly updates learning content, including:
- Videos and articles from reputable sources, helping you learn English in real-life contexts.
- The exercises are designed based on modern language trends, from business English to everyday communication.
Start your English learning journey today!
Whether you are a beginner or want to improve your English skills, Lingoland is the ideal companion. Download the app now and discover how to learn English easier, more fun and more effective than ever!

bluejetty:00036469:ios.name: LUVBUG: Emotional Growth
bluejetty:00036469:ios.summary: Welcome to the fastest growing emotional learning app, helping kids better understand & regulate their own emotions. This award-winning app, brings kids & parents together to learn about BIG feelings. Designed by learning scientists, LuvBug
bluejetty:00036469:ios.description:
Welcome to the fastest growing emotional learning app, helping kids better understand & regulate their own emotions. This award-winning app, brings kids & parents together to learn about BIG feelings. Designed by learning scientists, LuvBug improves emotional health in children, helping to fortify against mental health issues, while boosting academic success. LuvBug is highly focused on being PROACTIVE; giving kids tools to work through thoughts and feelings, before becoming hard-wired in response to stress or anxiety.  
With over a 1,000 activities, games, videos and themes; our immersive digital world uses self-esteem as the primary springboard towards exploration, creativity, and self-awareness. 
Comprised of 25 Levels, each level includes new video topics with age specific questions during videos and gameplay. All questions are designed to invite familiarity, create distinctions and scaffold earlier lessons, using ‘spiral curriculum’ as the gold standard for learning. 
Parents are notified each time their child advances to a new level rank. Celebrating their accomplishment, creates an opening for sharing and underpins the importance of co-engagement.
There are nine ‘age-based’ levels of difficulty that can be easily adjusted in the dashboard settings (if the default level is too simplistic or advanced). As children grow and learn, the complexity of the questions increases. For children who are not strong readers, have hearing challenges or are new to a certain language, all questions and answers are both written and read aloud. 
LuvBug’s focus on co-engagement opens up communication pathway with parents at an early age, which becomes invaluable to kids as they learn and grow. 
****Subscription Details*****
Your LuvBug subscription provides an option for a 3-Day Free Trial, or a direct Monthly, Annual or Lifetime Membership. You can cancel your subscription renewal at any time with specific instructions included both in your ‘Welcome Email’ and in the online dashboard and in the LuvBug App itself.
Payment is charged at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless cancelled 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period, with the cost of the renewal to be provided. To opt out of auto-renewal, simply turn this off this feature in your device settings. You can manage and cancel subscriptions anytime in your account settings.
Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok: @luvbuglearning
Privacy Policy:
LuvBug’s mission centred around Empowering Children to Empower Themselves includes doing so in a digital environment that puts first the safety of the children, parents, and educators using it.
Visit: https://luvbuglearning.com/privacypolicy
Terms of Use: 
https://luvbuglearning.com/termsandconditions

*Top the leaderboard – Win daily matches and take your favorite team to the top. Become the highest in both team & individual rankings

Raise your bat for intense IPL, T20 Cricket Matches as you play with your favorite team in IPL Tournaments of the Sports Games. Play & Engage with a global fan community of addictive sports games lovers. Play exciting IPL live Sports Games that combine Strategy & Sports like nothing else before! Live Cricket like a legend. 
Highlights: 
*Nominated ‘The Best Mobile & Tablet Game: Sports(India & International) 2017 Award,FICCI' 
*Sachin Signed Merchandise, Rewards up for grabs in online events 
*Get a mini-bat autographed by Sachin Tendulkar 
*Manual Catches 
Exclusive Modes: 
Live cricket in each of the modes 
Legendary 
*Play as Sachin Tendulkar in his best iconic fantasy matches in the same settings & best stadiums. Start your cricketing journey as a young 16-year-old Sachin & live through his glorious, epic cricket game career of 24 years. 
PvP 
*Compete with Real Players online or with Friends 
*Use Boosters to score more runs & choose when to opt Powerplay 
*Top the Epic Cricket Game League; Engrave your Name in the Hall of Fame 
Series 
*Play classic domestic & high-octane international tournaments 
*Participate in the SSPL sports game - Sachin Saga Premier League – a complete in-game IPL experience 
*Play IPL live T20 mode in SSCC – Fan Clash of the Day 
*WIN Fan points & get a chance to meet Sachin Tendulkar 
Quick Play 
*Play 2-OVER Quick Blitz, Exciting IPL T20 or Enduring ODIs fantasy Tournaments Mode sports game 
*Participate in domestic & international tournament game like Big Bash, Asia Cup, IPL live & more 
*Relive all the amazing World Cup & IPL live Journeys, and best criket league matches in their authentic settings of sports game 
Events 
*Compete in IPL T20 cricket game matches. Top the Time-Limited Leader boards event hosted every month 
*Revolutionary batting systems that emulate real-world playing criket conditions in authentic stadiums 
*Motion-captured batting shots of Sachin himself that allow you to play all epic cricket sports game shots the way he does 
*Experience dynamic camera angles & real-time replays 
*Enjoy the IPL live T20 gaming 
‘Sachin Saga Cricket Champions’ has features that make it the most dynamic and versatile sports game in the world of mobile cricket game. Be prepared for mind-blowing action in IPL T20!! Tune into the next generation of Cricket strategy Sports games. Compete with millions of real-world cricket fans from across the globe. Live cricket as you play it!

bluejetty:00169011:ios.description:
MDVIP Connect for iOS helps members easily connect with their doctor and make healthy choices every day. The benefits of the MDVIP Connect app include: 
• Enhanced secure messaging – ability to communicate securely with your MDVIP physician and/or staff. 
• Ability to update your contact information, manage payment profile and schedule payments. 
• Opportunity to view your most recent AWP results (if available) 
• In-app MDVIP support for any membership questions you may have. 
MDVIP was born in 2000 from an idea that started in the minds of forward-thinking primary care doctors who felt the healthcare system was losing its way. They knew there was a better way to practice medicine and provide the level of care and attention their patients deserved. 
• We believe healthcare should always put the patient first. 
• We believe medical care is not one-size-fits-all. 
• We believe doctors should have time to get to know patients beyond their symptoms. 
• We believe appointments should not come with time limits. 
• We believe in the type of primary care that improves health and lives. 
• We believe in MDVIP.

bluejetty:00178310:ios.name: BarSpoon - the cocktail app!
bluejetty:00178310:ios.summary: We offer step by step instructions and exact measurements in order to create your favorite cocktails. The app helps you pick the right glassware and garnish as well as providing the approximate prep time. Also, there is a fun fact on the hi
bluejetty:00178310:ios.description:
We offer step by step instructions and exact measurements in order to create your favorite cocktails. The app helps you pick the right glassware and garnish as well as providing the approximate prep time. Also, there is a fun fact on the history of the cocktail. 
Explore the different categories from classics and tropicals (tiki) to coffee drinks and famous cocktails that have appeared in film. You can also search by the different eras, taste buds (sweet, bitter, sour, savory, smoky and spicy) and base spirits.
One of the standout features of BarSpoon is its ability to empower users to select ingredients on hand, enabling them to create both new drinks and old favorites. Simply choose from the four categories - spirits, liqueurs/bitters, wines/vermouths, and mixers, then combine ingredients within them to discover your personalized cocktail recipe.
Mark cocktails recipes you love as favorites to find them easily next time you open the app.
Learn in detailed fashion about all the bar tools and glassware needed as well as exclusive behind the scenes access to bar lingo, shortcuts and tips from real life bartenders. The “liqueurs lexicon” provides flavor profiles and a history of each liqueur. 
You don’t live in the US? No problem! BarSpoon easily converts recipe measurements to ML so you can make your favorite drinks anywhere in the world!
By unlocking “Premium Cocktails” you will gain access to a lifetime of all the great recipes BarSpoon has to offer. We continue to add new recipes on a regular bases in order to keep up with new trends.
• BarSpoon was named by Forbes.com #5 in “8 Drink Apps to Help You Pour The Perfect Cocktail”. (March 2024)

Test your IQ and unleash your detective skills in Differences Hunt; the most addictive searching and finding difference photo hunt puzzle game where your duty is to uncover the differences and missing parts between two pictures. Zoom in, focus, and keep your eyes open! 
Enjoy a simple and intuitive game design that lets you relax and have fun while finding differences in each picture. Explore a wide variety of stunning pictures and indulge in the challenge of spotting hidden differences. Test your detection abilities and concentration as you race against the clock to identify disparities in seemingly identical images.
How to play the Differences Hunt game:
- Compare two pictures to discover the differences.
- Spot the difference and tap to highlight the distinct objects.
- Find the differences within the allotted time, searching for subtle variations.
- Enlarge the picture to spot small objects and hidden differences more easily.
- Use hints when you need a clue during your hunt for differences.
If you like playing entertaining find differences puzzle games, then Differences Hunt is just what you need! Improve your searching and concentration skills while solving photo hunt find the difference games puzzles. Sharpen your eyes, win all levels and become a master in searching and finding hidden differences!

bluejetty:00023982:ios.description:
HESI® A2 Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the A2 Nursing entrance exam with high scores on your first attempt.
HESI® A2 Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you get an in-depth understanding of concepts related to the 2026 A2 Nursing entrance exam preparation, but also helps you get familiar with thousands of exam-like questions to boost your confidence in passing the exam on your first try!
### Passing the exam on the first try ###
In HESI® A2 Exam Prep 2026 there are expertly prepared questions that cover the range of questions required for the A2 Nursing entrance exam. Nine content areas are included and you will be asked to test different subjects depending on the requirements of your school.
Specifically, these subjects are vocabulary and general knowledge, reading comprehension, grammar, basic math skills, biology, anatomy and physiology, chemistry, and physics.
### Key Features ###
- Practice with over 1300 questions
- Specialized practice by content area
- View an analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the A2 Nursing entrance exam is to keep practicing and not to lose confidence in the exam. You will find that each time you practice on HESI® A2 Exam Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam will increase, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Take a certain amount of time each day to practice some of the questions and do not imply that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easy to pass not only the A2 Nursing exam, but also any other exam!
### Purchase, Subscription and Terms ###
You will need to purchase a subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas and issues. After purchase, the cost will be deducted directly from your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and will be billed based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If a subscription needs to be cancelled for renewal, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term, otherwise the account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off automatic renewal in your account settings in iTunes after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://www.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://www.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html
If you have any questions or comments about your use, please let us know via email at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.

bluejetty:00083660:ios.description:
Air Printer App: Air Print helps you print photos and documents from your iPhone or iPad. Choose any AirPrint-compatible printer, including HP, Epson, Brother, or Canon, and start printing in just a few seconds.
Whether you need to print an important document, a memorable photo, a large poster, or extracted text, this all-in-one printer app provides convenient tools for your everyday printing needs.
KEY FEATURES
◆ PRINT FROM IPHONE OR IPAD 
Print documents and photos wirelessly from your iPhone or iPad using an AirPrint-compatible printer. No additional drivers or complicated setup are required.
◆ PRINT PHOTOS 
Choose your favorite photos from your camera or photo library and print them within seconds. Select and print multiple photos whenever needed.
◆ PRINT DOCUMENTS 
Access documents stored on your device or in iCloud and send them directly to your smart printer. Conveniently manage and print your important personal, school, or business files.
◆ SCAN DOCUMENTS 
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a portable document scanner. Use your device’s camera to scan documents, receipts, forms, notes, and photos, then prepare them for printing.
◆ PRINT LARGE POSTERS 
Transform your favorite photo into a large poster. Divide an image across multiple printable pages, adjust the layout according to your needs, and combine the printed pages to create a bigger poster.
◆ COPY TEXT FROM PHOTOS
 Extract text from photos and scanned images using built-in text recognition. Copy, edit, save, share, or print the extracted text whenever you need it.
◆ WEB PAGES
 Enter anything on the web and print it instantly with our smart printer.
◆ CUSTOMIZE PRINT SETTINGS 
Prepare your content before printing by adjusting available options such as paper size, page orientation, number of copies, color preferences, and layout.
AIRPRINT SUPPORT
Air Printer App works with AirPrint-compatible models from popular manufacturers, including HP, Epson, Brother, Canon, Samsung, Dell, Lexmark, Xerox, Panasonic, Ricoh, Toshiba, Sharp, and many others. Your iPhone or iPad and printer must be connected to the same Wi-Fi network, and the selected printer must support AirPrint.
EVERYDAY PRINTING MADE SIMPLE
Air Printer App is suitable for printing:
• Photos and images
 • Scanned documents
 • Personal and business files
 • Receipts and forms
 • School assignments
 • Travel documents
 • Large posters
 • Text extracted from images
From scanning a document to printing a photo, Air Printer App brings essential printing tools together in one convenient place. Choose your content, select your printer, and print in just a few simple steps.
Download Air Printer App today and make printing from your iPhone or iPad faster, easier, and more convenient.

- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.

Spin the solar disk to move through the time of day or up to five days ahead, a
bluejetty:00074036:ios.description:
Sunrise Sunset Widget is a beautiful Sun Tracker and Weather app that lets you explore the daily and seasonal cycles of the Sun in a stunning, interactive way.
Spin the solar disk to move through the time of day or up to five days ahead, and instantly see sunrise and sunset times, day length, twilight, golden hour, solar power output, and even the UV Index — all visualized with precision and style.
Switch to Weather Mode to view temperature, precipitation, wind speed, and humidity beautifully combined with the solar disk.
If you’re into photography, enable Golden Hour and Blue Hour mode to easily see when this perfect light begins and ends.
Point your phone at the sky with AR Mode to see exactly where the Sun and Moon are, and the paths they’ll follow today. Sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset are marked along the way, and the time slider moves the Sun and Moon to any time of day. Perfect for planning a photo, or finding out whether the sunset will clear the trees.
Wake up with the Sun. The Sun Alarm rings at sunrise, solar noon, sunset, or at civil, nautical or astronomical twilight, and moves with the season, so you always wake up with the light. Set it minutes or hours before or after the event, choose the days it rings, set a latest time for dark winter mornings, and see the week’s wake-up times at a glance. It rings even in silent mode and Focus.
Customize your experience with a wide range of color themes, adjustable display modes, and fully configurable widgets.
The Calendar shows each day’s daylight as a ring that matches the solar disk, or every sunrise, sunset and day length of the month at a glance. Clock changes, solstices and equinoxes are marked along the way, and tapping a day reveals more detailed solar information.
Tap the globe on the Sky screen to explore any place on the map, or search by name — the app works anywhere in the world.
Enjoy elegant Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets that keep you updated at a glance with sunrise, sunset, and daylight times right on your device.
Get notifications for sunrise and sunset, total day and night length, and see how the day changes compared to yesterday.
Whether you’re a photographer, nature enthusiast, or simply love knowing where the Sun is, Sunrise Sunset Widget brings solar and weather insights beautifully to life.

bluejetty:00135945:ios.description:
Enjoy the world’s leading history magazine on your iPad or iPhone. Dive into the latest issue of History Today and explore our library of over 100 back issues for the cost of a cup of coffee. Download issues to learn on the go and save your favourite articles to read again. 
History Today is written for history lovers who want the most up-to-date writing from the world’s leading historians — the experts in their field. Our understanding of the past continues to evolve and every issue of History Today provides thorough analysis written with personality and flair. 
History Today gives new context to the past and provides a perspective on why the world is currently as it is with a depth and variety of historical topics, eras and countries not found in any other magazine. It is perfect for anyone with an interest in the past and who wants to get the most out of their leisure time.  
Every issue of History Today contains: 
A wide variety of historical topics, from ancient and medieval history to the world wars and beyond
A truly international perspective, not just British and American history. 
The latest research from leading historians and subject experts. 
Longform book reviews, opinion columns and more. 
If you subscribe directly to History Today magazine or the History Today digital archive, you already have full and free access to the app. Just use your subscriber ID to log in – find it on your confirmation email or contact us at subscriptions@historytoday.com. 
You can purchase single issues within the app for £5.49/$6.49 or subscribe to receive every issue of the magazine and access our library of back issues. Subscriptions are priced at £4.49/$5.49 a month or £39.99/$50.99 a year. 
* The current subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for the same duration at the current subscription rate for the product 
* You may turn off the auto-renewal of subscriptions through your Account Settings, however, no cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period 
* Payment will be charged to your Apple account when the purchase is confirmed 
Our privacy policy can be found at http://www.historytoday.com/privacy-policy 
Our terms of use can be found at http://www.historytoday.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00076175:ios.name: Lark Health
bluejetty:00076175:ios.summary: Health looks different for everyone, which is why Lark offers unique programs designed to target your individual health goals. Whether you want to build healthy habits to lose weight, get help preventing or managing diabetes, lower your blo
bluejetty:00076175:ios.description:
Health looks different for everyone, which is why Lark offers unique programs designed to target your individual health goals. Whether you want to build healthy habits to lose weight, get help preventing or managing diabetes, lower your blood pressure, or just feel your best, Lark has a program for you. Every Lark program includes 24/7 digital health coaching from your smartphone or tablet, a smart scale, the Lark health app with food and activity trackers, helpful tips and resources, and other program-specific devices. 
The best part? If you qualify, you can join Lark at no extra cost to you with eligible insurance! 
The Lark coach can help you:
- Create healthy eating habits
- Move more and feel stronger
- Reach and maintain a healthy weight
- Learn how to manage common GLP-1 medication side effects 
- Plan meals and create grocery lists
- Build healthy habits to prevent and manage chronic conditions like diabetes and hypertension
- Improve your sleep and manage stress
- Connect with other Lark members just like you! 
FOOD COACHING
Food coaching with Lark’s Coach+ technology provides real-time, tailored healthy eating advice that’s generated based on your specific questions and responses. Whether you want feedback on a recent meal, help planning an upcoming meal, or a personalized grocery list, your digital coach is ready to help.
TRACK ALL OF YOUR HEALTH DATA
Display everything in one place: Weight readings, daily activity levels, sleep, stress, meals and key ingredients, blood sugar, blood pressure, and more. See everything in one dashboard to understand how you’re progressing toward each of your health goals.
24/7 SUPPORT
Message your digital coach anytime, anywhere for helpful tips and daily education. Guided chats help you achieve your goals in just 5 minutes a day! Most Lark programs also include live coaching opportunities with our certified coaches and the ability to join a community of other Lark members. 
COMPLIMENTARY DEVICES
When you enroll, you’ll receive a smart scale and other program-specific devices at no extra cost to you! Your devices connect and send measurements right to the Lark app, making it easy to track your progress as you go.
ENROLL THROUGH YOUR INSURANCE BENEFITS
Answer a few simple questions to see if you qualify for Lark at no extra cost to you. 
HEAR FROM LARK MEMBERS JUST LIKE YOU!
“65 lbs down and 100 times happier. Keep going even when you think it's not working because small losses add up in the end.” - Charles
“I joined Lark a year ago and I reached my weight loss goal, it feels amazing! I have more energy and feel better than I have in years. Thank you, Lark, for helping me.” - Lisa 
“This morning I was getting dressed and pulled on a pair of jeans that are a size too small that I keep just in case, and they FIT! When I went to the store later, I treated myself to a new sweater a size down, too. Small wins sometimes mean more than the scale.” - Carol
Disclaimer:
The Lark app is designed for personal health tracking for informational purposes only. It's not a medical device and isn't intended to diagnose, treat, or cure any disease. The content provided on the Lark app is not medical advice or a substitute for professional medical guidance. Consult a qualified healthcare provider with any medical questions or before making health decisions. Do not disregard or delay seeking professional medical advice based on information provided in the Lark app.

bluejetty:00151197:ios.name: PROBE PLUS
bluejetty:00151197:ios.summary: PROBE PLUS is for monitoring the wireless meat thermometer via Bluetooth connected, which provides real-time temperature monitoring and alarm functions. The APP content is simple and easy to operate and has comprehensive functions, which ca
bluejetty:00151197:ios.description:
PROBE PLUS is for monitoring the wireless meat thermometer via Bluetooth connected, which provides real-time temperature monitoring and alarm functions. The APP content is simple and easy to operate and has comprehensive functions, which can help you cook food perfectly.
PROBE PLUS is also your right-hand man in the kitchen or on the grill, allowing you to get rid of the kitchen and the grill during cooking time, and let the APP monitor your food for you. You'll receive audio and message notifications on your smart device when your food is ready. This way, you don't have to stare at your food cooking all the time, giving you more time to focus on what's most important to you.
Function:
1. Bluetooth wireless connection, the real-time temperature of the probe is displayed in the APP through the transmission of wireless data by the wireless thermometer.
2. Two series product can be used, wired probe devices and wireless probe devices.
2. Alarm function:
 - When the measured temperature reaches the preset temperature, the mobile phone will automatically alarm and remind.
 - Probe low battery alarm, reminding users to charge in time.
 - Device low battery alarm, reminding users to charge in time.
 - Alarm function after disconnection.
 - Over temperature alarm function, when the temperature exceeds the temperature range of the device, the mobile phone will automatically alarm and remind.
3.Time monitoring function, when the PROBE PLUS APP cooking setting is completed, click start, it will automatically enter the timing state, and calculate the total time taken from the current temperature to the set temperature alarm. Or set the count down timer to monitor the cooking food through time control.
4. USAD food temperature recommends is provided, or you can customized your favorite temperature setting.
5. Cooking time/temperature graph is provided, which will let you clear the temperature change at each time.
6. The historical cooking temperature setting record can be used again, allowing you to savor the flavor you most want.

Childcare software is an all-in-one tool that helps you manage your business. From enrolling new students to automating tuition payments, the software should support every aspect of your business. Once you’ve purchased the right childcare software, you shouldn’t need any outside services, such as QuickBooks or MailChimp. It brings all these services together for seamless management of every aspect of your business.
We’ll review the most important aspects of childcare software to help you prepare for selecting the best one for your center.

bluejetty:00134165:ios.description:
No giant printer? No problem!
Want to create massive posters, banners, or wall art with your home printer?
Docuslice lets you turn any image, PDF, or SVG into a stunning, multi-page masterpiece using your regular printer! Tiled printing is easier than ever — simply print across multiple pages and assemble them into one giant poster.
Here’s how it works:
- Choose your layout:
 - Grid Mode – set poster size using rows and columns (fixed number of papers).
 - Size Mode – set exact width and height for your poster.
- Import any image, PDF, or SVG.
- Customize it to perfection: Resize, add text and paragraphs, and style them with 1,900+ free fonts.
- Docuslice magically slices your design into printable tiles.
- Export your way — three options to choose from:
 - PDF (Standard) – a rasterized PDF, perfect for photo-heavy posters.
 - PDF (Vector) – razor-sharp at any size, ideal for text, logos, and line art.
 - Images – saved straight to your photo gallery.
- Print directly to your home printer or send to print shops if you don’t have one.
New: Paragraphs and rich text — text that wraps to its box, alignment, bullet and numbered lists, line and letter spacing, mixed styles, and 1,900+ free fonts.
Text and fonts:
- Paragraphs that wrap to their box — drag a side to change the width
- Align text left, center or right, and justify paragraphs
- Bullet and numbered lists, with nesting
- Line and letter spacing
- Mix fonts, styles, sizes and colors in one text
- 1,900+ free fonts, in every weight each family has
- Sharp text on paper — real vector text in the vector PDF
Perfect for:
- Eye-catching event posters (birthdays, holidays, etc.)
- Educational charts, decorations, and classroom posters
- Unique wall art for your home or office
- Campaign, activism, and protest posters
- Large banners, signage, and shop displays
- Blueprints, floor plans, and CAD drawings
- Engineering and architectural diagrams
- Logos, branding, and wordmarks
- Maps and infographics
- Line art, coloring pages, and stencils
- Stained glass patterns
- Cut files for vinyl and signage
- Sewing, quilting, and craft patterns
- Sheet music and lyric posters
Docuslice is:
- FREE to download and use
- Incredibly easy to learn
- Compatible with images, PDFs, and SVGs
- Packed with 1,900+ free fonts
- Exportable as standard PDF, vector PDF, or images
- Lets you print large image on multiple pages — at any size
- Cost-efficient – no need for large format printers
- Eco-friendly – save resources by using your home printer
Ready to unleash your creativity and print giant posters with ease?
Download Docuslice today!

bluejetty:00061294:ios.description:
Live flight tracker for Houston George Bush Airport (IAH). Free.
Arrivals, departures and flight status — on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled or landed. Gate numbers, baggage carousels and terminals, live. And keep the rest of your trip in the same app: boarding passes, where you parked, packing lists, tickets and bookings.
Perfect for travellers, frequent flyers, taxi drivers, airport staff and anyone meeting or seeing off passengers at Houston George Bush Airport.
FLIGHTS
• Live arrivals and departures board, refreshed with one tap
• Search by flight number, airline, city, airport, terminal, gate or baggage belt
• Status at a glance: on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled, landed
• Codeshare flight matching
• Domestic and international filters
• Favourite flights
• Weather and local time at both ends of a flight, with a 3-day forecast
• Flights-per-hour report and status sharing
• Dark mode, 12- or 24-hour time, °C or °F
• Available in 61 languages
MY TRIP — YOUR TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
• Boarding passes: snap a photo, the barcode is read and shown full-screen at the gate
• My car: photos, a note and (optionally) the location of your spot, with walking directions back
• Checklists: packing lists to tick off, with a starter list
• Bag tags: tag number, airline and a photo of your bag
• Receipts: snap a receipt and the total is read for you
• Tickets: train, bus, ferry and event tickets, barcode shown large
• Bookings: hotel, car hire and insurance, with tap-to-call, maps and the confirmation attached
• Links and notes: save links from other apps and keep trip notes
• Trip dates with a countdown
• Backup to a file, with an optional password
Everything stays on your phone. No account needed.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Add and edit everything in My trip
• Both ends of every flight: times, terminal, gate and baggage
• Flight details: taxi-out, air time, taxi-in and delays at each end
• Aircraft type and registration (tail number)
• Security and customs queue wait times (supported airports)
• PDF export of your trip and receipts
• No ads
Download now and always know exactly where every IAH flight stands.
—
This app is not an official airport app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Houston George Bush Airport or any airline. For definitive flight times, please check the official airport or airline website. The developer accepts no liability for incidents resulting from use of the data shown.
