bluejetty:00116989:ios.description:
Try the critically acclaimed Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown for free! Then unlock the full game with a single in-app purchase!
Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown is an action-adventure platformer game, inspired by the Metroidvania genre and set in a mythological Persian world.
Play an epic adventure as Sargon, an extraordinary and fearless young hero. Summoned by Queen Thomyris with your fellow brothers-in-arms, the Immortals, you are sent on a rescue mission to save her son: Prince Ghassan.
The trail leads you to Mount Qaf, the ancient city of Gods, now cursed and filled with time-corrupted enemies and inhospitable mythological creatures.
To fulfill your quest, you will have to learn to master unique Time Powers, combat and platforming skills to perform deadly combos to defeat your enemies and restore the world's balance.
Carefully redesigned for mobile with exclusive mobile features:
-Native revamped interface and touch control, with full custom remapping options: change the buttons’ position, shape, size, and position to your liking.
-External controller support
-New automatic modes and additional options to ease combat or platforming sequences: auto-potion, auto-parry, optional shield, direction indicator, wall grab hold, etc.
-Native screen ratio support 16:9 to 20:9
MINIMUM DEVICE SPECIFICATIONS
iOS 14 minimum (auto in build).
4 GB RAM. 
Excludes A12 family chipset devices (auto in build) AND
iPhone XR (3GB), iPhone SE (2nd GEN), iPad gen 8, iPad gen 9, iPad Air 3, iPad Mini 5.

bluejetty:00043321:ios.description:
With NICE gomobile, you can buy bus tickets anytime and anywhere. The Official NICE gomobile app is like having a vending machine in your pocket. No need to carry a MetroCard or fumble for change, gomobile will revolutionize your NICE bus experience! 
With gomobile, you can quickly and easily purchase NICE bus tickets, check schedules, service alerts, route maps along with REAL TIME ARRIVAL INFO! Purchasing a ticket is easy: select your ticket type, enter payment information, and you’re ready to go. To pay your fare, all you have to do is tap to use a ticket and then show your phone to the driver. You can also easily store tickets for future use.
We are working to make the app even better so let us know what you think by emailing NICEticketing@transdev.com
Features:
- Buy your tickets anytime, anywhere
- No need to find a MetroCard reseller or vending machine to pay your fare
- No need to carry exact change for every trip
- Store tickets on your phone for future use
- Never lose your ticket – tickets can be easily transferred if your phone is lost or stolen
- Check service alerts, schedules, route maps and more

Get ready for an out-of-this-world adventure in Shooting Blaster – the ultimate shooting game! Dive into a galaxy full of action, cool graphics, and tons of weapons for an awesome gaming experience.

Cool Story: Follow a captivating story that takes you across the galaxy. Encounter interesting characters, make choices, and see how your decisions affect the game.

Join the fun in Shooting Blaster, the game that makes you the space hero. Download now and get ready for an epic space adventure – are you up for the challenge?

bluejetty:00073828:ios.description:
AlfredCamera is recognized by:
⏩ “I like Alfred” — WIRED (September 2026)
⏩ “We're using AlfredCamera because it's … easy to set up” — Engadget (September 2026)
⏩ “My top pick” — Kim Komando (April 2025)
⏩ “Alfred is your pick” — Digital Trends (February 2024)
⏩ “The app to use is the … excellent AlfredCamera Home Security” — Fast Company (January 2022)
⏩ “There are a bunch of apps that allow old phones to become security cameras, but our favorite is Alfred” — Digital Trends (July 2018)
Over 90 million downloads worldwide. AlfredCamera turns an old iPhone or iPad into a home security camera, and the phone in your pocket becomes the camera viewer.
Our all-in-one app includes:
⏩ LIVE CAMERA: Watch a live view from anywhere on Wi-Fi or cellular
⏩ MOTION DETECTION: Get an alert and a short recording when something moves
⏩ CRY ALERT (Premium): Your phone rings like a call when your baby cries
⏩ TWO-WAY TALK: Talk to your dog, your baby or your parents
⏩ LOW-LIGHT FILTER: A clearer picture in a dim room
⏩ SIREN, MULTIPLE CAMERAS and TRUST CIRCLE for family
PHONE AS A SECURITY CAMERA
Stand your old phone on a shelf facing the front door and plug it in. It becomes an indoor home security camera that tells you when a package arrives or someone comes in. No drilling and no wiring, so it works in apartments and rentals.
BABY MONITOR
Two devices make a video baby monitor. Watch the crib from the kitchen, and with Premium, get a call-style alert when your baby cries.
DOG CAMERA FOR WORKDAYS
Dog home alone while you work? See if he's asleep on the couch, and talk to him so he hears a familiar voice. The same pet camera works for cats too.
CHECK IN ON MOM AND DAD
Set up a home camera together, in a spot your parents choose, and they can wave or talk to you.
REMOTE CAMERA WHILE YOU TRAVEL
Check on the empty house from the hotel and get motion alerts.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Video is end-to-end encrypted. Only you and the people you invite can see it; our team can't view it, and law enforcement requests need a warrant. You get an alert when a new device signs in.
QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK
Which app do reviewers recommend to turn an old phone into a camera?
WIRED, Engadget, Kim Komando, Digital Trends and Fast Company have all recommended AlfredCamera.
Can I use my phone as a security camera?
Yes. Your old iPhone or iPad is the camera and your everyday phone is the viewer. Sign in with the same account on both.
Do both phones need the same Wi-Fi?
No. The camera needs Wi-Fi or cellular data, and you can watch the live camera from anywhere.
Can I use an old iPhone as a baby monitor?
Yes. Keep it plugged in at least 3 feet from the crib and watch from your phone.
Can I talk to my dog while I'm at work?
Yes. Point the camera at his favorite spot and use two-way talk.
I rent an apartment. Can I have a home security camera without drilling?
Yes. A phone on a shelf is enough, and it moves with you.
Can I turn an old iPad into a home camera?
Yes. Stand it where it can see the room and keep it plugged in.
How do motion alerts work?
When the camera sees movement, your phone gets a notification and a short recording.
Can I see a dark room?
The low-light filter brightens the live view in a dim hallway or bedroom.
Can I watch more than one camera?
Yes. Add several old phones and switch between them in the camera viewer.

bluejetty:00180504:ios.name: Model Colors
bluejetty:00180504:ios.summary: Model Colors is an application for helping you keep track of your hobby model colors and projects. Have you ever ended up buying the wrong colors because you didn’t remember the exact code of the color you needed or forgot to get that pesky
bluejetty:00180504:ios.description:
Model Colors is an application for helping you keep track of your hobby model colors and projects. Have you ever ended up buying the wrong colors because you didn’t remember the exact code of the color you needed or forgot to get that pesky Dunkelgelb that you needed to finish that glorious tank you’re working on? If so, then Model Colors helps you keep track of the colors that you own and the colors that you need to buy. The application contains lists of all colors from a set of brands and you can browse these lists and mark the ones you already own and the ones you need to buy. Currently the app has over 50000 colors included from most big and many small manufacturers.
The lists of your own colors and colors that you need to buy can be easily shared via mail, iMessage etc.
If you mainly use some particular color types or individual colors you can set them as favorites and easily access them from the main menu. 
You can check for colors that are similar to a certain color either via color standards like FS, RAL, RLM etc, or via industry standard CIE deltaE 2000 calculations.
Various colors can also be grouped together for quick access into custom color lists. You can keep the colors you normally use for US airplanes in one list and colors you use for fantasy miniatures in another, making them easy to find.
Some of the included brands: Abteilung 502, Agama, AKAN, AK Interactive, Alclad II, Ammo, Andrea, AOK Silveroaks, Apple Barrell, Arcus Hobby Colors, Army Painter, Badger, Bits of War, Coat D'Arms, Colour Forge, Craft Smart, Createx, Creature Caster, Daler-Rowney, Darkstar Miniatures, Duncan Rhodes Painting Academy, Dwarven Forge, E7, Fantasy Flight Games, Faskolor, Fire Scale Modeler, Flames of War, Flory Models, ForgeWorld, Gaia, Gamescraft, Games Workshop, Golden, Gravity Colors, Green Stuff World, Hannants, Hataka, Heller, Hobby Mio, Huge Miniatures, Humbrol, ICM, Instar, Italeri, Jo Sonja's, Jumpwind, Kimera Models, Lefranc Bourgeois, LifeColor, Liquitex, Meng, Microscale, MIG Productions, Minuteman Scale Models, Mission Models, Modellers World, Modo, Monkey Modelling Paints, Monument Hobbies, Mr. Hobby, MR Paint, Nocturna Models, Paasche, Pacific88, Pactra, Pledge, Prince August, Privateer Press, ProScale Paints, Rackham, Reaper, Rembrandt, Revell, Rust-Oleum, Scale75, Scale Colors, Scale Modellers Supply, Sovereign Hobbies, Splash Paints, Tamiya, Testors, Titans Hobby, Tru-Color, True Earth, TT Combat, Turbo Dork, Ultimate Modelling Products, Vallejo, Vantage Modelling Solutions, Warcolours, Wargames Foundry, Warlord Games, Wilder, Winsor & Newton.
You can also add the models that you are working on or plan to build in the future. For each model you can register the colors that are required and make sure that you don't forget to buy any essential colors. Each model can have a photos associated with it as well as notes. Using the notes and photos it is easy to keep a build diary or just keep track of things that you need to do at some point.
Model Colors requires iCloud and iCloud Drive to be enabled for the app to work. iCloud Drive is used to save photos and documents for our models.
Model Colors uses a subscription in order to support the application development and there's a trial period that lets you evaluate the app.
Please see the link https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ for the End User License Agreement.

bluejetty:00060916:ios.description:

You put so much effort into gathering items and setting up the auction, let Bid Beacon help you get the most return on your efforts! Auction setup and managing users is super simple. Invite users to the auction in multiple ways (unique invite link, access code, and QR code).

If you’re looking to host the most successful silent auction yet, try Bid Beacon today!

ASK ANYTHING
AI Central can help you with a diverse set of tasks, such as:
Composing stories, poems, song lyrics, and scripts
Practicing and translating languages
Finding information on any topic
Discovering new recipes to try

Planning a trip to your dream destination
Solving complex math equations and coding problems

TOPIC DISCUSSION
AI Central is always up for a chat, no matter what topic you want to discuss. Whether you're interested in sports, politics, science, or anything in between, AI Central is here to listen to you and provide insightful responses.
HUMAN-LIKE CHAT

bluejetty:00131990:ios.name: Exif Metadata
bluejetty:00131990:ios.summary:
Exif Metadata lets you quickly and easily view, edit, and remove metadata, including GPS location, from your iPhone and iPad photos. It is a must-have tool for serious photographers and casual iPhoneographers alike. 
10 reasons to use Exif
bluejetty:00131990:ios.description:
Exif Metadata lets you quickly and easily view, edit, and remove metadata, including GPS location, from your iPhone and iPad photos. It is a must-have tool for serious photographers and casual iPhoneographers alike. 
10 reasons to use Exif Metadata:
- It's free to try
- View, edit, or remove Exif metadata on the fly
- View, edit, or remove location data from your photos
- Bulk edit multiple photos at the same time
- Filter photos missing location or metadata
- Your photos are processed on device and never sent to a server
- Extension lets you view metadata directly from the Photos app
- Works on both iPhone and iPad
- Supports Dark Mode
- Highly rated with an average of 4.5 stars
REAL REVIEWS FROM REAL USERS
"Still the best app for editing Exif metadata." -- by iPad User 0222
"As a conscientious parent, I am reluctant to share photos of my children on-line. This app clears any personal data and eases my concerns. Plus it is very straight forward and easy to use." -- by T puffin
"This app is perfect in its simplicity. It’s the only exif app i have found which allows you to view metadata within the camera roll - awesome!" -- by Fshhshsns
"EXIF Metadata does exactly what it says it will do. It’s extremely easy to use and the customer support is great. The inexpensive lifetime Pro version is worth every penny." -- by Apple TV Fan
"Very clean interface, does its job very well. If you want to bulk update the metadata on a collection of photos (eg imported from somewhere else) this is your solution. Highly recommend." -- by JT Player
FEATURES SPOTLIGHT
View Exif metadata:
- View basic photo information at a glance
- View 50+ metadata tags
- View location data such as GPS data, address, map location
Edit Exif metadata:
- Edit aperture, exposure, date, time, author, description, copyright, and more
- Edit geotags or spoof location
Filter photos:
- Pro users can filter photos missing location and Exif metadata
Remove Exif metadata:
- Remove GPS location data independently of other Exif data
- Remove all metadata at once
Bulk edit metadata:
- Pro users can edit metadata of multiple photos at once
Clean & simple design:
- Optimized for iPhone and iPad
- Supports Dark Mode
Photo extension: 
- Access metadata of your photos directly from the Photos app
Protect your privacy:
- Easily share photos online without any metadata
This app works with:
- All photos in your iPhone or iPad camera roll, except ProRAW photos
- Photos in iCloud Photo Library
- Photos in Photo Stream
Exif Metadata Pro:
The Pro version of Exif Metadata can be purchased via an annual subscription or one-time payment to remove ads and gain the ability to edit metadata for multiple photos at once.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews every year unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase.
Terms of use: https://www.sixstarapps.com/terms/
Privacy policy: https://www.sixstarapps.com/privacy/
HAVE QUESTIONS OR NEED HELP?
If you have any question about the app, or need help about something, please do not hesitate to contact us at www.SixStarApps.com. We’ll be happy to help!

bluejetty:00128917:ios.description:
Onet New - Classic Link Puzzle Game is a popular and addictive pair matching puzzle game.
The game has tons of challenging well-designed levels to train your brain, exercise your logical thinking and memory.
It is the best time killer for you! Play for free this awesome link game and enjoy hours of fun connecting lovely images of cute christmas, animals, food, beautiful flowers, and so much more.
In this exciting blast game, your goal is to remove all the images from the board by connecting pairs of identical images.
HOW TO PLAY?
* Match and connect pairs of the same kind images
* Link two identical images and tap to draw a line between them
* Match farther images to gain more stars: longer lines=more points!
* Use the HINT to reveal a possible connection
* Use the SHUFFLE to rearrange all the images randomly
* Use the SCISSORS to remove bomb
* Use the SWAP to change theme image
* Match Bomb tile before it explodes
FEATURES:
- EASY to learn line connect game
- Plenty of amazing THEMES
- Exciting PAIR MATCHING ADVENTURE for everyone to enjoy!
- HINT and SHUFFLE amazing boosters
- Fun PUZZLES to train your brain
- STUNNING graphics and beautiful levels
- FREE to play onet MEMORY GAME
- Play ONLINE or OFFLINE: you don’t need to worry about a Wi-Fi or internet connection
- Levels with timed bomb cards
- Revive after fail
- AUTOSAVE, continue playing where you left off.
- Classic "onet connect" game mechanics
Onet New - Classic Link Puzzle Game is seriously fun and addictive.
Thank you for playing Onet New - Classic Link Puzzle Game! We'll update Onet New regularly, stay tuned.
Please rate us 5 stars if you like game, we’re glad to hear any feedback/suggestion/request from you.

bluejetty:00040405:ios.name: RichScan: PDF Scanner & Sign
bluejetty:00040405:ios.summary:
Tired of paper clutter? GoodScan turns your iPhone and iPad into a powerful mobile scanner. Scan, edit, sign, and organize any document in seconds. Your entire office, right in your pocket.
GoodScan is your all-in-one solution for scanning
bluejetty:00040405:ios.description:
Tired of paper clutter? GoodScan turns your iPhone and iPad into a powerful mobile scanner. Scan, edit, sign, and organize any document in seconds. Your entire office, right in your pocket.
GoodScan is your all-in-one solution for scanning, editing, compressing, and organizing documents and images with ease. Say goodbye to clutter and boost your productivity with GoodScan’s powerful features.
Easily convert Microsoft Office word to PDF and keep all your important documents in one place. GoodScan is your go-to mobile solution for business productivity on the go. With GoodScan, you can scan any paper document, edit and convert it to PDF or other formats in seconds. Fill forms, sign them with your signature, and securely share – all from your phone. This powerful scanner, editor, and converter lets you manage PDF files effortlessly. Whether you need to fill, sign, or organize documents, GoodScan has you covered.
Key Features
- **Scan** – Turn your device into a high-performance scanner. Capture documents, receipts, and photos with exceptional clarity.
- **Edit** – Enhance documents and images with brightness, contrast, and other adjustment tools for perfect readability.
- **OCR (Optical Character Recognition)** – Convert scanned documents and images into editable and searchable text. Extract text effortlessly and save time on manual input.
- **Text Editor** – Edit and format documents directly in the app. Create, modify, and save text files without the need for additional software.
- **Microsoft Word Support** – Open, edit, and save DOCX and DOC files seamlessly. Work with Word documents on the go.

Para advogados, estudantes de Direito,
bluejetty:00133188:ios.description:
A legislação brasileira e a jurisprudência dos tribunais superiores num só app, conferidas todos os dias nas fontes oficiais. Leia todo o acervo de graça; a legislação em vigor abre até sem internet.
Para advogados, estudantes de Direito, concurseiros, candidatos ao Exame da OAB e todos que precisam consultar uma lei com segurança.
O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA
• Constituição Federal e ADCT, com as emendas constitucionais
• 20 códigos: Civil, Processo Civil, Penal, Processo Penal, CLT, CTN, CDC, Trânsito e outros
• Estatutos: OAB, ECA, Pessoa com Deficiência, Cidade, Desarmamento e outros
• Cerca de 14 mil leis ordinárias, 12 mil decretos, 3 mil decretos-leis e 200 leis complementares
• Medidas provisórias, com a situação de cada uma
• Súmulas do STF (inclusive as vinculantes), STJ, TST, TSE, TCU, TNU e OAB
• Teses de repercussão geral do STF; recursos repetitivos e Jurisprudência em Teses do STJ; OJs e precedentes normativos do TST
• Informativos do STF e do STJ, julgado por julgado
• Centenas de milhares de acórdãos do STF e do STJ
• Resoluções, provimentos e recomendações do CNJ
• Enunciados das Jornadas do CJF, do FONAJE e do FONAJEF
• Regimentos internos dos tribunais superiores, do CNJ e do Congresso
• Internacional: cerca de 150 tratados e convenções de direitos humanos, OIT, Mercosul, meio ambiente e justiça penal
• Revogadas: mais de 25 mil normas revogadas, para consulta histórica
SEMPRE ATUALIZADO
Todos os dias conferimos as fontes oficiais, do Planalto aos tribunais. Quando uma norma muda, a nova redação chega ao app sozinha, sem você precisar atualizar nada. E as suas marcações seguem para o mesmo trecho no texto novo.
GRÁTIS
• Leitura de todo o acervo; a legislação em vigor fica no aparelho e abre sem internet
• Busca de leis pelo nome, número ou apelido
• Citações viram links: toque e vá direto ao artigo, ou até ao inciso, citado
• Tabelas e imagens do texto oficial, com zoom
• Compartilhe um artigo por um link que abre no app ou no navegador
VERSÃO PRO
Para estudar
• Marca-texto em 12 cores personalizáveis, além de negrito, sublinhado e riscado
• Notas com formatação em qualquer trecho, e anotações curtas no próprio artigo
• Filtro que mostra só as leis e os artigos que você marcou
• Favoritos organizados em pastas
• Índice por títulos e capítulos, artigos fixados no topo da lei e várias leis abertas em abas
Para pesquisar
• Busca no texto de todas as leis, mesmo sem internet
• Busca dentro da lei aberta, de resultado em resultado
• Busca de jurisprudência por tribunal, relator, órgão julgador, classe, período, tema e legislação citada
• Citado na jurisprudência: a partir de um artigo, veja as decisões que o citam
Para ouvir
• Leitura em áudio dos artigos, com a tela apagada, velocidade até 2x, playlists e a opção de ouvir de um artigo até o fim da lei
E mais
• Atualizações das leis todos os dias
• Sem anúncios
NO IPHONE, NO IPAD E NO MAC
• Com sua conta (Apple, Google ou e-mail), marcações, notas, favoritos e playlists acompanham você no iPhone, iPad, Mac e no navegador, em vademecum.ftapps.com
• No iPad e no Mac, lista de artigos e texto lado a lado
• No iPad, grife com o Apple Pencil enquanto o dedo rola o texto
• Atalhos de teclado para marcar o texto
• Feito também para o iPhone Duo
FALE COM A GENTE
Não encontrou uma norma ou tem uma sugestão? Escreva para support@ftapps.com ou use "Entrar em contato" no app.
ASSINATURAS DA VERSÃO PRO
• Mensal: R$ 29,90
• Anual: R$ 179,90
O pagamento é cobrado na sua conta Apple ao confirmar a compra. A assinatura se renova automaticamente, a menos que a renovação seja desligada até 24 horas antes do fim do período atual; a renovação é cobrada nas 24 horas anteriores ao fim do período. Gerencie a assinatura e desligue a renovação nos ajustes da sua conta Apple, depois da compra.

bluejetty:00130043:ios.description:
Send photos, videos and files to any nearby device
ShareDrop moves files between your iPhone or iPad and any phone, tablet or computer on the same Wi-Fi. No cables, no cloud uploads, and nothing to install on the other device. It just needs a web browser.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose photos, videos or files in ShareDrop.
2. On the other device, scan the QR code or open the link.
3. Enter the 4-digit PIN, and the files arrive.
Receiving works the same way: open the link on the other device and upload files straight to your iPhone.
FEATURES
• Send nearby: share photos, videos and files over your Wi-Fi or Personal Hotspot.
• Receive without an app: the other device just uses its web browser.
• Private by design: each session has its own link and PIN. Files go directly between devices and are never uploaded to our servers.
• AirDrop and share sheet: send to Apple devices with AirDrop, or to Messages, Mail and other apps.
• Compress photos and videos: make files smaller before sending, or keep the originals. Location data is removed by default.
• Scan documents: turn paper into a PDF with the camera. On supported devices, Apple Intelligence suggests a clear name and a short summary.
• Files and history: sent and received files in one place, ready to open, save or share again.
• Send folders: share a whole folder as a single ZIP.
• Share from other apps: send files from any app's share sheet.
FREE vs PREMIUM
• Free: send photos, receive files, scan documents, keep your history, and compress once a day.
• Premium: send videos and any file type, send folders, and compress without limits.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
• ShareDrop Premium is available as a weekly or monthly auto-renewing subscription, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase.
• Some plans include a free trial. If you don't cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, the subscription starts and you're charged.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase.
• Subscriptions renew automatically at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
• Prices are shown in the app and may vary by country.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/sharedropapp/projects
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/sharedropapp/terms
Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00068944:ios.summary: Free Map Tools is a collection of tools based on maps. These tools allow you to perform various functions for a wide range of applications. You can measure distances and areas. You can also send or share the map as an image to indicate the
bluejetty:00068944:ios.description:
Free Map Tools is a collection of tools based on maps. These tools allow you to perform various functions for a wide range of applications. You can measure distances and areas. You can also send or share the map as an image to indicate the area, route or radius you have plotted.
The Radius Around Point tool lets you plot a distance radius on a map. You specify the centre point, the radius and other features such as colour. You can then visualise the radius to see the area covered.
The Measure Distance tool lets you plot a route on a map and find out the distance covered in various units. It also uses your GPS sensor to plot the route automatically.
The Area Calculator Tool lets you draw an area on the map and find the measurement of the area enclosed.
The Find How Far I Can Travel tool will show how far you can drive or walk within a set time. For example, how far can I get if I drive for 60 minutes from my current location.
How Far is it Between allows you to find the road and crow-flies distance between 2 addresses. It also shows both routes on the map.
The Map Tunnelling Tool allows you to find out where on the globe your antipodal point is. You can also find the antipode of any custom location.
Country Specific Tools
———————————————-
For the following countries:
∙USA
∙UK
You can use the following tools:
∙The zip/postcodes found inside a radius
∙The distance between two zip/postcodes

bluejetty:00123948:ios.description:
Online races are here! 
• Introducing HRM TV, the hub for online horse racing!
• Live PVP races occur every 5 minutes!
• Will you be able to top the global leaderboard?
Become the number one horse racing manager to grace the tracks! Race, train, breed from the local derby to the Ultimate Championship.
Compete against other jockeys online from around the globe and compete in new events daily!
FEATURES
RACE:
• Compete in the local derby, circuit, or cup to earn rewards and work your way toward the Ultimate Championship.
• Watch intense and suspenseful races just like the real spectator sport or skip ahead to get back to business.
• Play through a realistic and immersive calendar of races.
• Cross the finish line for a realistic photo finish. Stunning 3D visuals make Horse Racing Manager 2019 the best virtual horse racing simulation experience around!
TRAIN:
• Manage a robust and efficient stable to raise the fiercest of thoroughbreds.
• Boost horse performance stats with food, rest and physical training.
• Improve and upgrade stats through a variety of training methods or breed horses to create the strongest bloodlines.
• Strategize routines that can vary in surface conditions, exertion levels and more.
• Maintain peak performance. Only the best race horse owners know how to keep their horses well rested, at an optimal weight, and race ready.
• Pack a few pounds on with some sugary treats. Try feeding your horse a handful of sugar cubes!
• Unlock additional stable slots to bolster an even more impressive roster of horse racing stars.
BREED:
• Buy, sell and breed horses to participate in competitions and create a powerhouse stable full of speedy candidates.
• Match two horses with favorable traits to inherit special attributes and stats.
• Unlock special genetic traits such as unique colors or super speed using rare breeds
• Carefully breed unique skills that can only be obtained through breeding, and not training.
• Engage in events that can affect special Breeding Rights.
• 3D visuals showcase an impressive variety of unique colors, patterns, and traits acquired through breeding.
CUSTOMIZE:
• Choose a unique look for your jockey and horse with an assortment of options.
• Adjust the outfits, emblems, and colors to suit your own personal taste.
• Bond with every horse in your stable by giving them individual names.
• Experiment with Breeding Rights to produce a foal with special physical traits.
• Create a nurturing environment for your horses to flourish!
Stop just watching the horse races and take part in the action. Saddle up cowboys, because the number one horse racing management sim is here! Can you be a world-class horse racing manager talked about from Kentucky to Epsom!? Become a horse racing legend now!
* PLEASE NOTE! Horse Racing Manager 2025 is free to play, but it contains items that can be purchased for real money.
Meet other players and find out more about Horse Racing Manager:
* Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/horseracingmanager2019
* Twitter: @HRM_2019 (http://twitter.com/HRM_2019)
* Privacy Policy: https://thirdtimegames.com/privacy-policy.html
* Terms of Service: https://thirdtimegames.com/terms-of-service.html

bluejetty:00073931:ios.name: SeaNav US
bluejetty:00073931:ios.summary:
Explore, Plan and Navigate your boating trips in real time and outstanding high-resolution with the latest NOAA Marine charts covering the USA and US Great Lakes.
- Includes all US Coastal, ICW, Inland (USACE) and Great Lakes Digital Vecto
bluejetty:00073931:ios.description:
Explore, Plan and Navigate your boating trips in real time and outstanding high-resolution with the latest NOAA Marine charts covering the USA and US Great Lakes.
- Includes all US Coastal, ICW, Inland (USACE) and Great Lakes Digital Vector Charts
- Buoys, lights etc. are tappable with bearing and distance
- Free Apple Watch app
- Live AIS Ship targets and collision alerts (requires Boat Beacon)
- Seamless panning and zooming across charts
- Unique live Augmented Reality camera view
- Route Planning and tracking with Waypoints, ETA, XTE, etc. plus SeaNav autorouting
- Offline charts
- Route export and import to MFDs and other apps via gpx
- ActiveCaptain Marinas, Anchorage, Hazards and reviews
- US NOAA Raster charts available via IAP
- Canadian charts via IAP
- British Virgin Islands & Bermuda charts via IAP
- External NMEA over Wifi
SeaNav uses Digital Vector charts providing a wealth of benefits and advantages. Buoys, Lights, Bridges, Depth Contours, Depth Soundings, Rocks, Anchorage areas, NOAA Weather Buoys etc. are all selectable and have real time distance, bearing and detail information. Turn off layers to de-clutter the display and only show what is important at the time. Tides, moon and sun times and weather are also all available at your fingertips.
SeaNav’s unique AR view mode allows you to view buoys, lights, ships, waypoints and track overlaid on your iPhone or iPad live camera view. With "AR LockOn" you can select a target on the chart and then be guided to it in the AR camera view.
SeaNav lets you measure distances and bearings and record waypoints on routes. When at sea, the app’s Sailing HUD shows your position, Course over ground (COG), Speed over ground (SOG), Vector Made Good (VMG), Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA), Distance and bearing to next Waypoint. Waypoint reached alerts, auto-routing to the next waypoint and collision alerts.
SeaNav comes with a free Apple Watch companion app . 
Lowrance, Simrad and B&G GoFree support included.
Your purchase of SeaNav includes 12 months of free updates to the included US chart set. Further chart updates are then available via an in-app purchase. Charts for other regions including Canada may also be added to your product via optional in-app purchase.
Our in-app purchases are 1 year subscriptions, which automatically renew at the end of the subscription period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase, and will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Pricing for our 1 year US Charts update subscription is US$9.99.
Subscriptions may be managed by the iTunes account holder and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
 No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
Our Privacy Policy may be accessed via http://seanav.net/privacy.php
Requires iPhone or iPad. GPS only required for real time route navigation. Optional Real time AIS, Tides and Weather information require an active internet connection. 
iPhone devices and iPads with a cellular modem already have a built-in GPS, even if they do not have an active service plan.
If you have a WiFi-only iPad you will need an external GPS receiver or GPS feed to enable navigation.
Please note that continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. 
NOT FOR NAVIGATION 
This program is distributed in the hope that it will be useful. SeaNav should only be used for basic navigation reference and should not be solely relied upon to determine precise locations, proximity, distance, or direction.
Terms of Use: http://seanav.net/termsofuse.php
Privacy Policy: http://seanav.net/privacy.php
Support: help@pocketmariner.com
Third Party Licenses and Notices
NOTICE: US Marine Charts are derived from official NOAA Electronic Navigational Charts.

bluejetty:00171522:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00171522:ios.description:
Road Trip! — Your all-in-one road tripping app.
Plan trips with AI, play 15+ car games, track gas fill-ups, and explore along your route.
Plan Your Perfect Trip
Your AI trip assistant builds a custom day-by-day itinerary based on your interests, dates, and destinations. Get a Budget-to-Comfort cost breakdown across lodging, dining, activities, fuel, tolls, and parking — powered by real driving distances. Add up to 21 days of stops, drag to reorder, generate per-day AI suggestions, and see your route on an interactive map. Every trip includes AI-written tips tailored to your stops and the forecast.
Travel Together
Sign in with Apple to sync trips, favorites, and license plate progress across devices. Invite friends and family to collaborate as editors or viewers, share itineraries with a link, and leave comments on plans.
Discover Along the Way
Browse monthly picks of places and national parks. Search campgrounds, trails, and recreation areas from NPS and Recreation.gov. Find podcasts whose hosts actually talk about the cities on your trip, with one-tap deep links to Apple Podcasts. Save anything you love to Favorites.
Games Built for the Road
• Roadside Rush — Local-network multiplayer party game
• Name That Song — Pick the right album art from 1,000+ tracks
• Guess The Artist — Identify the artist from a blurred cover
• Sound Bite — Name a song from a tiny clip
• Landmark Lightning — Identify landmarks near you
• License Plate Spotting — Track all 50 states, synced across devices
• State Trivia & General Trivia — Holidays, movies, geography, and more
• Know Your Passenger — Multiplayer Would You Rather and Bucket List
• Bingo — Text and road-sign boards
• Guess the Word — Banned-word party game
• Conversation Starters — Shuffled prompt cards
Map & Along-Route Search
View your route on an interactive map with stop pins. Tap a category pill — gas, restaurants, attractions, hotels, rest areas, entertainment, shops — to find POIs along your route. Swipe the carousel to fly between locations and open directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps, or Waze.
Track Every Fill-Up
Log gas stops with price, gallons, odometer, and location. See total spend, average $/gallon, MPG trends, and a price-per-gallon sparkline. Estimate fuel costs for any route with the Gas Calculator.
Stay Informed
Real-time weather with hourly forecasts, 10-day outlooks, severe alerts, drive scores, and AI-generated insights tailored to your route.
Smart Notifications
Trip departure reminders, daily briefings during active trips, gas-log nudges, and monthly destination ideas on the 1st of every month.
Home Screen Widgets
Glanceable widgets for gas tracking, license plate progress, and a map widget with shortcuts to restaurants, gas, hotels, and directions.
Go Pro for the Full Experience
Unlock all music games, unlimited Roadside Rush multiplayer, unlimited AI trip planning and gas calculations, road-sign Bingo, After Dark game packs, higher trip planner limits, and an ad-free experience.
Subscription Information
Road Trip Pro is available through an auto-renewable annual subscription. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://theroadtripapp.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://theroadtripapp.com/terms

bluejetty:00160262:ios.description:
Welcome to Date Match 3D - Triple Game, a new, challenging, and charming triple matching 3D puzzle game.
Date Match 3D is a triple matching game where you need to find identical 3D items among a large array of similar objects, match them in triplets, and eliminate all items to advance to the next level.
In Date Match 3D, you will experience unique triple matching challenges, enjoy exquisite game graphics, and distinctive background images.
Date Match 3D is easy to play and can be opened and enjoyed anytime, anywhere. Its straightforward gameplay makes it perfect for quick sessions or extended play, offering a fun and relaxing experience.
Date Match 3D features numerous levels, each offering a sweet journey. By matching identical 3D items, you can uncover beautiful images in every level and enjoy the excitement each level brings. You can derive a lot of fun from this triple matching puzzle game, and it can also help sharpen your focus and relax your mind.
Dive into an exhilarating world of entertainment with our unique triple match 3D puzzle game. Specifically designed for mature audiences, Date Match 3D offers a thrilling and engaging experience that will keep you captivated for hours.
Game Features for Date Match 3D - Triple Game:
 Triple Match 3D Puzzles: Challenge your brain with 3D puzzles that require sharp thinking and quick reflexes. Match triple identical items to clear the board and progress to the next level.
 High-Definition 3D Visual Effects: Each level is filled with high-definition 3D objects, matching and eliminating them will give you an excellent visual experience.
 Brain Training: Date Match 3D is not only fun but also helps improve your attention.
 Free to Play: Date Match 3D is completely free, allowing you to enjoy the game anytime, anywhere.
 Downloadable Background Images: Each time you complete a level, you will unlock a beautiful background image. These images can be downloaded for free.
 Boosters and Refresh Features: Use boosters and refresh features when facing difficulties to help you pass levels with ease and enjoy a sweet adventure.
 Regular Updates: We’re constantly adding new levels, backgrounds, and features to keep the game fresh and exciting.
How to play Date Match 3D - Triple Game:
 Choose Objects: Select the first 3D object on the screen.
 Match Objects: Select the second and third identical 3D objects and move them to the box at the bottom of the screen to match.
 Clear Levels: Continue matching triple 3D objects until all objects are cleared and the level is completed.
 Unlock Rewards: After completing a level, unlock and download beautiful background images for free.
Are you ready to embark on a romantic and exciting journey? Don't miss out! Download Date Match 3D - Triple Game now and start your enchanting adventure!

bluejetty:00076955:ios.description:
SnapSolver is an AI math scanner and homework helper that turns a photo into a clear, step-by-step answer in seconds. Point your camera at any math problem — algebra, geometry, calculus, or a tricky word problem — and get the full solution with every step explained.
Scan Any Math Problem
Snap a photo of a handwritten or printed problem and SnapSolver reads it instantly, then solves it with step-by-step working you can actually learn from. Stuck on an equation? Just scan it and understand it.
Built for Math First
• Arithmetic, fractions & percentages
• Algebra & equations
• Geometry & trigonometry
• Calculus — derivatives & integrals
• Statistics & probability
• Word problems, graphs & more
Personal AI Tutor — Every Subject
Beyond math, your 24/7 AI tutor helps with:
• Physics, Chemistry & Biology
• Grammar, essays & literature
• History & social studies
• Follow-up questions and simpler explanations until it clicks
Smart Study Tools
• Step-by-step solutions you can follow
• AI-generated quizzes & flashcards to revise
• Custom study plans and practice problems
• Chat history to revisit any solution anytime
• Beautiful LaTeX formatting for complex equations
Why Students Choose SnapSolver
• Instant answers — in seconds, not hours
• Understand the "why," not just the final answer
• Available 24/7, across every subject
• Learn at your own pace and boost your grades
How It Works
1. Snap a photo of your homework problem
2. Our AI instantly reads and solves it
3. Get detailed step-by-step explanations
4. Ask follow-up questions until you understand
5. Master the concept and ace your exams
Download SnapSolver and turn your camera into an instant math tutor.
Note: SnapSolver is designed to help you learn and understand concepts better — use it as a study tool to strengthen your education, not just for answers.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/snapsolver/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/snapsolver/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00070075:ios.description:
Pair Tiles is a classic puzzle game where you have to find matching pairs of pictures that need to be connected with three straight lines and no other cards blocking their path! Can you do it? Challenge your focus and concentration!
Build your skills with over 100 levels! The Pair Tiles puzzle game is a great way to pass the time!
Rules:
– The goal of the game is to find two matching pictures and clear the field before the time runs out.
– You need to use all your attention and concentration.
– Select and connect the matching cards.
– You can also connect the pictures if they aren't next to each other, but the path to them must be free.
Features:
– A great way to strengthen your concentration, attention, and mind
– Shuffle mode
– 100+ levels of challenges and fun
– The ability to change the sets of images
– Unlimited hints if you get stuck
Try it once, and there'll be no stopping you! Make it all the way to level 100!
Whether you're on a long trip or spending a quiet evening at home, the whole family can relax and do a little brain work. It's also a great way to keep your kids occupied. 
Pair Tiles is one of the best matching picture search puzzles to develop kids' concentration and attention!

bluejetty:00044581:ios.description:
Post jobs. Find pros. Discover local deals.
Need a handyman, plumber, electrician, painter or cleaner? Quote It brings local home services together in one marketplace. Post a job and compare quotes, search the Directory for local pros, or browse Deals & Promotions from businesses near you.
Post once. Get multiple quotes.
Tell us what you need done, add photos and post your job. Interested service providers can send you quotes or arrange an in-person estimate. Compare your options, ask questions and choose the right provider for your project.
Find local pros in the Directory
Browse service categories and find local service providers on a map or in a list. Explore business profiles, ratings, reviews, services and completed work. Contact providers directly about your project, even without posting a job.
Discover local Deals & Promotions
Explore offers from local businesses for home maintenance, repairs, cleaning, renovations and more. Browse promotion details and message the provider to discuss the offer, availability and your needs. Available offers vary by location and provider.
Compare your options
Review provider profiles, customer ratings and completed jobs before deciding who to hire. Keep your quote conversations together and confirm pricing, availability and job details directly with your chosen provider.
Home services for everyday jobs and bigger projects
Find help with plumbing, electrical work, handyman jobs, house cleaning, painting, landscaping, lawn care, roofing, renovations, window and gutter cleaning, junk removal, moving, appliance repairs and more.
Support local businesses
Discover service providers working in your community. From routine maintenance to home improvement projects, Quote It helps you connect with businesses serving your area.
For service providers
Grow your local service business with Quote It. Find nearby job opportunities, submit quotes and connect with potential clients.
Build your business profile, showcase your services and completed work, and get discovered in the Directory. Create Deals & Promotions to introduce your services to nearby clients and keep your business visible.
Service-provider connections and some features may require credits or a subscription. See in-app pricing for details.
Download Quote It to post your next job, find local pros and discover offers near you.

-----
"The best new controller on the market." - Charlie
bluejetty:00129220:ios.description:
SmoothTrack 2.0 uses the head and eye tracking AR capabilities of your phone to provide the simplest and best head tracker for 6 degrees-of-freedom head movements in your sim games.
-----
"The best new controller on the market." - Charlie Hall, Polygon
Customer reviews:
"SmoothTrack just works. Less than 5 minutes to install, setup and fly. Love not being tethered to my desk! 5 stars!!"
"This worked perfectly and way better than expected! Totally enhanced my experience with MFS 2020!"
---
It's a near magical experience to seamlessly slightly move your head and have your game perspective immediately play along (the movements in the game are exaggerated so that you only have to make slight movements of your head to control the camera). Additionally, since version 2, your eyes are also optionally tracked and will nudge the camera based on where you're glancing on screen!
 - Simply lean forward to get a closer look at your Flight Simulator cockpit!
 - Look a bit up to see the overhead panel of your A320!
 - Simply shift your head a bit to the right to see the direction of the space station you're approaching in Elite: Dangerous!
 - Look a bit left before a hard left turn in Euro Truck Simulator 2!
No headset or extra equipment of any kind is required! Simply set up your device so that it can see your face. Using simple camera gestures, you can shift your perspective in-game. Also, if you want, you can store views (say, a copilot angle, or a cockpit closeup) as Quick Views for easy access later.
Your head movements are slightly exaggerated which enables you to look out of a cockpit side window with just a slight movement of your head to the left.
Any game that supports the FreeTrack or TrackIR protocol will work with this, including:
- Microsoft Flight Simulator
- Microsoft FSX
- DCS World
- Elite: Dangerous
- IL2: Sturmovik
- Euro Truck Simulator 2
- Kerbal Space Program
- ...and many, many others!
Email and Discord support is provided if there are any issues (or if you have any ideas for new features!).

House cleaning services

bluejetty:00151217:ios.description:
Book house cleaning in a tap. Ezi Home Services matches you with vetted local cleaners, shows your price upfront, and handles payment in the app. No calls, no waiting on quotes.
House cleaning services
• Regular house and apartment cleaning, one-time or recurring: weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly. Recurring cleans save up to 10%.
• Tidying and organizing included in every regular clean
• Deep cleaning for a top-to-bottom reset
• Move-in and move-out cleaning for renters, buyers, and landlords
• Short-term rental turnover cleaning, with optional linen laundering, guest restocking, and trash removal
• Post-construction cleaning
• Add-ons: inside the oven, inside the fridge, tile grout, baseboards, wall and door spot-cleaning, windows, basement, and garage
• Request a female cleaner, when available
Why homeowners book with Ezi
• Instant, upfront price before you book
• Every cleaner is vetted and verified
• Same-day cleaning when providers are available
• Secure in-app payment, no cash
• Real-time booking and tracking
• Not happy with your clean? We'll come back and re-clean.
• Rebook the provider you like in a tap
How it works
1. Pick a cleaning type and tell us about your home.
2. See your price and choose a date and time.
3. Book and get matched with a vetted provider.
Cities we serve
House cleaning in Miami and North Dallas (McKinney, Frisco, Plano, Allen, and Prosper), plus Toronto, Montreal, Ottawa, Gatineau, and Surrey in Canada.
In Canada, Ezi also books snow removal and lawn care (Toronto, Montreal, and Ottawa), car detailing (Toronto and Ottawa), and window and gutter cleaning (Ottawa).
Post-construction cleaning is available in Miami, North Dallas, Ottawa, and Surrey. Services vary by city; the app shows what's available at your address.
Questions
How much does house cleaning cost?
You see your price in the app before you book. It's based on your bedrooms, bathrooms, cleaning type, and add-ons.
Can I book a same-day cleaning?
Yes, when a provider is available in your area.
Do I need to provide cleaning supplies?
No. Supplies are included by default, and you can remove them at booking to lower your price.
Do you clean apartments and condos?
Yes. Houses, apartments, and condos are all priced by bedrooms and bathrooms.
Can I keep the same cleaner?
Yes. Rebook the provider you like in a tap, when they're available.
Download Ezi and book your first cleaning in under a minute.

bluejetty:00175435:ios.description:
The Epoch Times, as a thoughtful alternative to your daily news stream, puts the most recent authentic news in your hands. Using The Epoch Times app, you can stay up to date on world events wherever you are, even while driving or waiting in the most convenient way.
The Epoch Times app serves you with trusted news wherever you are. Get instant access to award-winning journalism, breaking, political, US, China, and world news, as well as stories on arts and culture, and more.
With The Epoch Times app you will have access to all of our digital content, including in-depth coverage of US politics, reporting on China. You will also get access to our premium shows such as American Thoughts Leaders, Crossroads, China in Focus, Facts Matter, The Larry Elder Show, Health Care, as well as commentaries and documentaries on issues that matter. There is special coverage updated regularly on trending topics. 
Download The Epoch Times app to experience our digital publishing platform.

• Top Section: See all important events and hot topics in the US, China, and around the world at a glance.
• Breaking News alerts: Get the latest news in a timely manner as they occur.
• Livestream Notification: Watch live broadcasts of major events in the US and around the world. 
• Video Section: Enjoy exclusive, original series, inspiring videos as well as documentaries. Users can view trailers automatically to grasp overview.
• Opinion: Read political, social, and personal commentaries.
• Easily share stories on all major social media platforms such as Twitter and Facebook as well as via email or text message. 
• Text-to-audio: Listen to articles wherever you are.
• Save Articles: Save articles and videos to your reading list.
• Offline: Read articles and watch videos on your saved list offline.
• Notification Center: See all of the day’s most important news at a glance.
• Adjust font size in articles.
• Dark mode.

We are working hard to ensure our readers have an excellent experience using our app. If you have any questions about how the app works, want to provide us with insightful feedback, or experience any technical difficulties such as crashes, please contact us at in-app.feedback@epochtimes.com. Manage your business payments from anywhere with Payoneer, the ultimate platform for global payment solutions. Tailored for small to medium-sized businesses (SMBs), corporate entities, and entrepreneurs, Payoneer makes international money transfers and online payment processing seamless, secure, and cost-effective.
Why Choose Payoneer?
Receive Payments Globally.
Effortlessly send money overseas or receive payments in popular currencies like USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, and more. With Payoneer, you’ll gain access to international payment gateway solutions specifically designed for SMBs. Whether you’re paying service providers, suppliers, or contractors, Payoneer’s payment solutions ensure smooth, reliable transactions in over 200 countries. Enjoy fast and affordable digital payment options that help you avoid high fees and delays—allowing your business to operate efficiently.

Leverage seller-specific features like VAT payments in multiple countries and working capital offers for platforms like Amazon and Walmart. Easily scale your business with immediate access to funds while ensuring ongoing cash flow efficiency.
Why Download the Payoneer App?
The Payoneer app makes managing your global payment solutions more convenient than ever. Oversee international money transfers and monitor payment solutions directly from your smartphone, bringing flexibility to your financial operations.
Reliable Customer Support
Our multilingual team is available 24/7 to assist with your digital payment solutions in over 20 languages. Whether you’re troubleshooting or have questions, we’re always just a click away.
Get Started Today
Join millions of businesses worldwide already using Payoneer to simplify their international money transfers and enhance their growth. Download the app now to unlock the power of a truly efficient global payment platform!

bluejetty:00069706:ios.name: Plant Daddy — Water Reminders
bluejetty:00069706:ios.summary: Plant Daddy helps you to care for your plants. It’s a beautiful, modern app that allows you to add your plants, record notes such as care information, and schedule water reminders. It’s that simple! You don’t even need to create an account.
bluejetty:00069706:ios.description:
Plant Daddy helps you to care for your plants. It’s a beautiful, modern app that allows you to add your plants, record notes such as care information, and schedule water reminders. It’s that simple! You don’t even need to create an account.
Plant Daddy is focused and intuitive. It intentionally does not include features like plant identification, care suggestions, light detection, etc. Other apps and websites can accomplish those needs. This is your cute little place to store your own information, get reminded when it’s time to water, and admire your lovely collection.
How to Use
‣ Add a plant, give it a name, and preferably a gorgeous photo
‣ Enter any notes you’d like to reference such as care instructions, light requirements, soil needs, etc
‣ Maybe add more information such as the date planted, scientific name, location, etc
‣ Set how often you’d like to water your plant and a notification will be sent when it's watering time
Features
‣ Liquid Glass design
‣ Dark mode
‣ Customizable app icon
‣ Sort and Filter options
‣ Calendar: see when your plants were watered and upcoming water reminders
‣ Notifications: mark your plant watered right from the notification, even on Apple Watch
‣ Widgets: add your plants to your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy
‣ Image Playground: create stylized images for your plants 
‣ Siri: Hey Siri, water Snake Plant in Plant Daddy
‣ Shortcuts: automate actions like Create Plant, Edit Plant, Find Plants, Water Plant, and more
‣ iCloud: your plants automatically sync and are backed up
‣ Home Screen quick actions: add a new plant and customize the app icon
‣ Universal app available for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro
‣ Menu bar, keyboard shortcuts, and multiple windows on iPad
‣ No ads, no tracking, no subscriptions
Pricing
‣ Keep track of up to 4 plants for free
‣ Have a bunch of plants? Unlock the All The Plants! in-app purchase to add your entire collection
‣ Really love the app? Tips are much appreciated and help support future development
I hope this app helps you to care for your plants! Cuz hunny we stan a plant daddy.

- Pain Relief: Alleviate discomfort in key areas like the lower back, neck, hips, and shoulders.

bluejetty:00120428:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00120428:ios.description:
Are websites and social media apps blocked? Is your network unusually slow? Run OONI Probe to find out!
With this app, you will examine the blocking of websites and instant messaging apps, measure your network's speed and performance, and check whether systems that could be responsible for censorship and surveillance are in your network.
OONI Probe is developed by the Open Observatory of Network Interference (OONI), a free software project (under The Tor Project) that aims to uncover internet censorship around the world.
Since 2012, OONI’s global community has collected millions of network measurements from more than 200 countries, shedding light on multiple cases of network interference.
▶ Collect evidence of internet censorship
You can check whether and how websites and instant messaging apps are blocked. The network measurement data you will collect may serve as evidence of internet censorship.
▶ Detect systems responsible for censorship and surveillance
OONI Probe tests are also designed to uncover the presence of systems (middleboxes) that could be responsible for censorship and surveillance.
▶ Measure the speed and performance of your network
You can measure the speed and performance of your network by running OONI's implementation of the Network Diagnostic Test (NDT). You can also measure video streaming performance with the Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP (DASH) test.
▶ Open data
OONI publishes network measurement data because open data allows third parties to verify OONI findings, conduct independent studies, and answer other research questions. Openly publishing OONI data also helps increase transparency of internet censorship around the world. You can explore and download OONI data here: https://ooni.io/data/
▶ Free software
All OONI Probe tests (including our NDT and DASH implementations), are based on free and open source software. You can find OONI software projects on GitHub: https://github.com/ooni. Curious to learn how OONI Probe tests work? Learn more: https://ooni.io/nettest/
To receive updates from the OONI-verse, follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/OpenObservatory

bluejetty:00016308:ios.description:
Dominoes is one of the most played board games in the world. We worked hard to offer you a free and exceptional game experience. Enjoy the clean, easy to use interface, the fast and smooth game animations, and the self adjustable intelligence or your opponent. You can choose between the three most played game versions: All Fives, Draw Dominoes and Block Dominoes. This board game is also called muggins, dominos, domino and the tiles are sometimes referred to as bones.
To succeed you need logical reasoning and luck. Practice certainly will take you far! 
The game consists of 28 dominoes. Each domino is a rectangle divided into two square ends. Each end has a number of pips (or spots) ranging from 0 to 6.
The goal is basically to achieve a certain score. You must match the same number of pips on one end of a tile to another equivalent number of a tile available on the end of a branch on the board. You have to get rid of all the tiles you hold before your opponent.
VIP Subscription is the best way to enjoy your Dominoes game. You will have access to exciting new game themes without any advertisement interruptions. You can subscribe for a term of one week, one month, six months and one year. The weekly cost is $4.99, the monthly cost is $4.99, the six-months cost is $19.99 and the one-year cost is $29.99. Prices may vary and actual charges may be converted to other currencies depending on the country of residency. Payment is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation. Subscription is renewed unless turned off at least twenty-four hours before the period ends. You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription through iTunes(https://support.apple.com/HT202039). Dominoes is one of the most played board games in the world. We worked hard to offer you a free and exceptional game experience. Enjoy the clean, easy to use interface, the fast and smooth game animations, and the self adjustable intelligence or your opponent. You can choose between the three most played game versions: All Fives, Draw Dominoes and Block Dominoes. This board game is also called muggins, dominos, domino and the tiles are sometimes referred to as bones.

To succeed you need logical reasoning and luck. Practice certainly will take you far! 

The game consists of 28 dominoes. Each domino is a rectangle divided into two square ends. Each end has a number of pips (or spots) ranging from 0 to 6.

The goal is basically to achieve a certain score. You must match the same number of pips on one end of a tile to another equivalent number of a tile available on the end of a branch on the board. You have to get rid of all the tiles you hold before your opponent.

bluejetty:00041822:ios.description:
Classic Mahjong Puzzle Adventure – A Timeless Puzzle Journey!
Are you ready to challenge your mind and embark on a relaxing yet exciting puzzle-solving journey? Classic Mahjong:Solitaire Game brings the classic tile-matching game to life with hundreds of carefully crafted levels, stunning visuals, and a deeply immersive experience. Whether you're a seasoned Mahjong master or a beginner looking to enjoy a relaxing game, this is the perfect place to test your skills!
- Classic Mahjong with a Modern Twist!
Classic Mahjong:Solitaire Game is a beloved game known for its simple yet deeply engaging gameplay. Your goal is to match identical tiles and clear the board. Sounds easy? Think again! Each level is a puzzle that requires strategy, skill, and a keen eye for patterns. The tiles are stacked in complex formations, and only open tiles can be matched. With limited moves and various layouts, every game presents a fresh and exciting challenge.
- How to Play
*Find and match identical Mahjong tiles.
*Only unblocked tiles (with at least one free side) can be selected.
*Clear all tiles from the board to win the level.
*Use hints or shuffles if you get stuck.
*Progress through increasingly difficult levels and become a Mahjong master!
 - Features That Make Classic Mahjong:Solitaire Game Special
* Hundreds of Levels – From simple layouts for beginners to intricate patterns for Mahjong experts, enjoy a variety of levels that test your skills.
* Beautiful Tile Designs – Traditional Chinese-inspired tiles meet modern aesthetics. Customize your tiles and backgrounds to create your perfect Mahjong experience.
* Relaxing Yet Challenging – The game is designed to provide a stress-free experience while keeping your mind engaged. No timers mean you can play at your own pace.
* Power-Ups & Boosters – Stuck on a tricky level? Use helpful tools like the Shuffle, Hint, or Undo to keep progressing.
- Tips & Strategies
*Start by clearing the top layers first to uncover hidden tiles.
*Focus on unlocking pairs that reveal more options.
*Keep an eye on patterns and avoid dead ends.
*Use hints wisely—sometimes, patience is the key to solving a tough board.
*Replay levels to improve your strategy and achieve a three-star rating!
- Play, Win, and Collect Rewards!
Complete levels to earn coins and unlock special rewards. Collect unique tile sets, backgrounds, and special game boosters. Participate in limited-time events to get even more prizes!
- Download Now and Begin Your Mahjong Journey!
Join thousands of players worldwide and experience the best Mahjong Solitaire game with Classic Mahjong:Solitaire Game! Whether you're looking for a relaxing escape or a mental workout, this game has something for everyone.
Play now and become the ultimate Mahjong master!

Choose Dot & Key for skincare that actually works:
At Dot & Key, we’re all about thoughtful formulas powered by science-backed actives and juicy fresh fruits. Every product is made with your skin’s unique needs in mind — no fluff, no false promises, just skin-loving solutions that do what they say. Here’s a peek at what you’ll find inside the app:
Moisturizers: Say hello to your holy grail hydration! Whether your skin craves deep nourishment or lightweight refreshment, our moisturizers are crafted to balance, hydrate and glow up your skin — without the greasy after-feel.
Sunscreens: Protection that doesn’t feel like a chore. Our sunscreens are lightweight, non-sticky, hydrating and leave no white cast — perfect for daily use, even under makeup. Because SPF should feel as good as it works.

Body Care: Smooth, nourish and glow from neck to toe. Our body lotions and shower gels are enriched with skin-loving ingredients blended with actives that tackle concerns while turning your daily routine into a spa-like ritual.
Hair Care: Scalp-focused, strand-loving. Our shampoos, conditioners and masks are gentle yet effective — targeting dandruff, dryness, and hair fall while leaving your hair soft, healthy and manageable.
Whether you’re building a full routine or just adding a skin treatment or both, we’re here to help you find your skin’s happy place.
So go on — explore, discover, and glow with confidence.
Got something to say? We’re always listening at care@dotandkey.com or on 03340100916.
Download the app & say hello to your best skin ever.

bluejetty:00087366:ios.description:
A Talent Calculator for World of Warcraft Classic, with a native look for a premium mobile experience. Classic Talent Calculator allows you to theory-craft and manage all of your Classic WoW talent builds, supporting Forever, Vanilla, Season of Discovery, The Burning Crusade, Wrath of the Lich King and Cataclysm
* Use the version menu to choose a Classic game type
* Select a new build or a previously saved build.
* Tap, swipe, long press or use the tooltip scroller to add or remove talents points.
* Colour coding of talents indicates its current status:
*** Grey: talent is currently unavailable
*** Green: talent allocation can be adjusted
*** Yellow: no more points can currently be added to the talent
*** Orange: points cannot currently be removed from the talent
* Talent details can be shown or hidden at the bottom of the page, either by tapping on the hide/show icon or by tapping on the background
* Talent details indicate any additional requirements before talent can be adjusted.
* Choose runes and check out spoilers for Classic Era Season of Discovery
* Choose glyphs for Classic Cataclysm
* Builds can be saved with talents orders, rune selections and notes. These can be later modifier or deleted.
This app is supported by advertising, with a paid option to remove.
We hope you enjoy using our app, and welcome feedback.

- World of Warcraft and Warcraft are trademarks or registered trademarks of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc., in the U.S. and/or other countries.

You start in a small city that needs to be supplied with goods. Boo
bluejetty:00019362:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Rail Nation. Here YOU will become a railway tycoon! Enter the transport simulation and discover the globally popular strategy game, train by train.
You start in a small city that needs to be supplied with goods. Boost the economy to make the city – and your railway company – grow fast. Experience the history of railways in six authentic eras. Research modern technologies and choose from 150 realistic engines and trains. Feel the power of your team: Get together with other players in corporations, dominate your game world, and lead your city to victory! 
Find the right tactics, build your railway empire, and become a successful entrepreneur.
Features:
• Realistic economy simulation: Pay attention to supply and demand, consider production times, and smartly trade 48 different goods.
• Cooperation and competition: Play with other players in corporations and become a powerful alliance to beat the competition.
• Real-time calculation system: Make decisions throughout the day.
• 6 eras of railway history: Experience historic steam engines, powerful diesel engines, and ultramodern electric engines. All trains are modeled with great attention to detail.
• 3 different scenarios: Play Classic on a fantasy map featuring 50 cities. Fight for supremacy in the battle of East vs. West on the USA map. Travel through Europe in Steam over Europe and bring the continent to prosperity.
• Also on your PC: Playable in a browser on your PC or Mac with the same account!
Issues & Questions: https://support.rail-nation.com/
Blog: https://blog.rail-nation.com/
Community Discord: https://discord.gg/railnation
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RailNation
T&Cs: https://agb.traviangames.com/terms-en.pdf
Requirements
Recommended: Dual Core CPU, 1.5 GB RAM
Rail Nation can be downloaded and played for free. Some in-game features may be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this function, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. A network connection is required.

bluejetty:00082635:ios.description:
Explore Monster High with your Best Boos and discover frightful fashions, mad science experiments, and more!
Join Draculaura, Clawdeen Wolf, Frankie Stein & more familiar friends on an interactive and skele-fun adventure!
Let your inner monster shine in this fun, creative and imaginative kids game.
BE YOURSELF. BE UNIQUE. BE A MONSTER.
Discover the ghoulest high school around! Play and create your own screamworthy stories, or re-create your favorite Monster High moments.
BOOLICIOUS COOKING
Visit the Creepateria for a bite and try out some fangtastic food! Experiment, combine and make spook-tacular potions or ingredients to create ghoul-icous recipes.
SCARY CUTE STYLES
Mix and match frightful fashions to create haunt couture looks! Explore your unique freaky-fab style.
EXPLORE MONSTER HIGH
The Boo Crew is waiting for you! Every room is full of clawsome activities and scream-tastic surprises to discover.
FANGTASTIC FUN
Express yourself and skelebrate what makes you unique in this virtual immersive world. This interactive Monster High game is easy and fun to play for girls & boys of all ages.
ABOUT MONSTER HIGH
Monster High is one of the most successful and beloved kids’ properties of all time, featuring a world of fangtastic characters that embrace what makes them unique and rally people everywhere to be yourself, be unique, and be a monster. In this reimagined world, being called “four eyes” is a badge of honor and “mummy issues” are par for the course. The Boo Crew—Clawdeen Wolf, Draculaura, Frankie Stein, and more are not just attending Monster High; they’re shattering expectations, shaking up the status quo, and celebrating what makes them special.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
- This app may offer monthly or yearly subscriptions
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
- You can cancel your subscription at any time, but please note that you will not get a refund for any remaining period of a subscription
PRIVACY & ADVERTISING
Budge Studios takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps are compliant with privacy laws. This application has received the “ESRB Privacy Certified Kids’ Privacy Seal”. Read our privacy policy at: https://budgestudios.com/en/legal/privacy-policy/, or email our Data Protection Officer at: privacy@budgestudios.ca

Budge Studios was founded in 2010 with the mission to entertain and educate boys and girls around the world, through innovation, creativity and fun. Its high-quality app portfolio consists of original and branded properties, including Disney Frozen, Bluey, Barbie, PAW Patrol, Monster High, Thomas & Friends, Transformers, My Little Pony, Strawberry Shortcake, Miraculous, Caillou, The Smurfs, Miss Hollywood, Hello Kitty and Crayola. Budge Studios maintains the highest standards of safety and age-appropriateness, and has become a global leader in children’s apps for smartphones and tablets.

bluejetty:00086766:ios.description:
O Shell Box está de cara nova, mas segue transformando a sua forma de abastecer. Abasteça nos postos Shell, acumule pontos, aproveite benefícios exclusivos e economize a cada abastecimento com um app feito para facilitar a sua rotina.
Cansou de pegar filas na hora de abastecer? Com o Shell Box, além de pagar sem filas pelo celular, você ganha benefícios exclusivos! Aproveite para pagar com descontos especiais e trocar seus pontos Stix em parceiros.
Ganhe mais agilidade no abastecimento nos postos Shell, faça o pagamento de combustível direto pelo aplicativo e tenha muito mais benefícios.
Shell Box Clube e pontos stix
O Shell Box oferece o Shell Box Clube, o programa de fidelidade do aplicativo. Ao abastecer e pagar com Shell Box, o usuário:
- Junta pontos stix automaticamente
- Sobe de nível dentro do programa
- Pode trocar seus pontos em todos os parceiros Stix
- Tem acesso a benefícios e descontos exclusivos no app
O Shell Box Clube valoriza quem utiliza o aplicativo com frequência, oferecendo uma experiência mais completa e personalizada nos postos Shell.
Encontre postos Shell mais perto
O Shell Box funciona em diversos postos Shell espalhados pelo Brasil, ajudando o usuário a localizar postos próximos, abastecer com praticidade e gerenciar pagamentos de combustível em um único aplicativo.
Cada abastecimento pago com Shell Box contribui para uma jornada contínua de benefícios por meio do Shell Box Clube e dos pontos Stix.
Veja como abastecer e aproveitar o Shell Box Clube:
1. Baixe o aplicativo Shell Box, faça seu cadastro e adicione seus dados e forma de pagamento.
2. Vá até um posto Shell participante para abastecer.
3. Clique em “Abastecer” e digite o código de pagamento ao lado da bomba.
4. Quando o abastecimento for concluído, é só finalizar o pagamento. Pronto! Assim, você também começa a acumular pontos no Shell Box Clube!
Pronto! Além de concluir o abastecimento, você começa a acumular pontos no Shell Box Clube e pontos Stix, aproveitando os benefícios disponíveis no app.

The Niyo card is the only international credit and debit card you’ll need to make international payments without paying any forex charges. It is perfect for leisure & business travellers, as well as students studying abroad. Zero forex markup* Niyo cards are delivered in just 3-5 days, with an option of 24 hour delivery in select metros. Niyo cards are better than regular prepaid travel forex cards for international travellers.
Why choose Niyo?
• Zero forex markup* on all international transactions: Save up to 5%
• Forex Cash at zero forex markup & free door delivery
• Niyo Express 24-hour card delivery: Assisted KYC at doorstep and instant card hand over & set-up 
• 1 free lounge access abroad each quarter# at 1300+ airports
• 1 free international ATM withdrawal each quarter#
• Add money in INR & use in 180+ countries
• Card delivery in 3-5 days
• Coins: Unique rewards program
• UPI payments with Niyo Pay
• ATM Locator to withdraw cash globally
• Currency Converter for live forex rates
• International eSIM with affordable plans in 120+ countries
• Flight bookings with zero convenience fee#
• Visa bookings at lowest market rate and full assistance
• Hotel bookings at exclusive properties at lowest rates
• Travel insurance with 99.9% instant policy assurance
• Utility Bill Payments with coin rewards
• 24/7 chat support irrespective of time zone
Niyo Express: Be travel ready in 24 hours!
With Niyo Express*, we send an expert to your doorstep for a quick, seamless KYC and card delivery, right from the comfort of your home. It’s fast, easy, and efficient!
- Free doorstep KYC by an expert
- Assisted card set-up to make it travel-ready
- Premium support throughout
*Available in select cities
How to open a Niyo account if Niyo Express is not available in your city?
Time: Less than 5 minutes
Documents: PAN, Aadhaar, Indian Passport
• Download the Niyo App
• Verify your Mobile Number and Email ID
• Verify your Passport & Aadhaar details
• Capture a quick selfie & enter your details
• Complete your 3-minute Video KYC
• Your Savings Account will be ready & card will be delivered in 3-5 days
The INR-based Niyo card takes away the need for a multi currency account & multi currency card. You can add money to your card in INR and transact in the currency of your destination abroad. Once you’re back in India, you can continue to use your card for domestic offline and online transactions. 
The Niyo Card is the only debit or credit card you will need to save up to 5% during your travels abroad.
Note: Niyo digital savings accounts and credit and debit cards are in partnership with DCB Bank and SBM Bank (India).
Download the app and experience the sheer brilliance of zero forex markup international debit & credit cards with Niyo!
*T&C apply
Got questions? Reach out to us at global@goniyo.com
