Instantly Hire a Coach for Remote Stroke Analysis Lesson & Live Video Consult. Connect to Top Coaches including ATP & WTA Coaches.
FCT is cutting edge technology where you can seamlessly connect to WTA & ATP Coaches who work with the current stars on the Pro tour today to help you with your game. FCT is also a Coaching platform for all coaches at any level to use to increase their revenues with in-app virtual lessons and build their base of followers by posting on the Full Court Feed to our 15 channels with various tennis subjects with 5 levels of play. Players at any level can Hire a Coach for an in-app lesson or have their current coach connect freely for Live Video Call or Stroke Analysis Lesson the same as a Hired Lesson.
What can you do with Full Court Tennis?
As a Player
Hire a Coach for a Live Video Call Lesson
• Review any match or practice session on the in-app call
• Coach can go over digital strokes taken with app
• Compare your strokes side by side to those in our FCT Pro Library
• Once booked you can also do the Live Video Call on the FullCourtTennis.com website 
Hire a Coach for a Remote Stroke Analysis Lesson
• Instantly you have a private lesson space to send your video to your coach
• Coach will voice over and or annotate and compare it and send it back
Message
• Text any User in app
• Send any User video in-app
• Privacy Allow & Block list 
Full Court Feed for Coach and Player 
• Anyone can post to the Full Court Feed (freemium)
• 15 channels with various tennis subjects to which users can post 
• 5 Levels of play to search 
• Full social media 
• Follow, learn, and interact 
• Once you follow a Coach or Player they go to your Feed 
• Post publicly or private
As a Coach 
• Set your rates and availability 
• Set your Payout info on Stripe
• Get Hired for Live Video Call Lessons
• Get Hired for Stroke Analysis Lessons
Coach’s Choice
• On Train Now a Coach can also Start a Free Stroke Analysis Lesson
• On Train Now a Coach can aslo Start a Free Live Video Call Lesson 
• Privacy-Player and Coach can set for Allow or Block list or leave it open to all
Pro Library 
• Rent FCT Pro Clips monthly to compare your strokes side by side 
My library 
• Take a video and store it in my library 
• Digitally manipulate draw, voice over and compare 
• Self-Learn and compare your stokes to those in our FCT Pro Library 
• Tools to organize your Library 
• Full Social Media sharing 
Branding 
Contact fct@fullcourttennis.com for details for any organizational branding of watermarks with multiple users.
About FCT
FCT’s Founder is Brian Teacher who won the Australian Open and who has coached extensively on the ATP and WTA tours and has developed many world class juniors along the way.
“I found it difficult to learn the game with all its technique and nuances and wanted to make great coaching accessible to anyone instantly.”
FCT Advisory Board: John McEnroe, Katrina Adams and AI scientist Dr David Fogle.
Simple Pricing 
Our free package allows for all users to always be able to post, learn and interact with the coaches and players on our Full Court Feed plus Welcome period extras.
Players subscription will be $1.99 a month and will come with some video storage, tip of the day and the opportunity to have some Free Live Video Call and Stroke Analysis Lessons.
Coach’s subscription will be $4.99 a month and will allow the coach to store some video taken with the app in their in-app, enable the coach to give Hired & Limited Free Lessons.
FCT Pro Library
Each Pro Player in the FCT Pro Library has a set of stroke clips that is available for monthly rental as a side by side comparison to self-learn or use as a coaching tool in an annotated comparison.
FCT will be adding Female Pro Tennis Players along with more Pro Men Players.
Terms of Use: https://fct-mob-pub.s3.amazonaws.com/fct/doc/terms/03_FCT_All_Terms.pdf

bluejetty:00186641:ios.description:
Améliorez-vous en langue française en un temps record grâce à digiSchool Orthographe, l'application de révision d'orthographe la plus aboutie ! 
Réalisée avec Aurore Ponsonnet, formatrice en orthographe (et formatrice de formateurs en orthographe !), vous pourrez voir ou revoir toutes les notions indispensables pour maîtriser la langue française. Les contenus sont tous validés par le comité d'experts du Projet Voltaire.
Des nombreux cours, fiches et quiz dans les thématiques suivantes sont disponibles : grammaire, conjugaison, orthographe grammaticale ou lexicale, vocabulaire, ponctuation...
Pour ne plus faire d'erreurs d'orthographe, téléchargez gratuitement l'application superOrthographe by digiSchool.
Vous trouverez même des dictées qui vous aideront à pratiquer la rédaction ainsi que des réponses à toutes vos questions fréquentes d'orthographe parmi nos contenus.
Parmi les quiz disponibles : des QCM, des textes à trous (choisissez la bonne réponse pour compléter une phrase), et même des champs à saisir sans faire de faute !
Nos conditions générales d'utilisation et la gestion de la propriété privée :
https://www.digischool.fr/conditions-generales-d-utilisation.html
Abonnez-vous dès maintenant pour accéder à tous les quiz et leçons d'orthographe, ainsi qu'aux entraînements.
Quatre formules d'abonnement sont disponibles : 
- digiSchool Pass 1 mois : 9,99 € /mois (sans engagement)
- digiSchool Pass 1 an : 79,99 € /mois 
- superOrthographe 1 mois : 3,99 € /semaine (sans engagement)
- superOrthographe 1 semaine : 6,99 € /mois (sans engagement)
Votre abonnement sera automatiquement renouvelé jusqu'à la résiliation, qui doit se faire au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période d'abonnement en cours. 
Contactez-nous par email : contact@digischool.fr

bluejetty:00086226:ios.description:
¡Mi HEB app está aquí! Para hacer aún más fácil la compra de tu súper en línea sin salir de casa o aprovechar la vuelta en la ciudad y de paso, poder recogerlo.
¿Te gustan las Historias? Encontrarás noticias, consejos, información y mucho más en la sección de nuestras H-E-B Stories.
AHORRARÁS TIEMPO Y DINERO
 • ¿No quieres salir de casa? Listo, recibe el súper en tu puerta.
 • ¿Vas por los niños a la escuela o sales del trabajo? Optimiza el tiempo y recogerlo en tu auto, con Pick & Go, ¡Fácil!
 • ¿Te gusta planear tu súper o sabes que la leche se acaba cada viernes? Haz una lista semanal, mensual, para la abuelita o tus hijos, práctico ¿no?
 • Ahora, ¿qué quieres ahorrar? ¿descuentos? aquí encontrarás promociones, cupones y ofertas personalizadas para ti.
 • ¿HEB Lover? es decir, pides más una vez al mes, con Prime tienes envíos ilimitados.
Espera, aún hay más…
AQUÍ LAS CARACTERÍSTICAS
 • H-E-B Stories. ¡Historias justo como en tu red social favorita!
 • Utiliza tu código de descuentos desde tu Cuenta en cada visita a tienda. ¡Ahorra con tu app!
 • Cupones semanales y promociones fáciles de agregar a tu carrito
 • Folleto semanal de promociones. ¡Compártelo con quien desees!
 • Historial de pedidos
 • Productos que solo encontrarás en línea y no en tienda, ¡un catálogo extendido para ti!
 • Pedidos Pick & Go: Pide en la app y recoge en tienda
 • Servicio a Domicilio

Sort shiny coins by color and size, merge matching stacks, and watch the board clear with smooth, realistic motion. The simple drag-and-drop mechanics and beautiful design make this one of the most soothing and rewarding sorting puzzles you’ll ever play.

 • Easy to play but hard to master
 • Beautiful colors and smooth coin physics
 • Satisfying sorting and merging loops
 • Short levels for quick relaxing sessions
 • Works offline — play anytime, anywhere
Coin Jam is designed for anyone who enjoys sorting, merging, matching, or organizing puzzles. It’s the perfect blend of calm visuals, clear logic, and the satisfying sound of progress. Each session delivers focus and relaxation — ideal for unwinding, training your brain, or finding flow.

bluejetty:00123586:ios.description:
Ritual connects you with local faves, hidden gems and your go-to chains near work or home. Order ahead, skip the line, and pick up something delicious. All on your schedule.
How does Ritual work?
- Browse hundreds of local restaurants near you: A mix of local gems and your everyday faves
- Customize your order in seconds
- Pay securely with the tap of a button
- Get notified the moment your order is ready
- Pick up something tasty. No line. No wait. 
What food can I order on Ritual?
From your morning coffee to a mouthwatering dinner, Ritual connects you with hundreds of local spots near you. Coffee and a pastry? Salad? Sandwich? Sushi? Tacos? A really good burger? Whatever you're craving, you'll find it. Search by cuisine or distance, reorder your faves, or discover a hidden gem.
Can I place group orders on Ritual?
Yes. Ritual's Piggyback feature makes group ordering a breeze. Create a work team, let teammates add their orders, and do one delicious run. No splitting bills, no collecting cash and bonus points for being the one who made lunch happen.
How does Ritual's rewards program work?
Ritual's Loyalty+ program rewards your daily rituals. Earn stamps at participating local spots and redeem them for something delicious on the house. Here's how it works:
- Order from a participating local restaurant
- Collect stamps automatically
- Redeem for free food
The more you order from your local faves, the more you earn! 
Is Ritual's payment secure?
Yes. Ritual keeps it safe and straightforward with no surprises. Save a personal or company credit card and pay with one tap. Your card number stays private and neither Ritual or the restaurant ever see it. Convenient contact-free pick ups.
Does Ritual offer corporate meal plans?
Yes. Ritual for Companies makes it easy to feed your team and show some local love. Ritual for Companies is a corporate meal and perk program designed to help businesses manage team food budgets, encourage office attendance, and provide exclusive restaurant discounts for hybrid or in-office employees. 
With Ritual for Companies you can:
- Set up custom employee meal plans that work for your team's size and budget that are recurring or one-time company-funded meal credits for meetings or daily office breakfast, lunch or dinner
- Distribute meal credits and perks to your team, whether that's 10 people, 100 or 1000+ 
- Allow team members to group and coordinate lunch orders together through Piggyback Ordering 
- Accommodate diverse team dietary preferences across local food vendors
- Use our admin portal to manage team members, customize notifications, and download usage

bluejetty:00150343:ios.description:
I'm Blakeley! Designer and Owner of the Blakeley Brand.
I'm sure you've seen my face a lot! Rightly so, it's plastered all over my website ha! I definitely am the face of my Brand, and it's a much deserved and well earned title!
I wasn't always so eager to model my own clothing, but I have really come to learn a lot of things over the years! One is authenticity and being comfortable in my own skin! While it's always a work in progress, I have learned the more "real" I am about myself, it has a tendency to elicit permission in others to shine bright and not hide who you are and who you are meant to be! 
I won't start my story with the boring...my love of fashion brought me to create my own clothing line...that's a given. 
In 2013 I was at a place in my life where I needed a BIG change. My husband was working 60+ hours a week, I had been running my airbrush tanning business and was gone every single night! We were over extended, over tired and burnt out. I wanted a change. 
My husband and I decided it was time to let go of the things that didn't serve us to make space for the things that did...like more family time, less stress and less obligations.
Just like that we made the decision and moved from our 4000 square foot home to a 1000 sq foot apartment with our 2 boys!
A funny thing happens when your mind and heart are more at ease. Suddenly it allowed room for creativity and a "flow" of life I was so desperately seeking!
I soon started making jewelry at night after my boys were asleep. I loved the creative outlet it gave me. 
One day I decided to post my new creations on my facebook page to show off my new hobby. Low and behind that post blew up! Soon, my mom, brothers and anyone who I could get to help would come over at night and help me make bracelets! I started marketing them via Facebook to Boutiques and got in hundreds of them within the first couple weeks! 
That was it, my fire was ignited and I KNEW fashion was my home! I started selling on Deal sites first and we were selling everything! Jewelry turned into accessories that then turned into clothes!
My UPS driver would deliver stacks of boxes outside our little apartment door and we would bring them in one by one until we could get them shipped out. 
It only took about 6 months before I saved up enough money to put a down payment on our home! I loved feeling that I was making a difference in our lives, and doing something I loved.
After being in business for a year, my husband came home from work one day and I told him I wanted him to quit his job and help me run the business. He told me if I could make the same amount or more for another year, he would quit, and I agreed!
Not even a year later I had doubled my sales and he quit his corporate job to help me with the business. 
I felt like I was really good at designing clothes and had a knack for it! Clothing was where I could REALLY feel my passion lied. 
In 2017 we shifted our business from deal sites and decided wholesale was the route we wanted to go. I posted my first 8 designs in a Boutique group and it EXPLODED! I got thousands of orders and things really ignited from there!
I've had so so many ups and downs over the past 4 years. It's been an absolutely wild ride, but one I wouldn't change for anything! 
Being able to keep our business not only alive, but absolutely thrive, confirms I am on the right path! 
"Follow your heart and clear your head!" It's my motto when things start feeling overwhelming and I just need to get back to basics. Your heart always knows the answer!
I hope I inspire you to follow your heart and follow your dreams. Amazing things happen when you do!
XOXO- Blakeley

bluejetty:00124427:ios.name: Soundboard Studio
bluejetty:00124427:ios.summary:
Soundboard Studio is the professional and smart sound playback app, perfect for for music, sound effects, voiceovers, pads, soundbites or anything else!
Soundboard Studio is designed for playing ad-lib sounds and music, with its large grid
bluejetty:00124427:ios.description:
Soundboard Studio is the professional and smart sound playback app, perfect for for music, sound effects, voiceovers, pads, soundbites or anything else!
Soundboard Studio is designed for playing ad-lib sounds and music, with its large grid of buttons for each of your tracks. You can customise the layout, colours and detailed settings for all of your tracks.
For years, Soundboard Studio has been the app of choice for many pro podcasters, studios, event venues and more. Here's just a few of their thoughts:
• “For the price it knocks everything else out of the ring that compares to work on a tablet or laptop.”
• “For me, this is the best of any program out there, and I’ve tried a lot.”
• “My worship Live looping is in a whole new Level! Thank you guys!”
• “This app is professional grade and made for—you guessed it—professionals! You won't regret this investment.”
• “Podcasters, look no further: This is your soundboard app!”
• “This is for serious professionals, so if that's you, add this app to your arsenal immediately.”
Top Features:
• Play multiple tracks simultaneously
• Set tracks to fade in and/or fade out
• Set individual volume levels for each track
• Trim the start and end of individual tracks
• Set tracks to automatically play the next adjacent track when they reaches their end
• Monitor and control multiple playing tracks
• Add images to your tracks to make them instantly recognisable
• Create multiple 'Boards' of tracks and quickly navigate between them
• Assign default track settings to apply to all newly imported tracks
• Import tracks from the Music library on your device
• Import audio files from your favourite apps and services like Dropbox, Google Drive, iCloud Drive and more via the Files app
• Use iTunes File Sharing to import files directly from your computer
• Drag & drop support – Drag any compatible audio files into Soundboard Studio
• See which tracks you have already played
• Low latency playback using the power and simplicity of iOS
• Colours! Select from 6 colours for your tracks and boards
• Collapsible view of all playing tracks for better control
• Easy drag & drop track arrangement
• Move tracks between boards
• Import multiple files at once from the Files app
• iPad split-screen multitasking support
• iPad slide-over multitasking support
Upgrade to Pro for extra features including:
• Create unlimited boards (limited to 4 boards without Pro)
• Add unlimited tracks (limited to 24 tracks without Pro)
• Background audio playback: Your tracks will continue playing when you close the app
• Add images to your tracks to easily identify them at a glance
• Program smart Track Automations to trigger events such as playing other tracks, or changing other track volumes
• Connect your device to an external display and chose from three realtime visualisers fo your sound
Soundboard Studio was designed to be perfect for...
• Podcasts
• Events
• Live theatre
• Church services
• Workshops
• Voice presenters
• Wedding planners
• Choreographers
• Stage Managers
• Magicians
• Puppeteers
• Dance recitals
Information about Soundboard Studio Pro:
Soundboard Studio Pro is available as a subscription or a one-time purchase.
If you subscribe to one of the subscription options, your subscription will start with a 7-day free trial. Your subscription will be applied to your iTunes account at the end of the trial.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime in the Settings menu in Soundboard Studio, or from your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
You can also upgrade to Pro without a subscription with a one-time purchase.
No other soundboard app comes close to the versatility, usability and experience of Soundboard Studio.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS, STAY MOTIVATED

bluejetty:00161709:ios.description:
Desenvolver maior capacidade de servir, estabelecendo alianças com nossos colaboradores, fornecedores e clientes, cujos resultados possam expressar uma identidade diferente no mercado em que atuamos. bluejetty:00177256:ios.name: Yoga+ by Mary
bluejetty:00177256:ios.summary: Create a lasting yoga routine that makes you feel good with over 300 guided yoga classes which are beginner friendly and personalized to your goals. Yoga+ is here to provide a space to help you practice yoga in a way that fits your everyday
bluejetty:00177256:ios.description:
Create a lasting yoga routine that makes you feel good with over 300 guided yoga classes which are beginner friendly and personalized to your goals. Yoga+ is here to provide a space to help you practice yoga in a way that fits your everyday life, feels fun, and builds lasting enjoyable habits. Together, let’s learn to better balance the mind and body both on and off the mat.
MEET MARY OCHSNER
Mary is an international yoga teacher with an online community of over 300,000 yogis. For over ten years, her passion has guided others to less stress and a more quiet and stable mind through daily yoga. 
FIND YOUR VIBE 
Not sure what you’re looking for? We offer four exclusive collections to suit your specific needs, whether to unwind after work, make time for yourself during busy times, give you a boost of energy, or offer self-care during those bad days. 
DAILY YOGA CLASSES AND MONTHLY CHALLENGES 
Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced yogi, Yoga+ provides multiple practice types to suit your needs.
• Wake up refreshed and wind down for the night with our gentle morning and relaxing evening yoga classes. 
• Take care of yourself and relieve stress with over 20+ classes aimed to help you unwind, relax, and feel good. 
• Unleash your inner warrior and find balance with beginner to advanced Vinyasa yoga classes and challenges. 
• Improve flexibility and release tension with deep full-body stretches and yoga classes to help stretch your hips, hammies, and back. 
• Yoga+ is proud to offer prenatal yoga classes to help with fatigue and morning sickness or postnatal yoga series to refresh and ground yourself. 
GUIDED MEDITATIONS & BREATHWORK

bluejetty:00044833:ios.description:
Squeeze is a way better massage experience. Why? Because unlike other massage places, you can book, pay, and tip right in the app—so after your massage, you can just float on out. No cashier, no registers, no checkout lines.
The app also lets you personalize every visit by selecting which areas you'd like us to focus on, how much pressure you prefer, and your music and lighting preferences. You can even add Premium Enhancements to customize your massage even further.
At Squeeze, our Signature Squeeze favorites deep tissue, heat therapy, percussion therapy, and aromatherapy are always included at no additional charge. How's that for easy, peasy, Squeezy?
MORE SQUEEZE, MORE PERKS
Our memberships make it easy to prioritize self-care with exclusive member pricing, flexible booking, and perks designed to help you relax more often. Manage your membership, book appointments, and view your visits, all from the app.
HAVE A FRIEND IN KNEAD?
Give the gift of Squeeze with a gift card and treat someone special to a little more relaxation.
LOCATIONS
We're growing across the U.S.! Browse our locations to find a Squeeze near you.
ABOUT US
We created Squeeze because we believed getting a great massage should be simple. We wanted to eliminate the hassle of hard-to-book appointments, awkward checkout counters, and inconsistent experiences and replace them with something thoughtful, personalized, and seamless.
From booking your massage to customizing your preferences to floating out the door, every detail is designed to help you feel your best. We hope you'll love it as much as we do.
Squeeze ya soon!

Relaxation
Life gets busy. Massage gives you the chance to slow down, unplug, and recharge.
Stress Relief
Massage can help reduce stress while supporting your body's natural feel-good hormones.
Pain Reduction
Massage may help relieve muscle tension, reduce discomfort, and support better sleep and recovery.
Health & Wellness
Massage is an important part of a healthy self-care routine that supports both body and mind.
Sports Recovery
Help reduce recovery time, ease sore muscles, and keep your body performing at its best.
Pregnancy
Prenatal massage provides gentle relief from many of the common discomforts experienced during pregnancy.

bluejetty:00156681:ios.summary: Now, board-certified health care providers can care for you or your child wherever you are, whenever you need them, from the convenience of your own mobile device or computer. From coughs and sore throats, to minor skin irritations and join
bluejetty:00156681:ios.description:
Now, board-certified health care providers can care for you or your child wherever you are, whenever you need them, from the convenience of your own mobile device or computer. From coughs and sore throats, to minor skin irritations and joint pain – we have you covered. An easier way to access both adult and pediatric care teams for urgent clinical care needs and common concerns – on your schedule, and in about 10 minutes!
Your virtual visit may even be less expensive than your other care options, compared to urgent care clinics and emergency rooms.
Simply download the app and register, and then select a provider and ‘click.’
Once you select a provider, the online communication begins shortly thereafter! Telehealth providers accessed via the Penn State Health OnDemand app will diagnose, may suggest follow-up care, and can prescribe medication.
Healthcare that meets you where you are and at your convenience; helping you feel better and return to your life sooner.
Penn State Health OnDemand can be used for various common symptoms and concerns:
• Allergies
• Cough
• Eye infections
• Joint pain or strains
• Lower back pain
• Minor rashes and skin concerns
• Painful urination
• Sore throat
• Stuffy and runny nose
The Penn State Health OnDemand telehealth program is not be appropriate for all concerns. The following symptoms should not be treated by a telehealth provider; go to the closest emergency room for in-person care:
• Assault, physical or sexual abuse, or child abuse
• Changes in mental status or confusion
• Chest pain or pressure
• Coughing/vomiting blood
• Difficulty breathing or shortness of breath
• Severe or persistent vomiting or diarrhea
• Sudden dizziness, weakness, change in vision, slurred speech, numbness, or other neurological changes
• Sudden or severe pain
• Uncontrolled bleeding
If you use Apple Health, you can choose to share your health information with the provider during your virtual video visit, such as heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, blood glucose levels, weight, nutritional information, and respiratory rate.

bluejetty:00153640:ios.description:
Whether you're getting over a breakup, healing from a toxic relationship, or moving on after a divorce, No Contact is the complete heartbreak recovery app that gives you structure, accountability, and real-time support to resist urges, find yourself again, and rebuild from the ground up.
STAY STRONG. STAY NO CONTACT.
▶ Beat nostalgia with reminders of red flags, broken trust, and why it ended
▶ Save screenshots and photos as visual proof in your Evidence Vault
▶ Write the risky text here first — pause before you send something you'll regret
▶ Panic Room: one tap when you're on the edge, built to pull you back before you break no contact
YOUR PERSONAL NO CONTACT COACH & AI THERAPIST
▶ Meet Kai — trained in the science of heartbreak, Kai learns your story and tailors advice to your healing journey
▶ Choose gentle support or tough love and brutal honesty
▶ A private space to vent, reflect, and process without judgment
PLEDGE NO CONTACT. BUILD YOUR STREAK.
▶ Start your No Contact counter and unlock weekly relationship psychology insights
▶ Check in daily to build your streak, log how you feel, and connect with others in No Contact
HEALING & GROWTH BEYOND SILENCE
▶ Programs to help you heal, grow, and rebuild
▶ Daily affirmations for the days heartbreak feels impossible
▶ Visualization sessions to rehearse hard moments before they happen
▶ Swap triggering social media for a curated growth feed
▶ Guided journaling to process and find clarity
UNDERSTAND WHAT REALLY HAPPENED
▶ Conversation Analyzer: upload a screenshot or chat history to uncover patterns and subtext
▶ Abuse Awareness: recognize manipulation and coercive control so you can stop second-guessing yourself
YOUR TOOLKIT FOR EVERY MOMENT
▶ Tools: a personalized library of coping tools — grounding, breathwork, releasing tension — organized by what you need right now
▶ Favorite your go-to tools for instant access
▶ Guided breathwork and somatic exercises to calm your nervous system
LEARN & UNDERSTAND YOUR HEALING
▶ Library: bite-sized articles on why leaving feels impossible, trauma bonds, and why grief isn't linear
▶ Personalized recommendations based on your patterns
THIS IS FOR YOU IF...
▶ You just went through a breakup or divorce
▶ You keep slipping back into contact with your ex
▶ You're stuck in a toxic or on-and-off cycle
▶ You want structure and accountability to finally move on
WHY IT WORKS
▶ Catches you in the moment, before temptation becomes a mistake
▶ Explains what you're feeling, so healing makes sense
▶ Holds you accountable when willpower runs out
▶ Makes healing feel real through visible growth
▶ Helps you understand what happened instead of replaying it
▶ Built specifically for heartbreak and the no contact rule
Start your free trial today and turn the hardest thing you've done into the best thing that's happened to you.

bluejetty:00091124:ios.description:
Alert SacRT: Free Safety and Security Mobile App for Riders
The Alert SacRT Safety and Security App offers riders a quick and discreet method for reporting safety and security concerns directly to RT Police. App users can send photos, six second video, text descriptions, and locations of suspicious people or activities. From the home screen, users have two easy options for contacting RT Police:
* The “Report an Issue” button allows users to send text or photos directly to RT. To ensure discretion, the camera flash is automatically disabled when photos are taken through the app. When reporting an issue, users can select locations and report categories to assist RT Police. Riders can also send reports anonymously if they chose.
* The “Call RT Police” button will connect customers directly to RT Police.
The application is designed for robust operation even under conditions of poor signal strength. If you send a report from an area without cellular/Wi-Fi connectivity, it will be stored and sent when connectivity returns. The system is also designed to send text descriptions before photos so that the police can get information as quickly as possible.
Additional Features:
BOLO (Be On the Look Out) Alerts. BOLO Alerts on Alert SacRT may display alerts from RT Police about specific persons of interest. For example, RT may display information about a missing person or child, such as where they were last seen. If you see a person from a BOLO, immediately call 9-1-1 and send an app report to RT discreetly.
Help keep RT safe, "See It - Hear It - Report It."

bluejetty:00064660:ios.description:
CreditWise is a free credit monitoring tool that could help you improve your credit score.
We believe in empowering people with the tools to effectively monitor and manage their credit, no matter where they are in their credit journey. Using CreditWise won't hurt your score.
With CreditWise, you'll have free access to your FICO® Score 8 and TransUnion® credit report—plus targeted advice, tools and alerts to help you monitor your credit. You'll also get free access to dark web alerts to help you take action when your information is detected somewhere suspicious.
Sign up for CreditWise and receive:
 ● Updates as frequently as daily to your TransUnion-based FICO Score 8.
 ● Access to your TransUnion credit report to look for signs of error, theft or fraud.
 ● Alerts if your Social Security number or email address are found on the dark web.
 ● Clarity on how certain everyday decisions may affect your credit score with the Credit Simulator.
 ● Helpful breakdowns of the key factors that make up your credit score and how you’re doing on each of them.
 ● Suggestions to help you improve your credit score.
 ● Alerts about select changes to your TransUnion or Experian® credit reports.
 ● Alerts if any new names or addresses were associated with your Social Security number on a credit application.
Ever wanted to know the impact of certain financial decisions on your credit score, before you make them? CreditWise has a tool for that. Use the Credit Simulator to see how different scenarios—like opening a new credit card—could affect your FICO Score 8. Knowing how certain actions could impact your score may help you establish, maintain and build credit for more financial stability.
CreditWise is free, fast, secure and available to every adult who is 18 or older residing in the US with a Social Security number and a report on file at TransUnion. Download the app today and take control of your credit.
The credit score provided in CreditWise is a FICO® Score 8 based on TransUnion® data. The FICO Score 8 gives you a good sense of your credit health but it may not be the same score model used by your lender or creditor. The availability of the CreditWise tool and certain features in the tool depends on our ability to obtain your credit history from TransUnion and whether you have sufficient credit history to generate a FICO Score 8. Some monitoring and alerts may not be available to you if the information you enter at enrollment does not match the information in your credit file at (or you do not have a file at) one or more consumer reporting agencies. You do not need to be a Capital One account holder to sign up for CreditWise.
Alerts are based on changes to your TransUnion and Experian® credit reports and information we find on the dark web.
The CreditWise Simulator provides an estimate of your score change and does not guarantee how your score may change.

bluejetty:00145403:ios.description:
GenVista turns your words into pictures. Describe what you want and get a lifelike photo or a cartoon. Have a photo? Say what should change, like "make it golden hour" or "change the coat to a red leather jacket", and get it back edited.
CREATE
• Realistic images: people, places and things that look like real photos
• Cartoon images: anime and cartoon drawings
• Ideas to start from, and five picture shapes from tall to wide
EDIT WITH WORDS
• Pick a photo, type what should change, done
• Keep editing a result until it's right
QUICK TOOLS
• Remove background: your subject on a clean white background
• Restore old photo: fix scratches and fading, bring back natural color
• Professional headshot: studio light and a neutral backdrop
• Turn into cartoon: your photo redrawn as a cartoon
YOUR PICTURES
• Save to Photos or share in one tap
• My creations keeps your pictures for 48 hours, then they're deleted for good, together with the photos you sent
• Report any picture that looks wrong

It's an auto-renewing subscription: payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm, and it renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings. Prices are shown in the app.
For adults 18 and over.

bluejetty:00045376:ios.summary:

Why waste time on TV shows you won't love or restaurants that don't live up to the hype? Stop doo
bluejetty:00045376:ios.description:
Find your next favorite movie, TV show, or restaurant with RecSpot — the go-to app for discovering, sharing, and organizing recommendations. 
Why waste time on TV shows you won't love or restaurants that don't live up to the hype? Stop doom-scrolling. RecSpot allows trusted friends, not hidden algorithms, to provide personalized recommendations of what to watch and where to eat or drink.
JOIN RECSPOTERS WHO ARE:
• Cultural mavens who want to help friends keep track of what’s great and what can wait /
• Foodies searching for top restaurants, food trucks, and nearby culinary experiences /
• Movie buffs wanting recommendations from real people - not an algorithm /
• Night owls wanting suggestions for new bars, clubs, and concert venues /
• Travelers who want to know the best local spots in a new city /
• Organizing TV shows into watchlists to binge-watch / 
[ RECLISTS ] 
Create customizable lists of your top picks, so you can easily track what you want to watch, where you want to go, and more. Save all your favorites in one place, and share them with your friends so everyone can keep track of the shows or places you want to hit up next.
[ VIBRANT COMMUNITY ] 
Are you looking for inspiration on what to watch or where to go? Follow your friends, influencers, and local experts to see what they're watching and where they're dining, drinking, and traveling.
[ BOOKMARK ] 
You'll never feel stuck choosing something to do because RecSpot keeps track of what you want to experience next. Quickly organize recommendations for restaurants, bars, cafes, hotels, and places to visit near you. And when it's time to relax, you can find TV and movie suggestions at your fingertips.
[ NICHE INTERESTS ]
Your destination for all things niche. The app's community of like-minded users makes it great for niche interests, such as Anime fans or Rom-Com connoisseurs. Follow influencers or friends who aren’t trying to maximize your view time but just want you to discover what they know you love. 
[ DISCOVER ] 
Easily keep up-to-date with new movie releases, TV series premieres, and what’s streaming on Netflix, Amazon, Disney, and more services. Browsable lists are automatically sorted by category so you can quickly find what interests you.
[ SEARCH ] 
Quickly find media, places, and interesting people. Filters and maps help you find just what you want. Recommendation scores are from real people, meaning the results are trustworthy - never sponsored. Stop feeling overwhelmed by all the options, and stop scrolling through ads.
[ DISCOVER NEW PLACES ]
RecSpot isn't just for entertainment - it's also an excellent resource for finding new places to visit. Whether planning a trip or just looking for new things to do in your hometown, RecSpot's recommendations and user reviews can help you discover stunning hotels, trendy restaurants, and lively nightlife nearby.
▶ READ WHAT RECSPOT USERS ARE SAYING ON THE APP STORE ◀
• "[...] One platform for every kind of recommendation. Especially great for locations you are unfamiliar with"
• "[...] Love how easy it is to share my favorite recommendations with my friends."
• "[...] Whenever I need a solid ‘go to’ for a recommendation, I got it!"
------------
Download RecSpot today and start discovering great recommendations for the things you love. Questions or feedback? Get responsive support at support@therecspot.com. Visit https://www.therecspot.com/ for more details.

Cast any online video to your TV, via Roku® and Roku-powered TVs.
*** Feature Highlights ***
• HD resolution supported (1080p and up to 4K depending on the device)
• Advanced browser, supports multiple browser tabs, blocks or hides spammy popups, search from the URL bar, ad blocker, browsing history etc...
• Subtitle auto-detect + Movie/TV Subtitle library

bluejetty:00161167:ios.description:
You use this app when you use an Arboleaf Body Composition Smart Scale. This free app tracks your body weight, body fat, BMI, and other body composition data. It provides the information and inspiration to track your weight loss progress and to keep your fitter.
Arboleaf app and Smart Scale make it easier for you to track your health, fitness and set goals. Step on the Smart Scale, you can have your overall body composition data including:
- Weight
- Body Fat
- BMI (Body Mass Index)
- Body Water
- Bone Mass
- Muscle Mass
- Basal Metabolic Rate
- Body Type
- Visceral Fat Grade
- Metabolic Age
The Arboleaf app works with all Arboleaf Smart Scale models. Some scale models may not support the full list of the above measurements, the app automatically reads all the available data from the scale and store the data on the cloud.
The Arboleaf app connects with several popular fitness apps such as Apple HealthKit, Fitbit, etc. Your body composition information can be seamlessly transmitted to your existing app. We are adding more fitness apps, please keep your Arboleaf app up to date.
One Smart Scales can support multiple users, it is a perfect bathroom scale for your entire family.
Your weight and your body composition data are your personal information. We treat your privacy with priority. Only you can access your data, and only you can decide how to share your data with others.
To learn more about the Arboleaf Scales, Arboleaf app, and compatible apps, go to www.arboleaf.com.

bluejetty:00173558:ios.description:
Art has not only the power to inspire, but it can also be incredibly relaxing. Breathe deep, clear your mind, and unwind with this ultra-relaxing and endlessly enjoyable puzzle game guaranteed to relieve stress, soothe frayed nerves, prompt ASMR and promote mental wellness.
 Find a sanctuary on your phone and make space to relax with this simple meditative drawing game that calms your brain, delights your eyes, and fires your inspiration.
► Cosmic connections
• It’s all interconnected – glide your fingers across the screen to join numbered stars and create a constellation of beautiful 3D drawings based on origami art. Numbers indicate the connections between each star, so the image develops slowly and organically from your movements on the screen until everything clicks satisfyingly into place.
• Never fear – made a mistake? No worries, just undo your last move and try again. You’ve got all the time in the world and there’s no penalty for trying and failing. The focus of this game is on relaxation and serious artistic fun!
• Infinitely relaxing – progress your way through hundreds of different puzzle drawings, each revealing a unique and carefully designed figure in a wide range of categories.
• Fresh challenges – every day brings a new extended puzzle broken down into stages so that your meditative efforts are eventually rewarded with a satisfying sensation of wholeness when you connect all the numbers, and the final image is revealed.
• Space to breathe – simple ergonomic game design, relaxing ambient music, rich sound effects, and satisfying but discreet haptic responses create a Zen-like environment that will induce ASMR and provide instant relaxation at even the most stressful times.
► At one with the universe
Let your fingers dance across the astral plane, sketching symbols of eternal significance (and some cute animals) between the stars in this soothing, meditative drawing game where each puzzle brings you closer to a state of Zen calm. Feel your body loosen and your mind float free as you draw your way to mental wellness. Download Start Art now to discover instant relaxation and the healing power of art.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00135032:ios.summary: The drum set, present in 99% of music, plays a crucial role in shaping a song's tempo, rhythm, and overall mood. If you had the chance to learn this influential instrument through an app, would you give it a shot? Enter InstaDrum. This app
bluejetty:00135032:ios.description:
The drum set, present in 99% of music, plays a crucial role in shaping a song's tempo, rhythm, and overall mood. If you had the chance to learn this influential instrument through an app, would you give it a shot? Enter InstaDrum. This app lets you dive into the world of drumming, providing entertaining and interactive lessons that encourage you to step into your drumming journey with confidence. Using its game-like structure, you can promptly learn to play your favorite songs, even as a complete beginner.
Experience a fun and easy approach to learning drums with InstaDrum, an app that's compatible with all electronic drums and even functions without one. Whether you have a drum set, a roll-up pad, or a drum machine, InstaDrum works seamlessly with them all. If you don't have a drum? No problem. Our on-screen virtual drum lets you explore music right at your fingertips. Just relax and play along with your favorite tunes, or grab your drumsticks for a musical cardio workout.
Here's why people love InstaDrum:
- Broad selection of songs catering to varied musical tastes and skill levels - from the sounds of Billie Eilish to Linkin Park, and from the beginner-friendly "Yellow" to the more challenging "I don’t know about you".
- It facilitates a progressive learning journey from mastering a single note to playing a beat, and from performing a beat to a complete song.
- It integrates with any electronic drums via Bluetooth or cable, providing real-time feedback on your performance.
- It offers real drum notation and full-length sheet music, equipping you with skills to read music even outside the app.
So whether you're searching for a cool new hobby, aspiring to rehearse before purchasing a drum set, or an experienced drummer wishing to play your favorite songs, InstaDrum caters to all your drumming desires.
Privacy Policy: https://www.instadrum.com/instadrum_privacy_policy.html
User Agreement: https://www.instadrum.com/instadrum_user_agreement.html

bluejetty:00144644:ios.name: Walk the Distance
bluejetty:00144644:ios.summary: Walking step challenges on real famous trails. Walk the Distance turns your everyday steps into an adventure on 20+ iconic hiking trails — from the Appalachian Trail to the Pacific Crest Trail, Camino de Santiago, and beyond. No treadmill o
bluejetty:00144644:ios.description:
Walking step challenges on real famous trails. Walk the Distance turns your everyday steps into an adventure on 20+ iconic hiking trails — from the Appalachian Trail to the Pacific Crest Trail, Camino de Santiago, and beyond. No treadmill or special device needed — just walk, and watch your progress come to life on a real trail map..
WALK ICONIC TRAILS
- Appalachian Trail (2,190 miles)
- Pacific Crest Trail (2,650 miles)
- Continental Divide Trail (3,100 miles)
- John Muir Trail
- Camino de Santiago
- Marathons, city walks, and national park routes
STEP CHALLENGES THAT KEEP YOU MOVING
Works automatically with Apple Health — no extra hardware required. Also syncs with Fitbit and Garmin so every step counts, whether you're walking the dog, commuting, or hitting the trails. Your steps sync all day, every day, and fuel your progress on the trail.
STAY MOTIVATED WITH CHECKPOINTS
Unlock real waypoints as you progress — trail shelters, scenic overlooks, and landmarks. Each checkpoint keeps you moving toward the next milestone.
WALK WITH FRIENDS & COMPETE
Add friends and walk the same trail together. See who's ahead on the leaderboard, get notified when someone passes you, and join group step challenges to stay accountable.
BUILT FOR YOUR HEALTH GOALS
Whether you want to lose weight, build a daily walking habit, burn more calories, or just get moving — step challenges on famous trails make fitness fun and meaningful.
CORPORATE WELLNESS
Companies use Walk the Distance for employee step challenges with team leaderboards and admin dashboards. Tap "Send to HR" to get your workplace started.
SET IT AND FORGET IT
The app runs quietly in the background, pulling your distance from Apple Health once per hour. When you reach a checkpoint or a friend passes you, you'll get a notification.
BETTER THAN A PEDOMETER
A pedometer counts steps — Walk the Distance gives them meaning. Step challenges on real trails turn your daily walking into an adventure, keeping you motivated every step of the way.
Free trails in every category, with additional routes available for $0.99 each or with a premium membership.

bluejetty:00123830:ios.summary: Demise of Nations is a 4X turn-based grand strategy wargame covering the rise of Rome till the fall of modern civilization. Command your armies in one of the many ancient and modern countries including the Roman Empire, British Islands, Ger
bluejetty:00123830:ios.description:
Demise of Nations is a 4X turn-based grand strategy wargame covering the rise of Rome till the fall of modern civilization. Command your armies in one of the many ancient and modern countries including the Roman Empire, British Islands, Germany, Japan or the United States. From Rome to modern nations, you create your own warring experience. Wage colossal wars solo, against the AI, or take on your gaming friends in cross-platform multiplayer games. Form alliances and fight co-op style with the AI and other players for ultimate victory.
Range of functionality is comprised of trading, diplomacy, expansion, conducting research, exploration, managing resources, building, food distribution, governing and city management. Units at your disposal are Scouts, Swordsmen, Spearmen, Archers, War Elephants, Galleys and Longboats amongst others. Demise of Nations incorporates changing weather patterns such as shifting climates and storms. Rain during summer providing much needed humidity for your crops, while snowy winters will proof if you are ready for the challenge. Assemble your armies, take on the world and achieve greatness in this epic historical strategy game.
 - Turn-Based Grand Strategy covering Ancient to Modern Times.
 - 4X Strategy: eXplore, eXpand, eXploit, and eXterminate.
 - Challenging AI based on Genetic Algorithm.
 - Weather and Seasons including Snow, Rain and Storms.
 - Diplomacy, Research, Trade and City-Building.
 - Cross-Platform Multiplayer/Hotseat-Play including co-op team games.
 - Random Map Generator.
 - Nations: Roman Empire, Gaul, Germany, Japan and the United States amongst others.
 - Troops: Swordsmen, Archers, Horsemen, Tanks and Fighter Planes amongst others.
 - Ships: Galleys, Aircraft Carriers, Battleships and Submarines amongst others.
 - Played as WE-GO Turn-Based Game allowing for an Unlimited Number of Players.
 - High Scores, Playing Statistics and Achievements.
 - Engaging Music and Sound Effects.

bluejetty:00164486:ios.description:
Vestin - The Safest Stock & Crypto Investment Simulation 
Enhance your investment skills without any risk through mock investments. 
■ Real-Time Investment Information 
- Easily catch up on stock charts, the latest news, and market prices at a glance. 
- From basic investment knowledge to advanced strategies, we offer a variety of investment insights tailored to your experience. 
- Simulate investments in US stocks, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies simultaneously. 
■ Smart AI Investment Analysis 
- AI analyzes your investment tendencies and suggests optimal strategies for you. 
- Gain insights from other users' portfolios, analyzed by AI. 
■ Community & Real-Time Chat for Each Asset 
- Share opinions and strategies with a diverse group of users. 
- Get in-depth insights on investments within specific asset communities.

- Build effective investment habits through daily missions.

■ Challenge the Monthly Top Earner Leaderboard
- Compete with others to show off your investment skills. 
- Track your investment growth in real time as your rank changes. 
■ Real-Time Notification System 
- Receive alerts on price surges, drops, and yearly highs so you never miss key investment moments. 
Start a safe and systematic investment journey with Vestin now!

bluejetty:00073178:ios.summary:

Choose up to 24 habits you want to keep, and build a streak of days in a row. Streaks works on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac and Ap
bluejetty:00073178:ios.description:
STREAKS. The habit tracker that helps you build good habits and break bad ones.
Apple Design Award winner.
Choose up to 24 habits you want to keep, and build a streak of days in a row. Streaks works on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac and Apple Vision Pro, and keeps everything in sync with iCloud.
BUILD HABITS YOUR WAY
* Track a habit every day, on specific days, a few times a week, or every few days
* Set goals over a week, fortnight, month or year, such as 10,000 steps a day or 3 workouts a week
* Break bad habits with negative tasks: quit smoking, drink less coffee, spend less time on your phone
* Time habits such as meditation, reading or brushing your teeth, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
* Record a note for any day
* Reminders arrive around when you usually complete a habit, only if it isn't done yet
AUTOMATIC WITH APPLE HEALTH AND SCREEN TIME
* Streaks completes habits for you from more than 80 types of Apple Health data, including steps, workouts, sleep, water, mindful minutes and calories
* Log water, mindful minutes or toothbrushing in Streaks and it's saved to the Health app too
* Screen Time habits track how long you spend in apps, so you can cut back on your phone
“I was smoking 15 cigarettes each day. Streaks helped me to quit smoking by reducing and then eliminating my daily use.” - Ben, Adelaide.
ON EVERY APPLE DEVICE
* Interactive widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen let you complete habits without opening the app
* A full Apple Watch app, with complications for every watch face
* Siri and Shortcuts support
* Share a habit with a friend or family member who also uses Streaks, so they can encourage you and keep you accountable
MAKE IT YOURS
* Over 30 color themes, including animated themes and seasonal looks
* Over 800 habit icons
* The Gold theme celebrates the days you complete every habit
* Statistics for your current and best streaks, completion rates and history
“I've now reduced my coffee intake by 70% with Streaks, something I struggled with for 5 years. It's a life changing app to me.” - Otávio, Chicago.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Do I need an account?
No. There's no sign-up or login. Your habits are stored on your device and synced through your own iCloud account, not on our servers.
Which devices does Streaks work on?
iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac and Apple Vision Pro. The apps sync with each other through iCloud.
Can I share Streaks with my family?
Yes. Streaks supports Family Sharing.
Does Streaks have ads or tracking?
No. Streaks has no ads and doesn't track you.
Does it work offline?
Yes. You can complete habits without a connection, and they sync the next time you're online.
How many habits can I track?
Up to 24, across four pages of six.
Can I track a habit weekly, or a few times a week?
Yes. A habit can repeat daily, on chosen days, a number of times per week, fortnight, month or year, or every few days.
Does it work with Apple Health?
Yes. Streaks reads and writes Health data with your permission, so habits like steps, workouts, sleep and water complete automatically.
Is there a version for kids?
Yes. Little Streaks is a separate app with routines and rewards for children.
Questions, suggestions or other feedback? Please email support@streaks.app.
If you like Streaks, please leave us a review! Your reviews enable us to keep improving and updating the app.
ABOUT HEALTH DATA
On supported devices, Streaks reads and writes data in the Health app with your permission, to determine completion of your tasks and to save what you log. All data is accessed in full accordance with the app review rules set by Apple. Please read our privacy policy at https://streaks.app/privacy for more information on our use of data.
--

* Track a habit every day, on specific days, a few times a week, or every few days
* Set goals over a week, fortnight, month or year, such as 10,000 steps a day or 3 workouts a week
* Break bad habits with negative tasks: quit smoking, drink less coffee, spend less time on your phone
* Time habits such as meditation, reading or brushing your teeth, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
* Record a note for any day
* Reminders arrive around when you usually complete a habit, only if it isn't done yet

AUTOMATIC WITH APPLE HEALTH AND SCREEN TIME

* Streaks completes habits for you from more than 80 types of Apple Health data, including steps, workouts, sleep, water, mindful minutes and calories
* Log water, mindful minutes or toothbrushing in Streaks and it's saved to the Health app too
* Screen Time habits track how long you spend in apps, so you can cut back on your phone

“I was smoking 15 cigarettes each day. Streaks helped me to quit smoking by reducing and then eliminating my daily use.” - Ben, Adelaide.

ON EVERY APPLE DEVICE

* Interactive widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen let you complete habits without opening the app
* A full Apple Watch app, with complications for every watch face
* Siri and Shortcuts support
* Share a habit with a friend or family member who also uses Streaks, so they can encourage you and keep you accountable

MAKE IT YOURS

* Over 30 color themes, including animated themes and seasonal looks
* Over 800 habit icons
* The Gold theme celebrates the days you complete every habit
* Statistics for your current and best streaks, completion rates and history

“I've now reduced my coffee intake by 70% with Streaks, something I struggled with for 5 years. It's a life changing app to me.” - Otávio, Chicago.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Do I need an account?
No. There's no sign-up or login. Your habits are stored on your device and synced through your own iCloud account, not on our servers.

Which devices does Streaks work on?
iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac and Apple Vision Pro. The apps sync with each other through iCloud.

Can I share Streaks with my family?
Yes. Streaks supports Family Sharing.

Does Streaks have ads or tracking?
No. Streaks has no ads and doesn't track you.

Does it work offline?
Yes. You can complete habits without a connection, and they sync the next time you're online.

How many habits can I track?
Up to 24, across four pages of six.

Can I track a habit weekly, or a few times a week?
Yes. A habit can repeat daily, on chosen days, a number of times per week, fortnight, month or year, or every few days.

Does it work with Apple Health?
Yes. Streaks reads and writes Health data with your permission, so habits like steps, workouts, sleep and water complete automatically.

Is there a version for kids?
Yes. Little Streaks is a separate app with routines and rewards for children.

Questions, suggestions or other feedback? Please email support@streaks.app.

If you like Streaks, please leave us a review! Your reviews enable us to keep improving and updating the app.

ABOUT HEALTH DATA

On supported devices, Streaks reads and writes data in the Health app with your permission, to determine completion of your tasks and to save what you log. All data is accessed in full accordance with the app review rules set by Apple. Please read our privacy policy at https://streaks.app/privacy for more information on our use of data.

** Fast & accurate lookup of the latest ICD-10 Codes **
ICD-10 CODING GUIDE is a powerful mobile app developed by Unbound Medicine, an award-winning health care information provider with more than 5 million users worldwide. 
Featuring the latest ICD-10-CM data from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), this premium app helps you quickly identify the most appropriate code on your smartphone or tablet — with rapid search by code, disease, injury, drug, or keyword. 
No internet access is required after initial content download. 
FEATURES
• Access to all ICD-10-CM codes 
• Code and keyword search for fast discovery
• Color-keyed Code Trees for accurate code assignment
• Make notes and highlights within any entry
• 'Favorites' for bookmarking commonly used codes
• Companion website for desktop convenience
FREE TRIAL: What To Expect
• First-time users are offered a Free Trial of Unbound's complete ICD-10 Coding Guide
• After the Free Trial period ends, your iTunes account will be charged $9.99 for a one-year subscription unless you have turned off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the free trial ends.
• To manage your subscriptions, open Apple's "Settings" app, tap your Apple ID at the top of the screen, tap Subscriptions, then tap the subscription you wish to manage. 
• NOTE: if you choose not to purchase a subscription, content will no longer be viewable after the free-trial period ends. 
Subscription Renewals
• Your subscription will automatically renew annually and your iTunes account will be charged $9.99 unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours prior to the end of the one-year period. 
• If you choose not to renew, you can continue to use the product but will not receive content updates.
• To manage your subscriptions, open Apple's "Settings" app, tap your Apple ID at the top of the screen, tap Subscriptions, then tap the subscription you wish to manage. 
Unbound Privacy Policy: https://www.unboundmedicine.com/privacy

bluejetty:00178293:ios.description:
--- Art with ease --- 
Create art with the help of your fingertip. It's easy, relaxing and satisfying! 
Mandalas are beautiful pieces of art where a certain segment is repeated many times, which gives a wonderful visual effect. This app is here to make it easy for you to create Mandalas from your own images or images from the built-in image library. Select an image and play around with different parameters which you can adjust. You also can animate the Mandala. 
--- Key features ---
- Load own images
- Customize different parameters
- Add effects (bloom, vignette, chromatic abbaration)
- Animate it!
- Screenshot and video recording (UI excluded, could be used for your projects!)
- Draw mode (Experimental)
--- Draw mode --- 
I also added a simple draw mode which allows you to draw your own Mandala. It currently only has limited options. When you like that mode, just let me know you're interested in more, so I will continue developing this mode. 
Do you have ideas for improvements or new features? Please send me a message using info@mkgames.org
If you like the app, you would really help me with leaving a review - thanks a lot!
- Best regards Marvin

bluejetty:00044629:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00044629:ios.description:
Manage all of your Virtual Numbers in our secure, integrated mobile app. The Tossable Digits app works with any active subscription.
Tossable Digits has been providing private virtual phone numbers to customers for over 20 years! Choose from over 5 million local or Toll-Free numbers from over 60+ countries, make and record private calls, send anonymous texts, hide your Caller ID with a new phone number, or even manage multiple lines for your personal or business life, all without the need for a second phone. We offer more included features than any other virtual phone number company.
HOW TOSSABLE DIGITS WORKS
Privacy is key with Tossable Digits. Simply choose a number or numbers from our list of over 5 million, then forward that virtual number to any phone you choose. When someone calls your new Tossable Digits number, we will route that call to whatever phone you set up to receive those calls - without the caller ever knowing it’s not your “real” number. You can even use our service with or without the app, and make calls from your Tossable Digits phone number on ANY device. Never carry a second phone again!
FEATURES AND BENEFITS
Each Tossable Digits number includes over 60 features no matter which plan you choose:
- Unlimited Call Recording
- Unlimited Voicemail
- Unlimited SMS Text Messaging
- Custom Call Rules
- Do Not Disturb
- Outdial
- Call Announce
- Call Forwarding
- CallerID Control
- Call Notes
- Screening
- Custom IVR Menu
- API
- Two-Factor Authentication
- and many more!
Other features we offer include RoboCall Blocking, Short Code SMS, Custom Caller ID Message, and more!
WHY USE TOSSABLE DIGITS?
- Your phone number is a gateway to your private information, and protecting that information has never been as important as it is now. Get a Tossable Digits number and use that phone number when selling things online, dating, making or taking deliveries, signing up for contests and memberships.
- Business Owner, Entrepreneur, or Employee in need of a separate business number? With Tossable Digits, there is no need for a complex phone system, second phone, or second sim card. Set calls to be forwarded to your office phone or cell phone with ease. With over 60 included features like Unlimited SMS, Call Recording, and Voicemail, IVR, Call Logs and Do Not Disturb, you can keep your business running with just one app.
- Traveling internationally or calling internationally? Park or Port your number to Tossable Digits if you are traveling for a while or get a local number in 60+ countries to help family and friends reach you easily. 
- Track Real Estate and Auto Sales Listings as well as Display Marketing ROI by getting a number for each listing, post, or ad. Stay organized and know what potential customers are calling about before you answer.
- Moving your business to another location but want to keep your number? Simply send it over to Tossable Digits and we will hold it for you as long as you need it.
BEST IN CLASS
Since we started in 2005 we’ve been featured in The Washington Post, Reuters, Fox, Forbes, Geek, Today, CNET, ZDNet, and more. We have an A+ rating with the BBB and pride ourselves on our world-class customer service. 
HOW DO I GET STARTED?
The Tossable Digits app is for existing Tossable Digits customers with an active subscription. Download the app for an even easier experience making calls and sending texts.

apple-macos:6761390161.name: Resso: Cloud & IT Manager
apple-macos:6761390161.description:
Resso gives developers, DevOps engineers, and tech solopreneurs a clear, visual canvas to catalog, track, and manage their infrastructure assets. Instead of relying on fragmented notes, scattered spreadsheets, or clicking through multiple disconnected web consoles, Resso brings your entire tech stack together into a single organised list.
Whether you are organizing freelance client infrastructure or mapping out a personal project, Resso helps you visualize how every asset connects to your broader system. Thanks to the mobile version, you can now manage your assets everywhere you go.
AUTOMATED PROVIDER IMPORT
Stop manually entering every piece of your infrastructure. Resso securely connects to your development ecosystems to automatically pull your live assets directly into your catalog:
• Compute Servers: Instantly import virtual machines from Google Cloud (GCP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
• Applications and Deployments: Sync your live apps from App Store Connect and deployment instances from Vercel.
• Code and Network: Pull in your GitHub repositories alongside domains and DNS settings from Cloudflare.
INTEGRATED TERMINAL AND SFTP FILE BROWSER
Move from viewing your asset catalog to interacting with it directly:
• Built-In SSH Console: Open a secure remote session natively inside the app for quick server management without needing outside dependencies.
• External Emulator Support: If you prefer your own customized terminal setup, Resso easily launches connections using your favorite external terminal instead.
• SFTP File Browser: For server assets, quickly open a built-in graphical file browser to navigate remote directories and manage files visually.
EXTENSIBILITY
• Apple Shortcuts & Siri: Access your asset data seamlessly within Apple's native Shortcuts app. Query asset properties, read infrastructure details to feed other automation workflows.
CORE ENGINE FEATURES
• Visual Dependency Mapping: Contextually link domains to servers, deployment environments to services, and databases to code repositories. See exactly how parts of your system interact at a glance.
• Universal Asset Schemas: Track servers, domains, repositories, and SaaS subscriptions in one place. Keep an organized record of hosting providers, server IPs, and domain renewal dates.
• Advanced Filter Engine: Query thousands of infrastructure components using conditional filters across text strings, tags, and custom dates to find exactly what you need in seconds.
• Local-First and Private: Your infrastructure blueprint belongs to you. Resso works completely offline with zero tracking or telemetry.
OTHER FEATURES
• iCloud Sync: Securely keep your catalog updated across your personal Mac ecosystem with native end-to-end encryption.
• Asset Reminders: Set up proactive calendar alerts and native Mac notifications for domain renewals, hosting expiries, or upkeep tasks.
• CSV Export: Easily export your asset data to clean tables for sharing, physical backups, or spreadsheet analysis.
NOTE
A monthly subscription (7-day free trial) or a one-time purchase is required to use the app.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://extiri.com/privacy_policy.html

firefox-addons:3117393.name: PassGen – Password Generator
firefox-addons:3117393.summary: Strong, random passwords and passphrases in one click. Offline, private, no accounts.
firefox-addons:3117393.description:
PassGen creates strong, truly random passwords and memorable passphrases right from your toolbar. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
★ ONE CLICK, OR NO CLICKS
Press Alt+Shift+G to open PassGen, then Enter to copy. A fresh password is on your clipboard before you can blink.
★ PASSWORDS YOUR WAY
• 4 to 128 characters
• Uppercase, lowercase, digits and symbols: every type you enable is guaranteed to appear
• Avoid look-alike characters (I, l, 1, O, 0) for passwords you need to read or type
• Set your own symbol list for sites that only accept certain symbols
★ PASSPHRASES YOU CAN REMEMBER
• 3 to 20 random words from the EFF word list (7,776 words)
• Choose the separator, capitalize words, add a number
• Six words give about 80 bits of entropy, which is easy to type and very hard to guess
★ HONEST STRENGTH METER
Shows the exact entropy in bits for your settings, with a clear Very weak to Very strong rating.
★ PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline: no network requests, no analytics, no ads
• Only one permission (storage), with no access to the websites you visit
• Randomness comes from your browser's cryptographically secure generator (crypto.getRandomValues), with no bias
• Open source, so anyone can check the code
★ ACCESSIBLE
Works fully with the keyboard and screen readers, and supports light and dark mode.

MobiMatter is a travel eSIM provider: buy, install and manage your eSIMs in one app, with a choice of networks across 200+ destinations. Our range includes plans from around 20 vetted providers. Available networks and providers depend on the destination and plan.
Choose mobile data when traveling abroad for a short trip or an extended stay, with single-country, regional and global options, including plans valid for up to 365 days. Check the countries covered and when the validity period begins before purchasing. See data allowances, validity, prices and supported networks in one place.
MAKE YOUR TRAVEL DATA GO FURTHER
• Choose your network: see the available plans for your destination and choose the right balance of data, coverage and price.
• Know what you are buying: check network, hotspot, activation and top-up details before purchase. Features vary by plan.
• Get set up: install your eSIM using the available in-app installation option or QR code, then follow your plan’s activation instructions.
• Check your data: view supported plans’ usage in the app or with the Home Screen widget. Usage updates depend on the provider.
• Top up when you need more: add data to supported eSIMs directly in the app.
• Earn towards your next trip: explore purchase and referral rewards. Rewards are MobiMatter credit; eligibility and terms apply.
GET READY IN THREE STEPS
1. Search your destination and choose a plan.
2. Buy your plan and install your eSIM while you have an internet connection.
3. Follow the activation instructions for your plan and connect at your destination.
Keep your usual SIM available for calls and messages while using your travel eSIM for cellular data. Charges from your usual mobile provider may still apply.
You need an unlocked, eSIM-compatible device. Coverage, speed, validity, activation rules and top-up availability depend on the plan. Review the plan details and device compatibility before buying.
Support is available 24/7 if you need help with your eSIM.
